tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 1 rdzogs pa chen po'i rnam gzhag mthong grol byin rlabs 'bar ba

tei:div.tei:p: d+ngha— mo 7 sneṅka lge ༷ — rko —༄/ dam chospo0sa pa r+sāpo'i rnam ā+og che long tsam rme brjod pa rtsungagrol byin rlar+sā'abar hrū tre'od garnazhes bya gas so/ / /tsho reb gong rdo rje mkhar gyis/ ci 4 ༷ // rna // cho/ mordzo ri—chi ci wa khye (tsho — ru ri 7 rmi4‘ dze — rto/ —— tram̐ ——snyo rtsa bod ljongasami dmangasadape skrun khang / | —1tsho — 4 dzo— gyu 4 rīner+yā cho 4 dzo 0 glerna stolteshā —ske— sko4smiX— ༷ ge —sde( /
༄khya/ /dam chos rdzogs pa chen po'i rnam gzhag che long tsam brjod pa mthong grol byin rlabs 'bad ba'i 'od gsa'//reb gong rdo rje mkhar gyis/bod ljongasamidamangasadaṣ+peskrun khang /

sngon 'gro'i gtam/nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs ni 'dzam gling gi chos lugs chen po gsum gyi ya gyal zhig yin zhing / 'di ni mnyam med ston pa shākya thub pa mchog gis dka' ba mtha' yas pa spyad nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa'i nyams myong rnams phyogs gcig tu dril ba las byung ba'i chos lugs thun mong ma yin pa zhig yin pas/ dad pa dang gus pa khon byed pa'i gzhi zhig min la/ chos lugs 'di'i gzhung rnams la rigs pa'i rtsal gyis zhib tu brtag cing dpyod pa'i thabs kyis nyams su len dgos pa zhig ste/ ston pa'i zhal nas kyang / dge slong dag gam mkhas rnams kyis/ / bsreg bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin du/ /legs par brtag la nga yi bka'/ /blang bar bya yi gus phyir min/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ mi su zhig yin na yang nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs la rmongs dad byed mi rung ba'i gnad de nyid mngon par mtshon zhing / nang pa'i chos lugs dang rmongs dad gnyis tha dad cing gzhi gcig gi steng du 'grogs par mi 'os pa zhig yin pa'ang gsal por bshad yod/'dzam bu'i gling 'di'i mi rnams kyi rgyud du lhan skyes rang byung gi yon tan dang / phyis skyes rtsol byung gi yon tan dang / byin rlabs bsgom byung gi — 1 —

tho'i ma'adzas rngo sa la che bsdo'i ma zha tho'iyon tan bcas yon tan chen po gsum yod cing / de las lhan skyes rang byung gi yon tan ni slob pa'am bsgom pa la sogs pa'i rtsol ba la brten mi dgos par skyes ma thag nas rang bzhin gyis shes shing rtogs pa'i yon tan de yin/ phyis skyes rtsol byung gi yon tan ni/ slob pa sogs rtsol ba la brten nas rang rang gi rgyud du 'byor ba'i yon tan de yin/ byin rlabs bsgom byung gi yon tan ni/ gang zag gcig dngos brgyud gang rung gi sgo nas 'tshang rgya ba'i thabs yang dag cing skyon med par ston pa'i gdams pa'i mchog sangs rgyas kyi bka' la thos bsam sgom gsum byed pa la brten nas byung ba'i mngon shes drug gi yon tan de yin/ yin na'ang deng sang 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams kyis rang byung gi yon tan dang rtsol byung gi yon tan ma gtogs don du gnyer bzhin med cing / byin rlabs bsgom byung gi yon tan zhig yod pa mi shes pa dang / gal srid shes pa'i dbang du byas na yang de la yid ches byed bzhin med pa ma zad/ da dung yon tan de ni dngos gnas mi'i blo ngor mi shong ba'i ngo mtshar can zhig yin pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas the tshom yang byed bzhin yod/ de yang zhib tu bsams na the tshom za dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan med cing / sngar byin rlabs bsgom byung gi yon tan rgyud du 'byor pa'i skyes chen dam pa mang po zhig byon myong ba ste/ dper na ston pa shākya thub pa dang / slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ nā ro pa/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ ma gcig lab kyi sgron ma/ mi la ras pa/ zhabs dkar tshogs drug rang grol sogs mang po zhig yod pa lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ deng sang gi mi su zhig yin na yang lhan skyes rang byung gi yon tan dang phyis skyes rtsol byung gi yon tan dag rang rang la 'brel thag nye ba'i dbang gis yid ches byed pa dang / byin — 2 —

tho〉sngo 'gro'i ga marlabasabasgom byung gi yon tan rgyud du len pa'i thabs mi shes pa dang thabs shes kyang rgyud du 'byor bar dka' zhing / spyod pa zhi zhing dul ba dang byams snying rje'i sems bcos ma min pa zhig sngon du 'gro dgos pa sogs cha rkyen mang po zhig yod pa ji bzhin bsgrub thub na rgyud du 'byor zhing ma bsgrub na rgyud du 'byor mi thub pa sogs rang nyid dang 'brele thag ring ba'i dbang gis de 'dra'i yon tan zhig yod srid dam zhes the tshom 'dzin bzhin yod/ de ltar byin rlabs bsgom byung gi yon tan de ni mi'i yon tan kun las mchog dang bla na med pa zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi phal mo ches rang rang gi rgyud du de 'dra'i yon tan khyad du 'phags pa zhig yod pa mi shes pa dang / gal srid rang rang gi rgyud du de 'dra'i yon tan yod pa shes na yang don du gnyer ba spangs te phyag mchod ngag bzlas tsam byed bzhin lto gos gtam gsum sogs 'jig rten chos brgyad don du gnyer bar brtson pas/'khor ba'i rtsa ba ma rig pa yin zhes sngon byon mkhas grub rnams kyis gsungs yod/spyir byin rlabs bsgom byung gi yon tan zhes pa ni/ rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes dang / lha'i mig gi mngon shes/ lha'i rna ba'i mngon shes/ sngon gnas rjes dran gyi mngon shes/ gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes/ zag zad mkhyen pa'i mngon shes bcas drug po de yin zhing / mngon shes drug gi yon tan de nyid rtsal du 'don pa'i thabs ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs 'di kho na nyid du zad pa dang / nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i ga zhung lugs la thos bsam sgom gsum byed pa'i las la brtson pa na byin rlabs bsgom byung gi yon tan rgyud du 'byor thub pa yin/ de yang nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs — 3 —

tho'i ma chos rngo sa la che bsgo'i ma tho'i ni byin rlabs bsgom byung gi yon tan rtsal du 'don par byed pa'i thabs yang dag par ston pa'i gdams pa rmad du byung ba zhig yin zhing / gdams pa 'di la brten na byin rlabs bsgom byung gi yon tan rang rang gi rgyud du 'byor thub mod/ 'on kyang de ni tshe gcig lus gcig gis mngon du byed thub pa zhig min par bshad/ de ltar bshad na yang byin rlabs bsgom byung gi yon tan de nyid tshe gcig lus gcig gis mngon du byed thub pa yin min de yang gtso bor yon tan de mngon du byed pa'i thabs yang dag par ston pa'i gdams pa zhig la rag las pa yin zhing / nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs kyi gdams pa yod tshad tshe gcig lus gcig la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ste byin rlabs bsgom byung gi yon tan mngon du byed thub pa'i thabs kyi gdams pa zhig min pa dang / de 'dra'i gdams pa la mjal thub payin min yang gtso bor rang rang gi las dang bsod nams la gzhan dring 'jog pa yin/ 'o na tshe gcig lus gcig gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ste byin rlabs bsgom byung gi yon tan mngon du byed pa'i gdams pa yod dam zhe na/ de 'dra'i gdams pa mchog yod de/ a ti rdzogs pa chen po bya ba 'di yin pa'i phyir/ de yang yin te/ (rdzogs pa chen po a ti zab don gyi khrid dmigs zin bris kun bzang dgongs rgyan 〉las/ 'dir ni dbus gter zug pa rtsa ba lta bu'i chos sder gtogs pa theg pa thams cad kyi snying po/bstan pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ grub mtha' thams cad kyi yang rtse/ rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal po/ lung thams cad kyi gal mdo/ man ngag thams cad kyi yang snying ngam zab cha/ theg pa thams cad kyi 'phro ba'i gzhi'am bcud bsdus pa'i snying po lta bur gyur pas na/ dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa — 4 —

༷:yi11 phar ཿni /bathams cad kyi dgongs pa dang ro gcig tu gyur pa/ rdzogs pa chen po man ngag sde'i yang rtse/ tshe gcig lus gcig gis sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid mi slob pa'i zung 'jug chen po khyab bdag gdod ma'i mgon po bcom ldan 'dasadapal kun tu bzang po'i go 'phang rin po che mngon du byed pa'i myur lam khyad par can du gyur pa a ti zab don snying po'i gdams pa zab mo 'di nyid kyi sgo nas skal ba dang ldan pa'i slob ma rnams rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa la bde myur gyi sgo nas 'khrid par byed pa'i rim pa zab mo de nyid 'chad pa'i skabs su bab pa yin zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ a ti rdzogs pa chen po zhes pa 'di ni tshe gcig lus gcig gis byin rlabs bsgom byung gi yon tan mngon du byed pa'i gdams pa dang skal ba ldan pa'i mi rnams rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'khrid pa'i myur lam mam nye lam khyad par can zhig yin pa mngon par mtshon 'dug cing / bdag gis da lta'i dus kyi mi rnams 'jig rten chos brgyad la sred cing zhen pa'i me lce 'bar ba'i stobs kyis rang gzhan gnyis ka dus gcig la bsreg pa'i sdug bsngal myong bzhin yod pa mthong zhing /nam yin yang rang rang gi lus sems ngal gso thob pa'i thabs ci yang ma rnyed par thog mar sems 'khrugs pa dang / sems 'khrug pa la brten nas lus kyi 'byung ba'i khams rnams 'khrugs pa dang / lus kyi 'byung khams 'khrug par brten nas nad rnam pa sna tshogs shig bskyed de sdug bsngal myong bzhin yod/de rnams la phan gdags pa'i slad du ṭ+wāṃrdzogs pa chen po'i zin bris mthong grolabyin rlabs 'bar ba'i 'od gsal 〉zhes bya ba 'di bris te kun gyi lus sems la ngal gso thob pa'i skyes su phul ba dang / khyed tshos 〈rdzogs pa chen po'i zin bris mthong grol byin rlabs 'bar ba'i 'od gsal 〉las bshad pa — 5 —

waṃ ma chos rdzogs la che yo'i rnam zhagawaṃltar/ thog mar bla ma bsnyen pa dang / bar du thos bsam bsgom gsum byas na/ mthar rang nyid kyis tshe 'dir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mngon dukhyed thub pa yin/ de'i phyir rdzogs pa chen po'i chos 'di ni gser gyi ri rab dang / dgos 'dod 'jo ba'i nor bu/ rmongs mun sel ba'i nyi 'od lta bu zhig yin zhing / nyin rgyun gzhung 'dir lta ba dang / klog pa dang / nyan pa dang / 'dzin pa dang / bsam pa dang / bsgom pa sogs byas na/ mthar skal ba ldan pa'i mi rnams smin cing grol ba ste byin rlabs bsgom byung gi yon tan rgyud du 'byor thub pa spyi dang khyad par du sems las che ba'i mi rnams la yid kyi ngal gso ster ba/ ci 'dod pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa la sogs pa'i phan yon dpag tu med pa zhig mchis pa'o/ / de yang dam chos rdzogs pa chen por thos bsam sgom gsum byed pa'i dmigs yul ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mngon du byed rgyu de yin zhing / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mngon du byed pa'i dmigs yul ni mar gyur sems can thams cad la phan 'dogs pa'am gzhan don bsgrub rgyu de yin la/ rang nyid kyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mngon du ma byas na mar gyur sems can thams cad kyi don byed pa'i mthu dang nus pa med pa yin/ de'i phyir grub thob snga ma rnams kyis mar gyur sems can thams cad la phan 'dogs pa'am gzhan la phan pa'i don byed pa'i ched du dka' ba shi la khad pa mang po spyad nas dam chos rdzogs pa chen por thos bsam sgom gsum byas te rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mngon du byed pa'i las la brtson pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bsten pa na/ mthar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mngon du byas nas ngo mtshar ba'i rdzu 'phrul ston pa dang / gnam la 'phur ba/ sa 'og — 6 —

0rnyan11 phar ཿni /sprutu 'dzal ba/ gzhan sems shes pa/ ma 'ongs mngon mkhyen ldan pa sogs mi ༄las mchog tu gyur pa zhig tu 'gyur srid pa dang / de 'dra'i mthu nus rdzu 'phrul ldan pa zhig tu gyur na/ da gzod mar gyur sems can thams cad la phan pa'i don chen po sgrub thub pa yin/ dper na bod kyi mi la ras pa dang /thang stong rgyal po/ klong chen rab 'byams pa/ zhabs dkar tshogs drug rang grol/ shar skal ldan rgya mtsho/ bdud 'joms rin po che/ mkhyen brtse rin po che sogs mkhas grub tshad ldan mang po byung ba lta bu yin zhing / de dag gis sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang de'i dgongs 'grel dag la thos bsam mdzad pa dang / rang rang gi bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i zhal nas gsungs pa'i gdams pa ltar sgrub pa snying por mdzad nas grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs te bya ltar dgung la 'phur ba'i grub rtags bstan myong ba dang / de rnams ni dngos med sgro btags kyi gtam zhig min par lo rgyus thog dngos su byung ba'i gnas tshul bden pa bslu ba med pa zhig yin/ las bsod che ba'i mi zhig yin na dam chos rdzogs pa chen po'i chos la 'phrad srid cing / dam chos rdzogs pa chen po'i chos la 'phrad ma thag nga la rgyu 'byor phun sum tshogs pa zhig thob par shog ces theg dman gyi rang don nyi tshe ba'i lta ba tsam gces su 'dzin pa las brgal nas theg chen gyi sems bskyed pa ste/ mar gyur sems can thams cad la phan pa'i don byed pa'i ched du nye ring chags sdang dang /rang don 'ba' zhig don du gnyer ba'i bsam pa/ sems can la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i bsam sbyor sogs mig gi rdul bzhin spangs te rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mngon du byed pa'i las la brtson par bya'o zhes dam bca' bkod nas dam chos rdzogs pa chen po'i gzhung gi gdams pa n+d+rag7 la shaṃs

dza'i mazhesas rngo sa la che /sdo'i ma dza'ibasam sgom gsum chag med rgyun chags su byas na/ mthar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mngon du byed pa'i dus shig yod srid pa dgongs 'jags zhu'o/ / mar gyur sems can thams cad la bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig mar gyur sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig mar gyur sems can thams cad sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba la reg par gyur cig mar gyur sems can thams cad nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig gu/ /rtsom pa pos/2༷06lo'i zla 4tshes 16nyin pe cin nas/

dkar chagamachod brjod/ (1)le'u dang po/ dam chosastsogs pa chen po'i byung ba che long tsam brjod pa/ (1)sa bcad dang po/ rgyal ba dgongs brgyud/ (4)sa bcad gnyis pa/ rig 'dzin brda brgyud/ (7)sa bcad gsum pa/ gang zag snyan brgyud/ (11)le'u gnyis pa/ rdzogs chen gyi mtshan don/ (18)le'u gsum pa/ rdzogs chen gyi phan yon/ (21)le'u bzhi pa/ gdams ngag gi khrid tshul/ (28)sa bcad dang po/ bla ma'i mtshan nyid/ (28)sa bcad gnyis pa/ slob ma'i mtshan nyid/ (42)sa bcad gsum pa/ gnas kyi mtshan nyid/ (53)sa bcad bzhi pa/ dus kyi mtshan nyid/ (54)sa bcad lnga pa/ yo byad kyi mtshan nyid/ (55)sa bcad drug pa/ grogs kyi mtshan nyid/ (56)le'u lnga pa/ thun mong phyi'i rdzon 'gro/ (58)sa bcad dang po/ tho rangs ldang ba'i rnal 'byor/ (58)1

sa bcad gnyis pa/ blo sbyong ba'i rim pa/ (91)dang po/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba bsam pa (92)gnyis pa/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsam pa (112)gsum pa/ las rgyu 'bras bsam pa (126)—bzhi pa/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa/ (149)lnga pa/ theg pa spyi'i rmang rdo skyabs 'gro/ (199)drug pa/ theg chen rtsa ba sems bskyed pa/ (218)bdun pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas/ (237)brgyad pa/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs thabs maṇ+ḍal/ (258)dgu pa/ byin rlabs myur 'jug bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ (273)bcu pa/ dbang blang pa/ (314)le'u drug pa/ spyor drug stan thog gcig tu nyams su len tshul/ (324)le'u bdun pa/ thun min nang gi sngon 'gro/ (334)sa bcad dang po/ rnal 'byor bskyed pa'i rim pa/ (334)dang po/ sku bskyed rim phyag rgya'i skor/ (334)gnyis pa/ gsung bzlas pa sngags kyi skor/ (343)gsum pa/ thugs 'od gsal chos nyid kyi rnal 'byor skor/ (347)sa bcad gnyis pa/ man ngag rdzogs pa'i rim pa/ (349)dngapo/ lta ba'i mthar thug khregs chod/ (349)2

gcig 'khor 'das ru shan dbye ba/ (349)gnyis/ sngon 'gro dngos kyi skor/ (359)gsum/ khregs chod kyi nyams len/ (380)1 cog bzhag gsum gyi gzhi bca' ba (380)2 gang shar rig pa rjen par bzhag pa/ (388)2 gnas 'gyu ngo bo dbyer med du ston pa/ (389)4 cir snang rang grol gyi rkyen dang bsre ba/ (389)5 gnas lugs gtan la dbab pa/ (390)6 rig pa ngo sprod pa/ (390)(1)gnas lugs lta thog nas ngo sprod pa/ (393)(2)nyams myong bsgom thog nas ngo sprod pa/ (399)7 zag med kyi ye shes mngon sum rang thog tu dbab pa/ (412)sa bcad gsum pa/ sgom pa'i snying po lhun grub thod rgal gyi gnas lugs/ (419)dang po/ 'od gsal ye shes gang la bzhugs pa'i gnas/ (422)gnyis pa/'od gsal ye shes gang la 'char ba'i lam/ (422)gsum pa/'od gsal ye shes ji ltar 'char ba'i tshul/ (422)bzhipa/ lam ji ltar bsgom pa'i tshul/ (423)le'u brgyad pa/ bar do'i skor/ (445)3

le'u dgu pa/ 'pho ba'i skor/ (505)le'u bcu pa/ rdzogs pa chen po'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi skor/ (526)sa bcad dang po/ gzhi lta bas gtan la dbab tshul/ (527)sa bcad gnyis pa/ lam bsgom pas nyams su len pa'i tshul/ (592)sa bcad gsum pa/ de gnyis kyi grogs spyod pa bstan pa (596)sa bcad bzhi pa/ mthar thug 'bras bu gtan grol gyi sa la phyin tshul/ (600)yid bzhin mdzod kyi don khrid zab don rdo rje'i snying po/ (609)4

mchod brjod/༄7/ /oṃ bde legs su gyur cig /gdod ma'i mgon po dga' rab rdo rje dang / /pad ma 'byung gnas ye shes mkha' 'gro sogs/ /rdzogs chen brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhabs/ /sgo gsum rnam par gus pas phyag 'tshal lo ngo bo rnam dag chos sku'i mkha' dbyings las/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal lhun grub longs spyod rdzogs/ / thugs rje kun khyab sprul sku'i 'gro don mdzad/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mthu stobs mi zad gnam lcags rdo rje yis/ /dgra bgegs brag ri phye mar 'thag pa'i sgras/ /gnam sa bla 'og brje ba ltar g.yo ba'i/ /bka' srung dam can rgya mtshos las kun bsgrubs/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal dkyil las/ /rdzogs chen dka' gnad cig car bkrol ba yi/ /1

macas rngo sa la che yo'i malegs bshad dri za'i rgyud du khugs pa'i glu/ /kho bo'i rna bar rgyu ba'i zlos gar sgyur/ /rim bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas lugs gzugs/ /kho bo'i rnam dpyod me long ngos shar ba'i/ /yon tan gzi 'od 'bar ba'i ngang tshul la/ /chu skyes tshogs kyang dga' bas 'dzum pa 'dra/ /smra mkhas ngag gi 'dod 'jo dbang gi rgyal/ /legs bshad 'dod dgu 'bad med stsol ba'i dpyid/ /mkhyen dpyod bde legs kun gyi za ma tog /kun mkhyen bla ma'i bka' drin ji ltar 'jal/ /sa gsum gnas su lan brgyar btsal na yang / /rlabs phreng mkha' la 'phyur ba'i chu gter klong / /rgya khab 'tshol ba ji bzhin rnyed dka' ba/ /man ngag yongs su 'dus pa'i rdzogs chen yin/ /bla ma'i drin las rdzogs chen khrid thob cing /thos bsam yon tan dud pa'i 'phrul snang gis/ /'chad pa'i rnga brdungs rtsod dus lus phra ma/ /skrag ste rdzogs ldan gos kyi rdzu la brten/ /2

mcho libaka' dang bstan bcos snying po kun 'dus pa/ /che ba bzhi ldan rdzogs pa chen po zhes/ /thar 'dod rnams kyi 'jug ngogs thun mong lam /bla ma'i gsung bzhin yi ge'i ri mor bkod/ /rgyal bas rgyal ba la ni dgongs par brgyud/ /sems dpas sems dpa' rnams la brda yis bstan/ /rig 'dzin rig 'dzin rnams la tshig gis gsungs/ /chos 'di bdag 'dras brjod par ga la rigs/ /de lta na yang myong khrid dad ldan rnams/ /smin zhing grol bar nges zhes smra na yang / /tshig don dpyod pa'i mthu bral rmongs 'thoms kyis/ /rtsa ba dor nas yal ga 'dzin pa mthong /de phyir bde ba'i grib bsil la gnas kyang / /gzhan rnams dman pa'i lam du gol dogs pas/ /brgya phrag dka' ba spyad de rdzogs chen gzhung / /brjod pa'i me tog nam mkhar khyab par thor/ /rdzogs chen zab don snyan 'gyur 'bum 'khyil bar/ / 3

macas rngo sa lache rtswagi ma tshig don rgyud mangs glu ru snyan 'khrol ba'i/ /grangs med rig pa'i zlos gar rtsen bzhin du/ /don gnyer can rnams sgra 'dzin dpyid du rgyu/ /zhes tshigs su bcad pa'i mu tig dri ma bral ba bstar la brgyus pa'i 'od snang phyogs bzhir 'phro bas sngun legs par bsus te 'o skol rnams kyi ston pa rgyal ba thabs mkhas la thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyis gdul bya sems can grangs med pa zhig gi bsam pa dang / dbang po dang / khams dang /mos pa'i khyad par dang rjes su mthun pa'i zhi ba chos kyi bdud rtsi bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bka' bstsal ba thams cad bsdu na theg pa rim dgur 'du zhing / rgyu la lam du byed pa rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang / 'bras bu la lam du byed pa 'bras bu gsang sngags kyi theg pa gnyis su yod pa las phyi ma la'ang gangs can bod kyi ljongs 'dir gsang sngags gsar rnying zhes pa'i lugs srol gnyis su grags pa las/ spyan 'dren pa po yon bdag phyag bzhes kyi gtsug lag khang / 'chad pa po paṇa chen/ sgyur byed kyi lo tsā ba/ zhu rten gyi me tog brjod bya chos kyi khyad par te che ba drug ldan gyi chos kyi sgo nas khyad du 'phags pa ni gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa rnying ma zhes bya ba 'di yin/ 'di la ma rmongs pa'i khyad par dang / thabs mang khyad par dang / dka' ba med pa'i khyad par dang / dbang po rnon po'i lam yin pa'i khyad par bcas bzhi yod par bshad cing / khyad chos de ldan gyi gsang sngags rnying ma la'ang ring brgyud bka' ma/ nye brgyud gter ma/ zab mo dag snang gi rim pa ji snyed cig mchis pa las/ 'dir zab mo gter gyi phyogs su gtogs pa de'ang shar gter smin pa 'bras bu lta bu/ lho gter 'dril ba sdong po lta bu/ nub gter 4

mcho rirjogasal ba mar me lta bu/ byang gter rgyas pa pad ma lta bu/ dbus gter zug pa rtsa ba lta bu zhes pa'i sde tshan lnga las/ 'dir ni dbus gter zug pa rtsa ba lta bu'i chos sder gtogs shing / de yang theg pa thams cad kyi snying po/ bstan pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ grub mtha' thams cad kyi yang rtse/ rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal po/ lung thams cad kyi gal mdo/ man ngag thams cad kyi yang snying /theg pa thams cad kyi 'phro gzhi ste/ dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa dang ro gcig tu gyur pa/ bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang po'i go 'phang rin po che mngon du byed pa'i myur lam khyad par can/tshegacig lus gcig gis sku bzhi ye shes lnga mngon du byed pa'i gdams nga ga zab mo rdzogs pa chen po zhes bya ba'i chos 'di/ rdza dpal sprul gyi grub gnas chos rdzong la mgo'i grub chen a khu sbyin pa zhes mtshan snyan gangs ri'i ljongs la ris med du khyab pa'i bla ma rin po che'i gsung rnams sgrub byed kyi lung du byas shing / bla mas lag len du 'khyer ba'i nyams myong ci rigs gsungs pa rnams gzhir bzhag byas pa dang / mkhas grub dam pa rnams kyi gsung gi snying bcud kyis zur brgyan pa bcas kyi thabs la brten nas don dril zhing go sla ba/ go rim gsal zhing 'dzin bde ba zhig rang mnyam skal ba dang ldan pa'i don gnyer can yod do cog gi sgra 'dzin sim pa'i dga' ston du brjod par bya'o/ / / /

le'u dang po/ dam chos dam chos rdzogs pa chen po'i byung ba che long tsam brjod pa/'dzam bu'i gling gi chos dang rig gnas gang dang gang zhig yin yang tshang mar chu 'go gangs dang chos 'go sangs rgyas zhes grags pa ltar rang rang la khungs dang / dar khyab byung ba'i rim pa/ gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus thun mong min pa zhig yod cing / de bzhin du dam chos rdzogs pa chen po zhes bya bar yang tshul ji ltar byung zhing dar rgyas su phyin pa'i lo rgyus bshad mi shes ge sar gyi sgrung lta bu zhig yod pa dang / lo rgyus de nyid rang mnyam skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la go sla ba'i tshig gi phreng ba'i lam nas sgro 'dogs skur 'debs kyi skyon phra mo tsam gyis kyang ma reg par brjod dgos te/ nyi zla kha sbyor las/ lo rgyus don gyis ma bshad na/ / gsang chen nges pa'i bka' 'di la/ / yid mi ches pa'i skyon du 'gyur/ / ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang 'gro ba yongs kyi sngon nas ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes chen po mnyam med ston pa rgyal ba shākya thub pas mkha' mnyam gyi 'gro ba yongs la chos kyi sgo mo mtha' yas pa zhig legs par phyes shing / sangs rgyas mchog gi zhal nas legs pa rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas bstsal ba'i bka' rnams tshur lam bzang 'dir ma 'dus pa yang med de/ 〈klong gsal 〉las/ ston pa thugs rje chen po yis/ / 'dul byed theg pa mang gsungs kyang / / yang gsang rdzogs 1

dza'i ma' sa cas saphab che 'tho'i ma mi'ipa chen por 'dus/ / zhes gsungs pa des mnyam med ston pa shākya thub pa'i zhal gyis gsungs pa'i theg pa thams cad kyang dam chos rdzogs pa chen po'i lam bzang du 'dus pa mngon par mtshon 'dug pa ste/ dge slong kun dga' ma'i zhal nas/ dper na chu bo chen po la/ / chuciphran thams cad 'dus pa ltar/ / theg pa rim dgu'i bstan pa yang / / rdzogs pa chen po nyid du 'dus/ / zhes kyang gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / theg pa thams cad kyi dgongs don ma lus pa'i bcud kyi snying por 'dus pa'i dam chos rdzogs pa chen po'i gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i gang zag rnams yid ches pa'i slad du thog mar chos brgyud kyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus shig brjod par 'os so/ /de yang ṭ+wāṃklong gsal 〉las/ skal ldan nges shes bskyed pa'i phyir/ /brgyud pa'i lo rgyus bshad par bya/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dam chos rdzogs pa chen po'i byung ba rang blos dpag tshod tsam zhig brjod na ni/ bdag cag gi ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa 'di nyid don dam par bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas sangs rgyas nas gang la gang 'dul gyi chos legs par bstan pa yin te/ mdo sde pad ma dkar po las/ bskal pa bye stong bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ / de yi grangs ni sus kyang bzung med par/ /byang chub dam pa 'di ni ngas rnyed de/ / ngas ni rtag tu chos kyang rab 'chad do/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bdag cag gi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thog ma med pa nas sangs rgyas shing / sangs rgyas ma thag bde mchog gi rgyud rgyas par gsungs pa dang / sems can bsod nams kyi dbang gis skabs rer dar zhing skabs rer nub par 'gyur ba yin/ gzhan yang dpal kun tu bzang po sngon nas sangs rgyas te chos gsangs pa yin zhes pa dang gong gsal gyi de 1rā/kyi ri byi

'jibe ngapha macas rngo sa ba che yo'i ngaliganyis don gcig pa yin par bshad/ de la mdo sde dang skyes rabs rnams nas byang chub tu sems bskyed cing bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags nas sangs rgyas par gsungs pa ni don la gdul bya sems can rnams drang don du de lta bu'i tshul bstan nas chos 'khor bskor ba yin zhing /ma 'ongs pa na yang da lta ba'i mdzad pa yang yang ston par gsungs te/ yab sras mjal ba'i mdo las/ dpa' bo chen po thabs mkhas che/ / sems can yongs su smin mdzad phyir/ / bye ba phrag brgyar rgyal ba nyid/ / sangs rgyas nyid du bstan gyur kyang / / da dung yang ni 'dren pa khyod/ / sangs rgyas mang por ston par mdzad/ / ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ ston pa thugs rje can gyis sems can la gang 'dul gyi chos ji ltar bstan pa yin zhe na/ thog mar chos sku'i dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin du dpal kun tu bzang po'i skur bzhengs nas bka' rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud sde dang yo ga rnams gsungs pa ni chos sku'i bstan pa yin/ longs sku rnam par snang mdzad sogs su bzhengs nas kṛ yog sde gsum gsungs pa ni longs sku'i bstan pa yin/ de rnams ni bskal pa yang yang dar la yar dar ba dang / mi yul du nub kyang lha dang gnod sbyin dang ḍāk+ki'i yul du dar zhing / de dag gi ston pa ni gcig tu sprul sku phyag na rdo rje yin pas/ mya ngan las 'da' ba yang med la/ bcom ldan 'das mchog gi sprul sku'i tshal gyis sde snod gsum gsungs pa ni/ bskal pa yang yang dar dus ༄mi 'byon la/ ston pa yang mya ngan 'da' tshul ston/ chos kyang bstan pa'i gnas tshad rdzogs nas nub par gsungs/ de yang 'dir 'chad par bya ba ni/chos sku'i bstan pa theg pa dgu'i yang rtse bka' rdzogs pa chen po yin te/nyan thos rang rgyal byang sems gsum/ / gang zag dbang po dmakā la

dza〉 ma' sa rdzo sa sda che bsgo'i ma gatho'idagongs/ /kri ya u pa yo ga gsum/ / gang zag dbang po 'bring la dgongs/ /ma hā a nu a ti gsum/ / gang zag dbang po rab la dgongs/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyer na/ theg pa 'og ma 'og ma rnams ni theg pa gong ma gong ma'i lam stegs yin te/ ji ltar skas kyi rim pa bzhin/ / theg pa'i don du bstan pa dang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar go nas gsung rab thams cad gdams ngag tu 'char bar byed dgos so/ /sa bcad dang po/ rgyal ba dgongs brgyud/rgyal ba dgongs brgyud ces pa ni/ ston pa bla na med pa de nyid kyi rang rtsal ye shes rol ba'i 'khor tshogs rnams la rdzogs pa chen po sgra tshig bya rtsol las 'das pa de kho na nyid kyi nges don brjod med don gyi sgo nas gsungs pa ni rgyal ba nyid la rgyal nyid kyis brgyud pa yin pas na de skad du brjod cing /de yang ye thog dang po sangs rgyas dang sems can ris su ma phye ba'am/dpal kun tu bzang po 'khrul ma myong bar gdod ma'i dbyings su mngon par sangs rgyas nas sku dang ye shes 'du bral med par bzhugs te/ 〈sbyong rgyud 〉las/ sangs rgyas kun las sngar sangs rgyas/ / zhes dang / bla ma med pa'i gong rol na/ / sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po yod/ / ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / der sems can rnams kyi rang ngo ma shes par 'khrul te 'khor bar 'khyams pas/ dpal kun tu bzang po chos sku stong ba'i ngang la gzugs kyi skur bzhengs shing / sprul pa'i 'khor zhi khro rab 'byams rnams la bka' rdzogs pa chen po'i chos sras gcig sa bon gyi rgyud la sogs pa grags stong brjod pa dang bral bar dgongs pa'i byin gyis brlabs pa dang / kun tu 4

dza'ibe jayo macas rngo sa sda che yoji jalibazang po des ye shes lnga'i snang cha las dag pa'i zhing khams rgyal ba rigs lnga 'khor tshom bu dang bcas pa byung ste/ 'khor rnams la dgongs pa brjod du med par chos ston par mdzad/ rigs lnga de las phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams tshad med grangs med pa rnams su/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug sems dpa' rnams la rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor dpag tu med par snang bas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa dang / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten grangs med pa na 'gro ba rigs drug so so'i thub pa drug tu sprul nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad par grags/ de yang 'gro ba'i don mdzad tshul ni rdo rje ljags kyis kyang brjod par dka' ba yin la/re zhig mi mjed 'dir sprul pa rim par 'phro tshul ni/ dang po byin rlabs mchog gi sprul pa gsum ste/ rin po che brgya rtsa gcig las grub pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku dang / rab byung bstan pa bu gcig pa'i rgyud dang / chos nyid kyi rdo rje chag gang ba rnams gzhom gzhig dang bral bar bstan pa'i btsas su bzhugs so/ / de dag gis sems can gyi don rgya chen po byed cing / de nas ye thog dang por sangs rgyas mngon 'phags dran pa mgon zhes bya ba byon nas rdzogs chen gsungs pas 'khor khrag khrig bdun cu sangs rgyas pa nas bzung ste/ bskal pa rtsod ldan zhes bya bar sangs rgyas grags pa zad pa'i 'jig rten mgon zhes bya ba byon nas rdzogs pa chen po gsungs pas 'khor bcu phrag dgu sangs rgyas pa yan gyi sangs rgyas bskal pa'i mgon po drug cu rtsa lnga byon pa rnams kyis rdzogs pa chen po gsungs par brten nas sems can grangs med la tshad kyang med pa zhig mngon par sangs rgyas par grags so/ /de yang zhing 'dir bskal pa dang por dga' ldan brtsegs zhes bya ba na/sprul pa rdo rje 'chang chen po pad ma'i steng du rang byung du byon zhing / rdo rje 5

tho'i mazhe sa rngo saphabazhe phari ma 'jisems dpa' dang phyag na rdo rje la rdzogs pa chen po dgongs pas byin gyis brlabs pa dang / de nas rdo rje 'chang de nyid khye'u snang ba dam pa bsam gyis mi khyab par sprul nas 'khor bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong la sgra thal 'gyur sogs rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud bcu bdun gsungs so/ /de nas gnas mi mjed 'jig rten du ston pa 'od mi 'khrug pa dang /gnas 'od kyi phung por ston pa 'jigs pa skyob pa dang / gnas chags 'byung mngal du snang bar ston pa gzhon nu rol ba'i rnam par brtse ba dang / gnas 'tsho byed gzhon nu'i sdum rar ston pa rdo rje 'chang dang / gsang sngags rol ba'i dur khrod du ston pa gzhon nu dpal po stobs ldan dang / gnas srin po ru la'i sgra ldan par drang srong khros pa'i rgyal po dang / bya rgod phung por ston pa gser 'od dam pa dang / sog po g.yu smin gyi gnas su ston pa brtse bas rol ba'i blo gros/ bya rgod phung por ston pa 'od srung bgres po dang / rdo rje gdan du mngon rdzogs rgyal po dang / ser skya'i gnas su ston pa shākya thub pa byon pa yin no/ /de yang ston pa longs sku'i cha lugs su bzhugs pa rnams kyis gsang sngags bla med spyi dang khyad par du rdzogs pa chen po kho na rgya cher gsungs shing /sprul sku'i cha lugs can rnams kyis dngos su gdul bya thun mong pa la sde snod gsum gsungs pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i gdul bya rnams la he ru ka la sogs pa'i skur bzhengs nas gsang sngags bla med dang rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud gzhung gsungs pa yin/ theg pa thun mong pa'i mdo sde rnams la ston pa gzhan de rnams ma grags pa yang sde snod gsum sogs ma gsungs pas ma bgrang ba yin zhing / de la ston pa bcu gnyis nas ma 'ongs byams pa dang /6

'jile 'pha macas rngo sa la che yo'i ngaride nas mos pa'i bar gyi sangs rgyas stong po thams cad ni ngo bo kun tu bzang po nyid yin pa la/ dgongs pa chos nyid las mi g.yo bar rim pa ltar byon pas/ rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa zhes su grags so/ /sa bcad gnyis pa/ rig 'dzin brda brgyud/de yang rig 'dzin brda yi brgyud pa zhes pa ni/ brda don tsam bstan pa las rig 'dzin rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyis chos nyid kyi don phyin ci ma log par rtogs pas na de skad du brjod cing / de yang dpal kun tu bzang po'i 'od zer las sangs rgyas bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis su shar zhing / sku gsung thugs kyi 'od zer bye ba phrag re re la rigs gsum mgon por sprul nas sprul pa 'jig rten khyab par bkye ste chos ston par mdzad do/ / rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga na rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis lha dang drang srong rnams la chos ston bzhin bzhugs shing / lho phyogs ri bo gru 'dzin gyi rtse na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis dri za dang lha klu rnams la chos ston bzhin bzhugs pa dang /byang phyogs lcang lo can na gsang ba'i bdag pos gnod sbyin dang rig 'dzin rnams la chos ston bzhin bzhugs pa dang / nub phyogs o rgyan goñja'i gtsug lag khang na rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas ḍāk+ki dang zhing skyong rnams la chos ston bzhin bzhugs pa dang / yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas chen rnams su dpa' bo dang ḍāk+ki nyi shu rtsa bzhis sha za dang zhing skyong rnams la chos ston bzhin bzhugasan yang grub pa thob pa ma gtogs phal pa'i mi'i 'dren byed kyi spyod yul du 'gyur thub pa zhig min par grags so/ /de nas dpal kun tu bzang po'i sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa rik+ṇis

tho'i ma chos rngo sa la che bsgo'i ma tho'igasum mgon po mchog gis bka' rdzogs pa chen po gsungs pas 'khor rig 'dzin 'bum phrag lnga sangs rgyas par gyur cing / 'dzam bu'i gling du li tsā byi dri ma med par grags pa la bka' rdzogs pa chen po gsungs pas 'khor 'bum phrag gcig sangs rgyas par bshad do/ /de nas spyan ras gzigs 'og phyogs rgya mtsho'i gting du byon nas klu'i rgyal po 'jog po la bka' rdzogs pa chen po gsungs pas 'khor lnga brgya sangs rgyas par gyur cing / de nas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir byon nas o rgyan yul dang / rgya gar dang / sing gha la dang / kha che dang / li yul dang / sā la'i yul dang / bod yul te thugs rje chen po'i zhing khams bdun du sprul pa'i rgyal po bdun la bka' rdzogs pa chen po'i chos gsungs pas sprul pa'i rig 'dzin 'bum phrag gcig sangs rgyas pa dang / phyag na rdo rjes ri rab kyi byang phyogs su gnod sbyin skar mda' gdong la bka' rdzogs pa chen po gsungs pas 'khor 'bum phrag brgyad sangs rgyas so/ /de yang gsang sngags rdzogs pa chen po mi yul du byon tshul ni/ theg chen gyi mdo phal cher dang gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde rnams lha yul dang mkha' 'gro'i phyag tu bzhugs shing / sangs rgyas 'das nas lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad na/ ri bo me ri 'bar ba'i rtse mor dam pa'i rigs can lnga 'dus nas gdung tshig nyi shu rtsa gcig gis gsang bdag la gsol ba btab pas/ phyag na rdo rjes byin gyis brlabs te sa gzhi gser du snang ba dang / me tog gi char 'bebs pa sogs ltas bzang po dang bcas rgyal po dza'i pho brang du gsang sngags rgyud sde mang po dang / shrī na len+d+ra'i gtsug lag khang du mtshan nyid sde gsum/ wa ra ṇa sir kṛ ya'i sde/ ri bo me ri 'bar ba'i rtser yo ga'i rgyud sde/ rgyal po dza'i khang steng du 8

'jile ngawo ma chos rngogs pa che pha'i ngaldam hā yo ga siṅgā la'i nags tshal du a nu yo ga o rgyan dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling du a ti yo ga'i rgyud sde rnams babs pas na/ mdo rgyud phal cher gnam chos kho na yin par grags so/ /khyad par du o rgyan thor cog can gyi yul du byis pa lo brgyad pa gcig gis rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal gzigs te rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud sde 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi dngos su gsan te thugs su chud nas paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgya dang rtsod pa byas kyang ma thub ste/ paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyis phyag 'tshal zhing sangs rgyas kyi sprul par thag chod cing / rgyal po dga' bas mtshan dga' rab rdo rje btags pa dang / des rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud sde thams cad yi ger bkod pa dang /nam mkha'i sprin gseb tu 'byon pa sogs rdzu 'phrul bstan nas mi dang ḍāk+ki rnams la bka' rdzogs pa chen po'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te 'khor 'bum phrag gsum sangs rgyas so/ / de'i tshe paṇ+ḍi ta 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la 'jam dpal gyis lung bstan te/ slob dpon dga' rab rdo rje dang mjal nas rdzogs pa chen po'i chos thams cad gsan zhing / khong gis rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi la sems sde man ngag gi sde gsum du byas nas bka' gter snyan brgyud gsum du byas te dar bar mdzad pa dang / der 'khor 'bum phrag bdun dang bcas pa sangs rgyas so/ /de'i tshe rgya nag gi mkhas pa shrī sing ha la spyan ras gzigs kyis lung bstan nas sa la khru gang ma reg par byon pas zhag dgu nas rgya gar dur khrod so sa gling du phebs shing / slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang mjal nas rdzogs pa chen po'i chos gsan pa dang / rdo rje gdan nas gter yang bton nas rgya gar du dar bar mdzad de 'khor 'bum phrag bdun dang bcas 9

'ji mazhe sa jo saphab che yori ma 'ji pa sangs rgyas so/ /des rgya gar nub phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta bi ma lā mi tra dang / rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta ye shes mdo gnyis la rdo rje sems dpas lung bstan nas shrī sing ha dang mjal du byon zhing / o rgyan rin po che yang byon pa dang / khong rnam pa gsum gyis rdzogs pa chen po'i chos rnams rdzogs par gsan nas bi ma la mi tra 'khor drug 'bum dang bcas pa sangs rgyas so/ /de nas o rgyan rin po che 'og min du byon nas kun tu bzang po las rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud sde dpag tu med pa gsan zhing / bkod pa lhun grub tu kun tu bzang po la spyi ti yo ga'i rgyud sde dpag tu med par gsan pa dang /mkha'asbyod rig 'dzin gyi gnas su mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes la dbang rnams zhus so/ / brag phug mā ra ti kar sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas zhal gzigs te thugs rje chen po lta ba yang thog gi rgyud sogs rdzogs chen dang 'brel ba'i rgyud gdams ngag mang du gnang zhing / o rgyan rin po ches bka' rdzogs pa chen po gsungs pa dang / thog mar 'khor 'bum phrag bcu gsum mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa yin la/ de'i yan chad rig 'dzin brda'i brgyud pa yin no/ /de nas sprul pa'i rig 'dzin thams cad bka' bgros nas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir gdul bya thabs kyi chos bye ba drug 'bum byin gyis brlabs te bzhag cing / grol byed 'bras bu chos bdun 'bum nyi khri bka' bsgos te bzhag pa dang / zab mo reg grol gyi chos sa ya drug 'bum gter du sbas/snyan brgyud thos grol gyi chos 'bum phrag gcig dang sum stong gab sbas su bzhag ste ma 'ongs pa'i sems can dbang po rab rnams grol byed 'bras bu 10

dza'ime cayo macas rngo sarica la'i ngalichos la spyod pa shes pa thams cad dang / reg grol gter dang 'phrad pa thams cad/ thos grol snyan brgyud 'chang ba thams cad skye ba re res phyir mi ldog pa'i yang dag par rdzogs te sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro/ / phyi ma'i dus na de ltar sangs rgyas pa'i gang zag 'dzam bu'i gling du nam mkha'i skar ma tsam 'byung ngo zhes lung bstan pa spyi dang khyad par du tshe lo drug cu kha ral nas bzung ste tshe lo bcu pa la thug gi bar 'dir rdzogs pa chen po thugs kyi bstan pa'i dus yin pas/ yid sgrib rang bzhin gyis dag cing rdzogs chen bsgoms pas nyams dang rtogs pa 'khrungs sla ba yin no zhes sgra thal 'gyur sogs rgyud gzhung rnam dag tshad ldan rnams nas gsungs so/ /sa bcad gsum pa/ gang zag snyan brgyud/gang zag snyan khungs brgyud pa zhes pa ni/ chos nyid rdzogs pa chen po'i don thugs kyi za ma tog tu gtams par gyur pa'i bum pa las drangs shing ljags kyi pad+ma 'dab brgyad las thon pa'i don snyan gyi bu ga shin tu srab pa nas rim par brgyud pa'i bka' gsang rdzogs pa ched po zhes yongs su grags pa'i bstan pa'i snying po 'di nyid nyag gcig gi brgyud pa zam ma chad par snyan nas snyan du brgyud pas na de skad du brjod cing / de yang rje btsun 'jam dbyangasakyi sprul pa rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi sku ring la/ o rgyan rin po che dusagasum mkhyen pa dang paṇa chen bi ma la mi tra gnyis gangs ri phreng bas mtshan pa'i bod yul du phebs nas mdo sngags kyi bstan pa mkha' la nyi ma shar ba ltar mdzad cing / khyad par du paṇa chen bi ma las myang ban ting 'dzin bzang po dang slob dpon be+e ro tsā na sogs la rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud bcu 11

waṃ ma chos rdzogs pa che yo'i mgazhagawaṃbadun sogs gnang pa las brgyud pa la bī ma la'i snying thig dang be+e ro'i snying thig sogs su grags shing / de dag gi rgyud las rdzogs chen bka' ma dar ba dang / gsang skor sogs bka' gter zung 'jug kyang dar bas grub thob pho mo nam mkha'i skar tshogs kyi grangs la 'gran nus pa zhig byung ngo / /gter chos smon lam gyi brgyud pa ni/ dus gsum mkhyen pa o rgyan rin po che'i zhal nas gsungs pa'i chos rnams ma 'ongs gdul bya'i don du yi ger bkod nas gter kha bye ba trem bod du sbas pa las gu ru chos dbang gis bla rdzogs thugs gsum/ sangs rgyas gling pas dgongs 'dus kyi rdzogs chen/las 'brel rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i snying thig rat+na gling pas klong gsal snying thig sangs rgyas gling pas rdo rje sems dpa'i snying thig rin chen gling pas rdzogs chen gcig chod kun grol/ pad ma gling pas rig pa rang shar sogs rgyud pa mang po zhig dang / chos rgyal gter bdag gling pas rdzogs chen a ti zab don/ rig 'dzin rgod ldem can gyis rdzogs chen dgongs pa zang thal sogasagater kha nas rdzogs pa chen po'i chos skor dpag tu med pa bton pa rnams ni gter chos smon lam gyi brgyud pa yin no/ /mkha' 'gro'i gtad rgya'i brgyud pa ni/ lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug la mkha' 'gro ma'i rdzogs pa chen po'i po ti bdun brag me long 'dra ba nas bton nas gtad cing / mnga' bdag nyang la ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis shog ser stag sgro gang gtad pa dang / mkhas grume klong chen rab 'byams pa dri med 'od zer gyi mnal lam du mkha' 'gros gser gyi dbu brgyan bskon zhing byin gyis brlabs pas rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud man ngag thams cad la mkhas par gyur to/ / de ltar ye shes kyi ḍāk+ki dang chos bdag mkha' 'gros dngos sam nyams 12

tho'ile ngapha mazhesas rngo sa la che yo'i ngalidang rmi lam du lung bstan zhing gnang ba byin pa ni mkha' 'gro gtad rgya'i brgyud pa yin no/ /bka' babs don gyi brgyud pa ni/ bla ma mtshan ldan la nyams khrid zhus pa'am/ mtshan thos pa tsam mam yang na rmi lam du byin gyis brlabs pa sogs gang rung zhig la brten nas nyams rtogs khyad par can rgyud la skyes te chos de'i sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po 'grub pa yang yin la/ yang gter chos rnams ni chos bdag tu lung bstan gsal ba de yin zhing / rje rol pa'i rdo rjes bi ma la mi tra zhal gzigs pa nyid kyi mdzod spur thim pas rdzogs pa chen po'i rtogs pa khyad par can 'khrungs nas mgur bzhengs pa dang /rdzogs chen gyi bstan bcos mdzad pa lta bu rnams bka' babs don gyi brgyud pa yin no/ /gong smos kyi brgyud pa de rnams las dper na seng ge rgod kyi phru gu bzhin du gcig las gcig lhag pa'i mkhas grub kyi bla ma mang po rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du rim pa ltar byon tshul rnams bka' brgyad la sogs pa'i zab chos rnams kyi thog ma'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi nang ltar yin zhing / brgyud pa de dag las byung ba'i bka' gter gyi gdams pa zab mo rnams nyams su blangs pas/sngar bod btsan po'i dus skabs su rje 'bangs nyer lnga la sogs pa'i tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas pa dang 'chi khar bar dor grol ba mtha' yas pa byung ste/ pad ma bka' thang las/ nam mkha'i snying po nyi ma'i zer la bcibs/ /sangs rgyas ye shes brag la phur ba 'debs/ / rgyal ba mchog dbyangs rta skad thengs gsum thon/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nam mkha'i snying po dang /sangs rgyas ye shes/ rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ mkhar chen mtsho rgyal/ dpal 13

'ji mthe sa rngo saphab che 'tho'i ma tho'igyi ye shes/ dpal gyi seng ge be+e ro tsā na/ mnga' bdag rgyal po/ g.yu sgra snying po/ snyo na ku ma ra/ rdo rje bdud 'joms/ ye shes dbyangs/ sog po lha dpal/ sna nam ye shes/ dpal gyi dbang phyug ldan ma rtse mang / ska ba dpal brtsegs/ shud bu dpal seng / rgyal ba'i blo gros/ khye'u chung lo/dran pa nam mkha'/ 'o bran dbang phyug rma thog rin chen/ dpal gyi rdo rje/lang 'gro dkon mchog rgyal byang chub sogs tshad ldan mkhas grub mang po zhig byon zhes gsungs pa'i phyir te/ kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pa'i zhal nas/ bstan pa snga dar gyi dus na/ bsam yas mchims phur grub chen nyi shu rtsa lnga/ lha sa dang yel par grub chen brgya rtsa/ lho brag mkhar chur nyi shu cirtsa gcig dpal chen chu bo rir sum cu rtsa lnga sogs byon pa rnams kyis rdo rje glu dang mgur bzhengs pa bsam gyis mi khyab ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ gong gsal gyi lo rgyus 'di dag gis spyir tshe gcig lus gcig la 'tshang rgya ba ni rgya mtsho lag pa'i 'khyor bar bskyil ba dang / nam mkha' mig gi rgyal mor btsud pa/ lhun po mthe bong rtse mos 'degs pa ji bzhin shin tu dka' zhing bsam pa'i yul las ring nas 'das pa zhig yin zhing / de yang thabs bzang zhing gdams pa zab mo gnad thog tu 'khel ba zhig yod na tshe gcig lus gcig la 'tshang rgya thub pa ste/ blo dang brtson 'grus rab rnams ni tshe 'dir 'tshang rgya ba dang / blo dang brtson 'grus 'bring rnams ni bar dor 'tshang rgya ba/ blo dang brtson 'grus tha ma rnams ni rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing du 'tshang rgya ba yin par gsungs pa'i phyir/ de 'dra'i khyad du 'phags pa'i chos ni rdzogs pa chen po 'di yin pas/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi lus can rnams kyis rdzogs pa chen po'i chos la thos bsam sgom gsum byed pa'i las la brtson pa srog bsdos kyis byas 14

dza'ile nga po ma chos rngogs pa che yo'i ngawān tshe 'dir dang / yang na bar dor dang rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing gang rung zhig tu 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba ni the tshom med pa zhig yin/ de'i phyir thog mar rdzogs pa chen po byung ba dang dar rgyas phyin pa'i lo rgyus la blo goms pa zhig ci nas kyang yin dgos so/ /'dir bod du rdzogs chen dar ba'i lo rgyus mdo tsam brjod na ni/gsang sngags rnying ma'i chos kyi snying po man ngag rdzogs pa chen po zhes pa 'di la nang gses kyis phye na sems sde/ klong sde/ man ngag gi sde bcas gsum yod/ de las sems sde la ma bu bsdoms pa'i bco brgyad yod cing / de las lnga ni lo chen be+e ro tsā na dang / gsum ni paṇa chen bi ma la las brgyud pa yin pa dang / rdzogs pa chen po sems phyogs su grags pa ni/ lo chen be+e ro tsā na dang g.yu sgra snying po gnyis la gnyags dzha na ku ma ras zhus/ khong la bka' yi chu bo chen po bzhi 'dus shing slob ma'i mchog bcu la sogs pa byung nas sog po sangs rgyas ye shes sogs la brgyud nas byung ba yin/ yang lo chen be+e ro tsā na'i slob ma spangs sangs rgyas mgon pos rba rak+ṣi ta la gsungs/ des ya zi dar ma shes rab sogs la brgyud pa dang / yang be+e ro tsā nas jo mo sgre mo la gsungs pa sogs brgyud pa mi 'dra ba yod/ 'di'i lta grub ni/ rang byung gi ye shes chos nyid kun tu bzang po'i klong du chos can gyi snang ba thams cad rang snang bkod pa'i rgyan tsam las 'ching grol dang / shar bya shar byed du ma grub pas/ yod med dang / yin min gang du'ang mi dpyod par ye grol phyogs 'byams chen por gtan la 'bebs pa de yin/ klong sde ste rdzogs pa chenapo klong sde ni/ paṇa chen bi ma la las byung zhing / des 〈dpal nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud 〉kyi don klong dgus bstan pa dang / ye shes 15

dza'i ma chos rngogs la che 'asgo'i ma zhaga'akho gsang ba la sogs pa'i rgyud la brten nas rdo rje zam pa'i man ngag rnams be+e ro tsā nas dpang mi pham mgon po la gsungs pa rnams rim gyis 'dzeng dharma bo dhi sogs nas brgyud pa las dar bar mdzad/ 'di'i lta grub ni/ sems nyid rang byung gi ye shes kyis 'khor 'das kun la khyab kyang / snang ba dngos por rgya ma chad/ stong ba dngos med du rgya ma chad/ gnyis ka ma yin pa zung 'jug gi phyogs su'ang ma lhung la/ ngo bo stong pas rtag pa'i mtha' las grol zhing /rang rtsal ma 'gag pas chad pa'i mtha' las grol bas bya bral bde sdug las 'das pa'i lta ba gtan la 'bebs par byed pa de yin/ man ngag sde ni snying thig gi skor rnams yin te/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas nas brgyud pa'i man ngag mkha' 'gro snying tig dang paṇa chen bi ma la mi tra nas brgyud pa'i bi ma snying tig sogs yin zhing / 'di'i lta grub ni/ 'khor 'das spang blang dang bral zhing re dogs phyogs lhung las brgal nas blo dang yid dpyod las 'das pa'i chos nyid de/ gzhi dbyings ka dag mkhregs chod dang / lam snang lhun grub thod rgal bsgoms pas blo 'das rang byung gi ye shes skad cig la 'char bar byed pa de yin/ yang de las zab pa'i rdzogs pa chen po snying tig ni paṇa chen bi ma la mi tra sngar bod du byon skabs rgyal po khri srong lde btsan dang myang ting 'dzin bzang po gnyis la gsungs shing / myang ting 'dzin bzang pos dbu ru 'bri gung zhwa yi lha khang du gter du sbas nas/ chig brgyud kyi man ngag rnams 'brom rin chen 'bar la gsungs pa las rim par brgyud nas lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug bar du byung / des gdams ngag rnams gter kha gsum du sbas pa las/ rong snar mda'i lce sgom nag po dang / mal dro 'chad pa stag gi shangs pa ras pa/ yar 'brog g.yu mtsho'i 'gram du 'khrungs pa'i 16

dza〉le nga po ma chos rdzogs pa che po'i ngawāzhang bkra shis rdo rje rnams kyis gter nas bton te/ man ngag rnams rim bzhin kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i bar du byung / kun mkhyen klong chen pas rdzogs pa chen po snying tig gi chos skor rnams gzhung dang man ngag gang ci'i thad nas dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pas bod yongs su klong chen snying thig ces grags pa 'di byung / yang mkha' 'gro'i snying tig ni/ slob dpon dga' rab rdo rje nas rig 'dzin shrī sing ha la gnang / de la slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis gsan nas bod du mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal la gnang /des gter du sbas pa rnams gter ston pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis gter nas bton te rgyal sras legs pa rgyal mtshan sogs nas rim par brgyud de dar zhing rgyas pa yin zhes rgya cher gsungs pa rnams 'dir bkod nas rdzogs chen gyi byung ba mdo tsam brjod pa re zhig rdzogs so/ / / /17

le'u gnyis pa/ rdzogs chen gyi mtshan don/'dir rgya mtsho las gting zab cing kun gsal las rgya che ba'i chos phun sum tshogs pa 'od gsal rdo rje'i snying po'i lam bzang / 'das pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gshegs shul/ ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsgrub bya/ da lta ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam bzang / tshe gcig lus gcig gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mngon du byed pa'i myur lam khyad par can/ theg pa thams cad kyi yang snying bla na med pa a ti rdzogs pa chen po zhes bya ba'i mtshan don ci zhig yin zhe na/ rig 'dzin 'jigs med rdo rje lags kyis mdzad pa'i 〈'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i thun mong lam sbyong gi rim pa 'og min bgrod pa'i bde lam 〉las/ bka' dang bstan bcos snying po kun 'dus pa/ / che ba bzhi ldan rdzogs pa chen po zhes/ /zhes gsungs te/ rdzogs pa chen po zhes bya ba ni/ rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos mtha' dag gi snying po kun 'dus shing / che ba bzhi dang ldan pa zhig la go dgos pa mngon sum nyid du bstan/ yang 〈rgya bod tshig mdzod chen mo 〉las/ rdzogs pa chen po zhes pa ni/ sems kyi rang bzhin la ngo bo stong ba chos sku/ rang bzhin gsal ba longs sku/ thugs rje kun khyab sprul sku ste sku gsum gyi yon tan thams cad lhun gyis grub pas na rdzogs pa dang / de ni chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs yin pas na chen po zhes bya'o/ /18

dza'ile nyis pa jogs che gyi mtshazhes dang / yang rig 'dzin 'jigs med rdo rjes mdzad pa'i 〈'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lam la ji ltar sbyangs pa'i rim pa mkha' spyod bsgrod pa'i myur lam 〉las/ de ni sgyu lus dang ni 'od gsal rnams/ / mngon sum bsgrub pa'i gdams ngag sna tshogs pa/ / phyogs gcig bsdus pa'i chos la rdzogs chen brjod/ / ces dang / dbus ba mkha' 'gro mas mdzad pa'i 〈snang sbyang dbus 'grel 〉las/ 'khor ba'i chos phung po khams dang skye mched rnams rdzogs pas gzhi rdzogs pa/ theg pa'i rnam grangs lam gyi 'jug ngogs 'bras bu'i 'thob bya bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams rdzogs pas lam rdzogs pa/ sku dang ye shes la sogs 'bras bu'i nyer lnga'i bdag nyid chen por ye nas bzhugs pas na 'bras bu rdzogs pa ste/ mdor na lam theg pa rim pa dgu'i 'bras bu'i cha dang bcas pa rdzogs pas na rdzogs pa/ theg pa thams cad mdo gcig tu bsdus/ don gcig tu 'dus/ snying po gcig tu dril ba'i bdag nyid yin pas na chen po/ zhes dang / rdzong sngon pad ma thugs mchog rdo rjes mdzad pa'i 〈rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying thig gi sngon 'gro'i ngag 'don khrigs su bsdebs pa rnam mkhyen lam bzang gi 'bru 'grel 'dod 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba 〉las/ dang po mtshan don ni/ rdzogs pa chen po zhes pas gzhi bde gshegs snying po bstan/ de yang rang gi sems nyid gdod nas dag zin pa bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po can 'di la 'khor 'das lam gsum gyi yon tan thams cad rdzogs pas na rdzogs pa ste/ 〈kun byed 〉las/ gcig rdzogs gnyis rdzogs sems la rdzogs/ / kun rdzogs byang chub sems su rdzogs/ /zhes so/ /chen po zhes rig stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes 'di la/ spangs pa chen po/ rtogs pa chen po/ phrin las chen po gsum 19

dzaji ma chos rdzogs pa che pha'i ma zhagadza'ilhun gyis grub pa'i tshul bstan pa yin la/ zhes gsungs pa dang / de rnams kyis rang rang gi bzhed pa ltar rdzogs chen zhes pa'i mtshan don gsal zhing yang dag pa zhig bstan yod pa smos ci dgos/ de lta na yang rdzogs chen zhes pa ni/ don du na snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad sems nyid kyi dbyings su rdzogs pas na rdzogs pa dang / rig stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes la spangs pa chen po dang / rtogs pa chen po dang / phrin las chen po gsum lhun gyis grub pas na chen po zhes brjod par sems shing /de'i don dam la bltos te thams cad sems kyis btags pa'i rnam 'gyur tsam yin pa dang / kun rdzob la bltos te sems kyis bzos pa'i snod bcud kyi snang ba thams cad gzhi las gol ba'i ma rtogs 'khrul ba'i rnam 'gyur du yod pas na/ chos thams cad sems kyis bzos pa'i snang ba dang / sems nyid skye 'gag med pa gzhi med rtsa bral du 'dug pa'i don du snang ngo / / rdzogs chen gyi mtshan don brjod pa re zhig rdzogs so / / / /20

le'u gsum pa/ rdzogs chen gyi phan yon/de yang 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams kyis thun mong dang thun min gyi rig pa'iganas kun la brtson pas sbyangs pa ni phan yon zhig 'thob pa'i ched du yin gyi/ sos dal du sdod par skyo nas dmigs yul gang yang med par dka' ba spyad nas slob gnyer byung rgyal du byed pa zhig gtan nas min/ de bzhin du theg pa thams cad kyi snying po/ bstan pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ grub mtha' thams cad kyi yang rtse/ rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal po/ lung thams cad kyi gal mdo/ man ngag thams cad kyi yang snying / theg pa thams cad kyi bcud bsdus/ dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa dang ro gcig tu gyur pa/ tshe gcig lus gcig gis sku bzhi ye shezlo ༄'a bdag nyid mi slob pa'i zung 'jug chen po khyab bdag gdod ma'i mgon po bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang po'i go 'phang rin po che mngon du byed pa'i myur lam khyad par can a ti rdzogs pa chen po 'chad pa dang / nyan pa/ sgom pa/klog pa sogs byed pa la'ang phan yon smra bsam brjod pa'i yul las 'das pa zhig yod de/ ji skad du/ de yang thog mar lam zab mo cha tshang ba gdams pa'i rgyal po 'di la/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas nyams su blang bar byar yod pa ni/ 'phral yun gyi don rgya chen po 'grub pa yin te/ zhes dang /mnyam med jo bo rje'i zhal nas/ phan btags pa thams cad kyi mchog blo chos 21

dza'i ma chos rngo sa sda che 'asgo'i maphan tswa'il bsgyur pa de yin/ zhes dang / 〈mdo 〉las/ skye bo mang po dga' ba dang /chos srung rnams kyis bsrung ba dang / lha rnams kyis bstod pa dang / mi ma yin gyis mi brdzi ba dang / phyogs bcur snyan par grags pa dang / shes rab spobs pa mi zad pa dang / bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro/ / zhes 'od gsalardzogs pa chen po'i chos 'chad pa dang / nyan pa dang / sgom pa dang /klog pa dang / 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i phan yon rnams cung zad kha gsal zhing don dril ba zhig gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i chos sam gdams pa zab mo 'di 'chad pa dang / nyan pa dang / sgom pa dang / klog pa dang / 'dzin pa sogs byed pa'i skal ba dang ldan par 'gyur ba lta zhog tha na gdams pa 'di nyid kyi mtshan thos pa la yang skye ba mang por legs par spyad pa du ma zhig dgos par gsungs te/ ji skad du/ rigs kyi bu gang gis 'das pa'i dus na/ sangs rgyas mtshan med mtha' yas pa de snyed la bsnyen bkur dang mchod pa byas te/dge ba'i rtsa ba rab tu bskrun pas mdo sde 'di'i ming thos par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / mdo sde re re tsam gyi mtshan thos pa'ang de ltar gsungs na/ mdo sde thams cad kyi snying po phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa ni de bas kyang smos ci dgos/ de'i phyir gsham du a ti rdzogs pa chen po'i gdams pa zab mo'i phan yon bstan pa ni/ ji skad du/byang chub don du gnyer ba'i skal ba la/ /skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi gnad bsdus pa/ /rdzogs chen 'chad nyan sgom pa'i yon tan dang / /'chad dang klog pa'i phan yon bsdus la brjod/ /22

nye'i6sgo ma pa casdo sa che /snyeyab 05ces bshad pa ltar/ 'dir dam chos rdzogs pa chen po'i gdams pa 'di la thos pa dang / sgom pa dang / kha ton du byed pa la sogs pa'i phan yon nyung ngu rnam gsal zhig brjod par bya'o/ /dang po thos pa'i phan yon ni/ spyir rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos gang dang gang zhig la thos pa btsal yang phan yon dpag tu med pa yod de/〈thos pa'i tshoms 〉las/ thos pas chos rnams shes par 'gyur/ / thos pas sdig las ldog par byed/ / thos pas don ma yin pa spong / / thos pas mya ngan 'das pa 'thob/ / ces dang / skyes rabs las/ gang zhig thos pas yid ni dad gyur nas/ /legs par dga' la brtan pa nyid du 'gyur/ / shes rab skye zhing gti mug med par 'gyur/ / rang gi shes kyang de ni nyo ba'i rigs/ / thos pa gti mug mun sel sgron me yin/ / rkun po la sogs mi 'khyer nor gyi mchog /kun tu rmongs pa'i dgra 'joms mtshon cha yin/ / thabs tshul man ngag ston pas grogs kyi mchog / phongs par gyur kyang mi 'gyur mdza' bo yin/ / gnod pa med pa mya ngan nad kyi sman/ / nyes pa chen po'i dpung 'joms dpung gi mchog / grogs dang dpal dang gter gyi mchog kyang yin/ /ya rabs rnams dang phrad na skyes kyi mchog / tshogs kyi nang na mkhas pa mgu bar 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang a ti rdzogs pa chen po'i chos sam gdams pa la thos pa 'tshol bar 'dod pa dag gis nga rgyal dang / ma dad pa dang / don du gnyer ba med pa dang / phyi rol du yid rnam par g.yeng ba dang / yid bsdus dang / skyo bas nyan pa ste dri ma'am skyon drug yongs su spangs shing / nyan mkhan gyis rang la nad pa lta bu'i 'du shes dang /chos la sman pa lta bu'i 'du shes dang / bla ma dang slob dpon la sman pa lta bu'i 23

bsngo ma chos rdzo sa sda che bsgori ma 4〉 'du shes sam/ yang na rang nyid mgron po/ chos la gru/ bla ma la mnyan pa/gzhan yang rang nyid rgyus med/ chos la zhon pa/ bla ma la lam mkhan la sogs pa'i 'du shes nye bar bzhag nas mnyan na phan yon ni mtha' yas pa zhig yod de/ dz+nyomyang 'das 〉las/ gal te sems can gang gi rna lam du lan gcig tsam thos pa tsam gyis/ bskal ba bdun gyi bar du ngan song du mi lhung ngo / /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin zhing / thos pa'i stobs kyis chos zab mo 'di la dad pa rab tu bskyed na yang / skal ba med pa'i mi rnams chos zab mo 'di thos pa lta zhog tha na mtshan tsam yang rna bar lhung ba yang shin tu dka' ba dang / mtshan tsam rna bas thos pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur na yang / sngon bsags kyi bsod nams dman pa'am las 'brel med pa zhig yin na chos zab mo 'dir dad pa'i skal ba ni ha cang 'thob dka' ba zhig yin te/ phyag rgya'i mdo las/ 'jam dpal chos kyi rnam grangs 'dir mos pa dka' ste/sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mang po la bsnyen bkur byas pa'i sems can de dag gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos par 'gyur zhing / thos nas kyang mos par 'gyur ro/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / de las mngon par shes thab pa zhig ni chos zab mo 'di sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mang ༄po la bsnyen bkur byas pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po mngon par mtho ba'i sems can rnams ma gtogs gzhan rnams kyis dka' ba med par thos par 'gyur ba zhig min zhing / chos zab mo 'di thos shing dad par gyur pa'i sems can rnams ni bsod nams chen po ldan pa zhig yin pa ste/ bde ldan zhing mdo las/ lta ba can dang dman dang zhum rnams kyis/ / sangs rgyas chos la dad pa rnyed mi nus/ / gang dag sngon gyi sangs rgyas mchod byed pa/ / de 24

dza〉me phan ma pa rdzo sa che gyipha 'a dag 'jig rten mgon gyi spyod la slob/ / ces dang / phal chen bzang po dpal gyi le'u las/ gang rnams nyan thos theg pa'ang yid ches pa'i/ / mi rnams 'jig rten kun na dkon pa ste/ / de bas rang rgyal theg pa la'ang dad pa dkon/ / theg chen dad byed de bas shin tu dkon/ / theg chen 'di la zhugs pa dkon pa ste/ / 'di 'dra'i chos la dad pa shin tu dkon/ / 'dzin cing spel byed smos kyang ci dgos te/ / yang dag ma nor 'jug pa smyos ci dgos/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / chos zab mo dag la thos pa byas te dad pa rab tu skyes nas 'dzin pa'i las la brtson pa'i phan yon ni/ mdo ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thob/ / de dag migayo mchod byas te/ / bskal bar sems can snyed du yang / / rtag tu gus par mchod pa bas/ / gang gis tshig gcig bzung ba na/ / bsod nams snga ma thams cad ni/ / bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar yin no/ /gnyis pa sgom pa'i phan yon ni/ sgom pa zhes pa ni bsam byung gi nges pa rnyed pa'i don la dpyad 'jog ci rigs kyi sgo nas yang yang 'dris par byed pa'i shes rab yin zhing / de las dpyad sgom zhes pa ni/ bdag med pa'i don la shes rab kyis so sor dpyad nas spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i dbyings su mnyam par 'jog pa de yin pa dang / 'jog sgom zhes pa ni/dmigs pa'i thog tu sems ma g.yeng bar bzhag nas sgom pa de yin/ de lta na'ang skabs 'di'i sgom pa zhes pa ni/ a ti rdzogs pa chen po'i gdams pa zab mo'i don rang rgyud la sbyar nas lag len du 'khyer bar go dgos shing /de ltar a ti rdzogs pa chen po'i don zab mo bsgom na phan yon dpag tu med 25

tho'i ma chos rdzo sa pa che bsgo'i ma tho〉pa zhig yod de/ yab sras mjal ba'i mdo las/ gang gis bskal ba bcu'i bar du nyan te gzhan la bstan pas/ gang se gol gtogs pa tsam 'di bsgom na/ de nyid de las bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ / zhes dang / mdo ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi bstan pa yi/ / byang chub lam la bsgom par byed/ / lam der goms par bsgom byas na/ / bla med sangs rgyas 'grub par 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ chos zab mo dag la dpyad 'jog ci rigs kyi sgo nas legs par bsgom na mthar thug ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob ste phan yon kun gyi nang nas ches khyad du 'phags shing 'gran pa'i zla thams cad dang bral ba'i phan yon thob pa 'gyur ba dngos su mtshon yod do/ /gsum pa kha ton du byas pa'i phan yon ni/ gong gsal gyi de ltar lam ma sbyangs pa'i sems can dag gis chos kha ton du byas na'ang phan yon yod de/'jam dpal snying po las/ gsung rab kun gyi snying po bsdus bsdus pa/ /tshul 'di thun re ston dang nyan pas kyang / / dam chos 'chad dang thos pa'i phan yon tshogs/ /rlabs chen sdud par nges pas de don bsam/ / zhes dang /mdo sde las/ lan gcig bklags na bskal ba stong gi bar du 'khor ba la rgyab kyis phyogs par 'gyur ro/ / bcangs pa tsam gyis skye ba dran par 'gyur ro/ / zhes dang / gzhan yang rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud las kyang phan yon mtha' yas pa zhig gsungs pa'i phyir/ a ti rdzogs pa chen po'i gdams pa zab mo 'di nyid sa steng na rab tu dkon pa'i rin po che zhig yin pas/ 'di la thos pa dang / sgom pa dang / kha ton du byas na bskal ba bdun gyi bar du ngan song du mi lhung ba dang / sangs rgyas thob pa/ bsod nams 'phel ba/26

dza'ile ga ma la rngogs che gyiphab 05'khor ba las rgyab kyi phyogs pa/ skye ba dran pa sogs phan yon mtha' yas pa zhig yod la/ deng sang gi sems can yod do cog gis rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang khyad par du a ti rdzogs pa chen po'i chos sam gdams pa zab mor thos pa dang / sgom pa dang / kha ton bcas byed pa'i las la brtson pa brgya phrag thang lhod med par brtsegs par 'os so/ / / /27

le'u bzhi pa/ gdams ngag gi khrid chul/de yang tshe gcig lus gcig gis sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid mi slob pa'i zung 'jug chen po khyab bdag gdod ma'i mgon po bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang po'i go 'phang rin po che mngon du byed pa'i myur lam khyad par can du gyur pa'i a ti rdzogs pa chen po'i zab don snying po'i gdams pa 'di nyid skal ba dang ldan pa'i slob ma rnams la khrid pa'i dus su gsham gsal gyi 'di dag gal bo che la nan tan du bya dgos so/ /sa bcad dang po/ bla ma'i mtshan nyid/deng gi dus 'dir chos pa'i gzugs kyis rang nyid la rnyed bkur snyan grags 'tshol ba'i slad du gzhan rnams bag tsha ba cung zad tsam yang med par bslu bar byed pa'i lus can mtha' yas pa zhig yod pa ni/ ji skad du/〈mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉las/ srid pa 'di yis rang gi ngang tshul rnams/ /rab tu gsal bar rtag tu bstan na yang / / da tshe 'di'i rnyed bkur lhur len pa'i/ /sde snod 'dzin pa khas 'che 'di 'dra ci/ / 'dod pa'i rnam rtog cung zad kha ma bri/ / rnyed bkur sgrub phyir mi byed ci yang med/ / de dag sprul pa'i lus can yin par rlom/ / sa steng 'di 'dras gang bas rab tu skyo/ / rang sems gdul ba'i ched du chos gsungs mod/ / deng dus chos la bsten nas 28

dza'ile phabagi pa ga masapharag gi da ladregs shing khengs/ / khyim pa kun las lhag par chags sdang 'phel/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bod kyi yul 'di na ha cang mang po zhig yod pas/ bla ma bsten par 'dod pa'i slob ma rnams kyis chos gos rnam gsum gyon pa zhig yin pa mthong ma thag rang nyid kyi bla mar bkur bar mi bya ste/ chos gos rnam gsum gyon pa thams cad bla mar rung ba zhig ma yin te/ chos gos rnam gsum gyon na yang bla ma'i mtshan nyid mi tshang ba mang po zhig yod pa'i phyir ro/ / des na bla ma ni gang byung mang byung dang gang 'dod 'dod du btsal chog pa zhig gtan nas min zhing / gal srid rang nyid las dman pa'i mi zhig bla mar bkur zhing bsten na rang nyid kyi mi tshe stong zad du gtong ba ma zad/ da dung chos rnam dag cig rgyud du 'byor bar re ba de yang skya rengs khrod kyi skar mdang / 'od zer khrod kyi mun pa/ char pa'i rjes kyi 'ja' tshon bzhin du 'gyur bar gor ma chag pas/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig bsten rgyu ni shin tu gal che ba zhig yin te/ de yang 'di skad/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan pa la/ / dal 'byor don yod phyir du 'jug pa na/ / thog mar dge ba'i bshes gnyen btsal zhing bsten/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar 'di dang gtan gyi phan pa dang bde ba ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che brgya lam na mtshan tsam yang thos par dka' ba nyid 'jig rten du gnas pa la/ dal 'byor gyi chos dang ldan pa'i yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i mi lus thob pa dag chud zos su mi gtong bar don yod par bgyi ba'i phyir du 'jug pa'i blo gros dang ldan pa dag thog mar kho na dge ba'i bshes gnyen te bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig legs par btsal nas rnyed pa na tshul bzhin du bsten dgos na yang / ched du brjod pa'i tshoms las/ dman 29

dza'i ma chos rdzogs la che yo'i mgazhagadza'ipa bsten pas mi dag nyams 'gyur zhing / / thad kar babs pa bsten pas so na gnas/ / gtso bo bsten pa'i dam pa thob par 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i snying po'i don mang du thos pa'i yon tan rang nyid las kyang dman pa zhig bla ma bsten pas bsten mi dag la'ang yon tan gang yang mi skye bar skyon mang po skyed pas nyams par 'gyur zhing /gsang chen rdo rje theg pa spyi dang lhag par du a ti rdzogs pa chen po'i don mang du thos pa'i yon tan yang rang nyid dang mnyam pa ste che chung ngam dman lhag ci yang med pa zhig bla ma bsten pas bsten mi dag gi yon tan yar skyed mi 'byung zhing sngar gyi yon tan rnams kyang chud zos su mi 'gro ba ste 'phel 'grib ci yang med par so na gnas pa zhig tu 'gyur bas/ de 'dra'i bla ma bsten na rang nyid kyi chu tshod dang / lang tsho/ sems shugs bcas don med pa'i sgo nas chad zos su gtong ba ste mi tshe stong zad du gtong srid pa yin/ gzhan du ༄na rgyud rang shar las/ mi shes nga rgyal chen po dang / / blo rmongs tshig phyir 'breng pa dang / / gsang sngags don la mi dgongs dang / / gzhan gyi zhe gcod khengs tshig dang / / log pa'i lam du zhugs pa dang / / dbang gi dkyil 'khor zhal ma mthong / / dam tshig 'chal bar gyur pa dang / / dris pa dag la lan mi 'debs/ / thos chung nga rgyal che ba ste/ / slob dpon ma brtags slob ma'i bdud/ /ces gsungs pas/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i snying po'i don mi shes na yang shes pa'i tshul 'chos spras te nga las lhag pa gzhan na med do snyam pa'i nga rgyal che ba/ blo rmongs pa'i dbang gis gsang sngags kyi dgongs don zab mo'i tshul la bsam blo mi gtong ba'am gtong mi shes par dri ma can du byed pa nor 'khrul can dang the tshom gyis 'chang ba byis pa thang dkyil du 3shaṃ

0:khyo3zhi dzizasbyon cagi /ska' phar zugi 'khyams pa lta bu/ dka' gnas btang snyoms su bzhag nas sla sar spros te rgan po so med kyis zas za ba lta bu/ skabs don gyis stongs shing don dang ma 'brel ba'i gtam gyis zang zing bor byed pa bya rog gi tshang 'cha' ba lta bu/gdul bya'i rgyud tshod dang mi bstun par shes tshad lhug par bshad pa glen mas bu chung gso ba lta bu la sogs pa'i 'chad pa'i skyon ldan pa'am yang na tha snyad tshig skam kho na'i rjes su bsnyegs ci thub ‘ra brtson pa ma gtogs lung rigs kyi spros pa gang dang gang zhig mdzad pa thams cad kyis gsang sngags spyi dang khyad par rdzogs pa chen po'i dgongs don gyi snying po mngon par gsal zhing 'dril bas nges pa skye ba dang / tshig thor bu re'i bstan tshad tsam min par gzhung don spyi'i 'gangs 'chun pa'i go ba ster ba sogs kyi yon tan nyin mo'i skar ma ji bzhin rab tu dkon pa/ gsang sngags sam rdzogs chen 'chad pa'i skabs su de'i don mi bshad par rtsa ba dor nas yal ga 'dzin pa'i dpe bzhin rang nyid kyi che bar brjod pa ste/ rdzogs pa chen po'i brgyud pa khyad du 'phags pa ni bdag la babs/ rdzogs pa chen po'i dbang lung khrid gsum gyis phyug pa yang bdag yin/ gzhan rnams ni bdag la 'gran pa'i do 'dzugs thabs gtan nas med pa yin zhes sgro 'dogs skur 'debs dag gi skyon gyi dri ma ldan pa'i 'chal gtam bag med du sgrog pa'i kṛzabs kyis bsten mi rnams bslu ba'i skyon dang ldan pa/ rang rgyud ma dul ba'i dbang gis rang ni khyod tsho las phyogasagang ci'i thad nas ldab brgya 'gyur gyi lhag pa yin snyam nas lus ngag yid gsum tsub pa dang byams snying rje'i dri mi bro ba'i rnam 'gyur gyis gzhan gyi zhe gcod cing / chos 'chad pa'i rgyab tu gzhan gyi rgyu nor sogs rang la phan pa zhig e thob la dmigs shing / rgyu nor skyes su ma phul na zhe sdang langs te 31

dza'i ma chos rdzo sa la che 'dza'i ma zha dza〉gnod cing 'tshe ba dang / gzhan gnod nye skyor gyi phyogs lhung che ba sogs bsam pa ngan pas snying po'i sa bon rul ba/ srog gcod pa/ ma byin len pa/mi tshangs spyod pa/ mi chos bla ma'i rdzun bshad pa la sogs pa'i log lam du bag tsha ba med par zhugs shing rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal ma mthong ba/rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams chag tu gyur cing slob mas dris pa mtha' dag la dus thog tu dris lan gnad la 'khel ba mi 'debs pa/ gzhung rnams la thos pa chung zhing rang nyid khyad du 'phags par rlom pa dang gzhan rnams la ma gus pa dang sdug bsngal 'byung ba'i rten byed pa'i nga rgyal che ba ste de 'dra'i slob dpon nam bla ma ni dad ldan gyi slob ma rnams la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i bdud yin pas lam sang spang bar bya dgos te/ o rgyan rin po che'i zhal nas/ thos rgya chung la nga rgyal che ba/ blun rmongs tshig la sred cing khengs sems che ba/ shes rab chung zhing don la rmongs pa/ bskyed rdzogs don la g.yel zhing lag len rdugs pa/ bdag 'dzin che zhing thugs rje chung ba/dag snang chung la log lta che ba/ mkhyen pa chung zhing phyogs cha che ba'i bla ma de bsten na phung bar 'gyur bas spang bar bya'o/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar bla ma ngan pa mig gi rdul bzhin phangs pa spu tsam yang med par spangs te bla ma bzang po ji lta bu zhig bsten dgos snyam na/ gang bsten par bya ba'i bla ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ o rgyan rin po che'i zhal nas/ spyir theg pa chen po'i tshig don lag len gsum la mkhas pa/ bskyed rdzogs bzlas brjod/lta sgom spyod gsum/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum la rtags dang drod thob pa/ rang nyams su len zhing sgrub pa la brtson pa/ gzhan don khrid la mkhas shing thugs rje che ba/ thugs dgongs rtogs pa dang ldan pa/ thugs rab dag snang dang 32

dza〉le wāzhi la ga mas ngag gi daspul/mithugs rje 'dzin pa/ tshe 'di'i snang shes dor nas phyi ma don du gnyer ba/brgyud pa'i byin rlabs yod cing / lag len yon tan dang ldan pa de yid bzhin nor bu lta bu yin pas bsten par bya'o/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang las phyogs gang ci'i thad kyi yon tan lhag par gyur pa zhig yin dgos shing /de yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi dbye ba spyi tsam du bzhi ste/ so so skye bo dang /byang chub sems dpa' dang / sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'o/ / de dag kyang rang gi gnas skabs bzhi dang sbyar te rang nyid las dang po dus skabs su sangs rgyas dang sa chen po la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bsten pa'i nus pa med pas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen so so skye bo la bsten dgos shing / so so skye bo'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen nam bla ma ni gong du o rgyan rin po che'i gsung lung du drangs pa bzhin mtshan nyid ldan pa zhig yin dgos te/ a ti bkod pa chen po las/ mkhas shing bya ba bral ba dang / / chos nyid don la tshad phebs dang / / 'dod pa'i don la rmongs pa med/ / gsang sngags bla ma'i mtshan nyid do/ / zhes dang / klong gsal las/mtshan dang ldan pa'i bla ma yis/ / dbang bskur bas ni sdug bsngal grol/ /zhes dang / man ngag snying tig las/ dang po rdo rje bla ma ni/ / dbang thob rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin byed/ / zab don rtogs shing khong du chud/ / phyi nang gsang ba'i rnam g.yeng bral/ /byings rmugs skyon bral dgongs pa mtho nges shing dag pas dbang bskur bya/ / phyi yi rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi dang / / nang gi rnam rtog yid byed dang / / gsang ba lta ba kha 'byams spang / / zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/ des spyir gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde mtha' dag gi don la mkhas shing grub mtha'i dbye ba phyed pa/ bye brag lam 'di nyid kyi myong drod tshad dang ldan 33

waṃ macas rngogs la che rtswa'i rnamagazhagawaṃpa/ man ngag gi don ston pa la mkhas shing chags sdang sogs tshe 'di'i 'du 'dzi'i g.yeng ba dang bral ba/ rdo rje'i lus gnad du bsnu na pa'i rim gnyis kyi nyams len mthar phyin pas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor chos nyid mngon sum gyi don tshad la phebs pa/ dgongs pas rang rgyud grol cing thugs rjes gzhan rgyud smin nus pa/ gnas lugs kyi don la shes rab zab mos sgro 'dogs chod pa'i ye shes kyi slob mas dris pa rnams la dris lan yang dag cing skyon med pa zhig rmongs pa med par 'debs pa bcas kyi yon tan ldan pa zhig yin dgos tshul bstan yod do/ / deng sang snyigs ma'i dus 'dir chos la kha g.yar zhing sprul sku min yang de'i chas su brdzus pa dang / yon tan ci yang med la g.yo sgyur mkhas pa/gzhung don la rmongs pas kun nas 'doms pa/ phyogs lhung chags sdang gi bran du gyur pa'i mi ngan mang po zhig gis bod spyi dang lhag par du spun zla'i mi rigs gzhan rnams kyi dad ldan kun la mgo bskor btang ste dngul dang rgyu nor mang po zhig len par brtson bzhin yod pa mthong thos gnyis kyi yul du 'gyur ba ste/ dper na lo du ma'i sngon la/ rgya nag pe cin du sprul skur brdzus pa'i mi sdig sgrib can zhig 'ongs te rgya'i chos la dad pa'i skal ldan rnams la chos gsungs shing / phyis dad ldan gyi slob ma rnams kyis nged cag la dbang bskur bar bya'o zhes re ba nan gyis bton pa na/ chos kyi don la mi mkhas pa/grub mtha'i dbye ba mi rtogs pa/ lam gyi myong ba dang drod tshad mi ldan pa/man ngag gi don ston par rmongs pa/ rim gnyis kyi nyams len med pa/rang rgyud ma grol ba/ 'du 'dzi'i g.yeng ba che ba/ dngul dang rgyu nor la chags zhen che ba sogs bsam sbyor ngan pa'i skye bo des dbang bskur ba zhes 34

tho'ile 5bcan pa ga mas jag sku1lapa'i don la rab tu rmongs shing 'thoms par gyur nas slob ma rnams la de ring dbang bskur bar bya'o zer nas rig 'dzin tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i mgur bya de khrung khrung dkar mo zhes pa de nyid bklags te dbang bskur ba sogs skabs rer dgod bro la lan rer ngu yang bro ba'i gnas tshul ya nga ba 'di byung ba red/ de'i phyir mi rigs gang dang gang zhig yin na yang de'i dad ldan dgashis bla ma bsten par 'dod pa'i skabs su sprul sku'i ming tsam mam rab byung gi gzugs 'dzin pa tsam la bltas nas de dag bla mar bsten par mi bya ste/ rang rang gis bsten par 'dod pa'i bla ma zhig rnyed zhi na/ thog mar bla ma de'i 'gro 'dug spyod gsum/ chos kyi yon tan/ rtogs pa'i che chung /de'i chung dus nas da lta'i bar gyi lo rgyus sogs la rtsad gcod phu thag chod pa zhig byas nas de'i rgyus gsal por lon rjes/ da dung gong du smras pa'i bla ma'i mtshan nyid ldan pa yin min la sems zhib mos brtag cing dpyod pa gces su 'dzin dgos/ rang nyid kyis bsten par bya ba'i bla ma de nyid nges pa don gyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig yin pa the tshom med par rtogs pa na/da gzod bla ma bsten pa dang / de ltar byas na rang gzhan gnyis kar rngo thogs pa yin no/ / de ltar rang lus kyi sgrib pa phal cher zad tsa na/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen sa chen po la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la bsten par nus shing / rang tshogs lam chen po yan chad du gnas tsa na/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku la bsten par nus pa dang / rang sa chen po la gnas tsa na/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la bsten par nus pa'o/ / de dag las bdag cag las dang po ba rnams nyon mongs pa'i mun khang na 'dug pa'i tshe/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gong ma rnams 35

waṃdam chos rdzogs pa chenawo'i rnamagazhagawaṃbasten pa lta zhog zhal mthong ba tsam yang med pa la/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen so so skye bo dang mjal bas/ de'i gsung gi sgron mes lam snang bar byas nas/dge ba'i bshes gnyen gong ma rnams dang mjal bar 'gyur te/ des na thams cad las drin che ba ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen so so skye bo yin no/ / so skye'i bshes gnyen gyi mtshan nyid la'ang gong du smras pa'i yon tan rnams te yon tan brgyad dam/ bzhi'am/ gnyis dang ldan pa zhig dgos par gsungs te/ yon tan brgyad ni/ tshul khrims ldan zhing mang du thos/ /rtogs pa dang ni l+līng brtser ldan/ / mi 'jigs bzod ldan skyo ba med/ / tshig gi bya ba ldan pa'o/ / zhes pa de rnams yin/ yon tan bzhi ni/ mang du thos pas ston pa rgya che ba dang / shes rab che bas gzhan gyi the tshom gcod pa dang /skyes bu dam pa'i las byed pas tshig bzung bar 'os pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam par byang ba gnyis kyi mtshan nyid kyi de kho na nyid ston pa rnams yin/ yon tan gnyis ni/ spyod 'jug las/ rtag par dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni/ / theg chen don la mkhas pa dang / / byang chub sems dpa'i brtul zhugs mchog / srog gi phyir yang mi gtong ngo / / zhes gsungs pa ltar mkhas shing sdom pa ldan pa zhig yin dgos/de 'dra'i mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma'am slob dpon la so thar gyi slob dpon dang / byang sems kyi slob dpon/ sngags kyi slob dpon te gsum yod cing / de las so thar gyi slob dpon ni/ thog mar 'dul ba kho na la'ang rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs gnang ba'i mkhan po/ las byed pa slob dpon/gsang ste ston pa/ gnas sam klog pa'i slob dpon bzhi/ de'i steng du dge tshul gyi slob dpon bsnan na lnga yod do/ / de dag gi spyi'i mtshan nyid ni/ sum 36

dza'ile yabagi pa/ ga masapodag gi ྅byelabargya pa las/ tshul khrims ldan zhing 'dul ba'i cho ga shes/ / nad par snying rtse 'khor ni dag pa dang / / chos dang zang zing phan 'dogs la brtson pa/ / dus su 'doms pa de dag bla mar bsngags/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo bcu lon zhing skyon ma byung ba'i tshul khrims dang ldan pa ni brtan pa'i yan lag dze+esnod 'dul ba'i cho ga ma 'khrul bar blo nas shes pa mkhas pa'i yan lag slob ma nad pa la snying brtse zhing rang gi 'khor tshul khrims dang ldan pas dag pa/ chos dang zang zing ste phan 'dogs gnyis kyis phan gdags pa la brtson pa/ bslab bya rnams dus dang dus su gdams pa rnams ni phan 'dogs pa'i yan lag ste/ de lta bu ni so so thar ba'i bla mar bsngags pa yin no/ / bye brag mkhan po ni brtan mkhas btsun gsum dang phan 'dogs pa'i yan lag bzhi dang ldan pa/ brtan mkhas la'ang lhan cig tu sbyar ba'am lnga phrugs nyer gcig dang ldan pa ste mdo rtsa'i 'grel chen dang pad dkar zhabs kyis bshad pa ltar shes par bya/ phan 'dogs pa la'ang yan lag bcu gnyis su bshad de/ snying rje bzod ldan nang 'khor dag pa dang / / phan 'dogs gnyis brtson mtshan dang lta ba mthun/ / smra shes don go shes pa rang bzhin gnas/ / tha mal lus dang sa ni rang bzhin pa'o/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /las byed pa'i slob dpon ni/ dge slong gi sdom pa rnam par dag cing /mtshan thun pa/ lta ba mthun pa/ tha snyad gsum ldan/ lus tha mal du gnas pa/ sa rang bzhin du gnas pa ste chos drug gi steng du sdom pa 'bogs pa la mkhas pa zhig yin dgos/gsang ste ston pa'i slob dpon ni/ dge slong gi sdom pa rnam par dag 37

lke'aji mazhesas rngogs la che 0sgo'i ma ga'aji cing / mtshan mthun pa/ lta ba mthun pa/ tha snyad gsum ldan/ lus tha mal du gnas pa/ sa rang bzhin du gnas pa ste chos drug gi steng du bar chad dri ba la mkhas pa zhig yin dgos/ gnas sam klog pa'i slob dpon ni/ gnas slob ni mkhan po'i mtshan nyid ldan pa'i khar spang blang gi lung 'bogs pas slob ma'i༄da dag par sgrub nus pa zhig yin dgos shing / klog slob ni slob dpon gyi chos kyi khar sde snod gsum la blo gros gsal ba zhig yin dgos/byang sems sam byang sdom gyi slob dpon ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ bshes gnyen dul ba zhi ba nyer zhi ba/ / yon tan lhag pa brtson bcas lung gis phyug / de nyid rab tu rtogs pa smra mkhas ldan/ / brtse ba'i bdag nyid skyo ngal spangs la bsten/ / zhes chos bcu dang ldan pa zhig dgos par gsungs pa ltar/tshulakhrims bslab pa'i srab bzang pos sems kyi rta rgod 'dul ba/ dran pa dang shes bzhin gyis ting nge 'dzin la bslab pas sems nang du zhi bar gnas pa/ sems las su rung ba'i zhi gnas la brten nas yang dag pa'i don la so sor dpyod pa'i shes rab skyes pas rmongs pa nye bar zhi ba/ slob ma las dman pa'am mnyam pa ma yin pa yon tan ches lhag pa/ gzhan gyi don la spro ba brtan pa'i brtson 'grus dang bcas pa/ sde snod gsum mang du thos pa'i lung gis phyug pa/ thos bsam sgom pa'i stobs kyis chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid rab tu rtogs pa/ gdul bya'i blo tshod dang bstun pa'i lam gyi rim pa smra ba ste bshad mkhas pa dang ldan pa/ rnyed bkur sogs la mi lta bar snying rjes chos ston pa'i kun slong dag pas brtse ba'i bdag nyid/ yang yang 'chad padī ༵ ngal zhing khong khro ba sogs bzod pa'i skyo ngal spangs pa la brten par
