4〉le phabagi pa ga masapharaka gi labya'o/ /de'ang dul ba zhi ba nye bar zhi ba de nyid rtogs pa rnams rtogs pa'i yan lag lung gis phyug pa ni lung gi yan lag yon tan lhag pa bcas chos drug po rang gis thob pa'i yon tan/ lhag ma bzhi po gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i yon tan te/ de dag dang ldan pa ni skyes bu chen po'o/ / gzhan yang thos sogs bcu gnyis ldan pa mchog de las gzhan yang mang du thos pa la sogs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis dang ldan pa ni mchog tu gsungs te/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ mang du thos shing shes rab che/ / zang zing rnyed pa don mi gnyer/ /byang chub sems ldan snying rje che/ / dka' ba bzod cing skyo ngal chung / / man ngag che zhing lam las grol/ / rigs la mkhas shing drod tshad shes/ / bcu gnyis ldan la bsten par bya/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /sngags kyi slob dpon ni/ rdo rje slob dpon brtan dul blo gros can/ /bzod ldan g.yo med sngags rgyud sbyor ba shes/ / brtse ldan mkhas shing de nyid bcu mthar son/ / dkyil 'khor las mkhas sngags bshad spyod pa shes/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lus ngag sems rnams ma 'tshubs pas brtan pa/ sems kyi bslab pa dang ldan pas dul ba/ chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i blo gros can/ slob ma'i bya ba la bzod pa dang ldan pas khong mi khro ba/ rang gi nyes pa bcab pa'i g.yo dang gzhan bslu ba'i bsam pas yang dag ma yin pa'i don ston pa'i sgyu dang bral ba'i drang ba ste drug khyad par gyi mtshan nyid phrin las bzhi la sogs pa'i sngags kyi sbyor ba dang mtha' drug la sogs pa rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes pa/ gzhan la snying brtse ba dang ldan pa/ thun mong ba'i gzhung lugs rnams la'ang ci rigs par mkhas shing / de nyid rnam pa bcu'i mthar son pa/bsnyen sogs dag par byas shing dbang bskur ba'i bya ba khong du chud pas 39

dza'i ma chos rngogs pa che yo'i rnamashazhagadza'idakyil 'khor bri ba'i las la mkhas pa/ dbang po rab 'bring tha ma'i tshul dang mthun par sngags bshad pa'i spyod pa ste/ de nyid bcu tshan pa gsum du dbye nas bsdoms pas dgu/ thun khyad gnyis ka bsdoms pas bco lnga'o/ /de nyid bcu la nang gses su dbye na gsum yod pa las dang po rdo rje slob dpon la nye bar mkho ba'i de nyid bcu ni/ rab gnas kyi rgyud las/dkyil 'khor ting 'dzin phyag rgya dang / stangs stabs sngags dang 'dug stangs dang / / bzlas brjod sbyin sreg gtor ma dang / / las la sbyar dang slar bsdu ba'o/ / zhes 'byung ba ltar dang / cho ga'i de nyid bcu gur gyi dgongs pa ḍom bhi pa'i de nyid becu pa las 'byung ba ni/ srung ba dbang bskur gtor ma bzlas bsgom dang / / phyir zlog pa dang dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dang / / sdig sbyong ba dang gshegs su gsol ba dang / / de nyid bcu zhes rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs/ / zhes pa de yin zhing / de kho na nyid kyi de nyid bcu rgyud 'bum lnga'i dgongs pa rin chen 'bar las 'byung ba ni/ rdo rje dril bu ye shes dang / / lha dang dkyil 'khor sbyin sreg dang / / sngags dang rdul tshon gtor ma dang / /dbang bskur de nyid bcu rig pas/ / zhes pa de yin te/ de ltar na de kho na nyid sum cu tham pa'o/ / yang na rab gnas kyi rgyud las 'byung ba de dang 'dra ba rdo rje snying rgyan las phyi'i de nyid bcur gsungs pa dang / de nyid 'dus pa las de dang phyogs mtshungs gsungs pa rnams ni yo ga'i lugs yin par bshad do/ /yang gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi phyogs las bshad pa ltar na/ dam pa'i mdzod gsum ldan pa ste/ de'ang bden pa dbyer med du rtogs pa'i lta ba/bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin pa'i ting 'dzin/ spyi dang bye brag gi dam tshig las mi 40

༷:༷6) sgo sbyon zugi /skasdo cada'/ zugi'ada' ba ste gsum dang / yang na bskyed pa'i mdzod ma hā/ rdzogs pa'i mdzod a nu/ lta ba'i mdzod a ti gsum la mkhas pa/ phan nus zab mo'i dbang gi chu bo rdzogs pa/ gsang sngags yal bar mi 'dor zhing snod ldan rjes su 'dzin pa'i gnyer dang ldan pa/ rgyud sde la mkhas shing gzhung gi don khrol ba/ phrin las te sgrub pa'i chog khrigs mkhas pa/ snyan brgyud kyi man ngag nyams su myong ba'i drod rtags 'chang ba ste mdzod gsum so sor bgrang bas rang bzhin brgyad ldan gyi rdo rje slob dpon du sangs rgyas gsang ba'i lam rim las bshad do/ /de yang bla ma'i mtshan nyid ji skad bshad pa thams cad mdor bsdu na/rdo rje 'chang nas da lta'i bar du smin grol gyi brgyud pa ma chad cing dam sel gyi skyon ma zhugs pa/ sdom pa dang dam tshig brtul zhugs la gnas pa/ brgyud pa nas brgyud par byung ba'i man ngag dang ldan pa/ bka' bstan bcos spyi dang khyad par rgyud kyi don rig pa/ gzhan phan snying rje'i thugs dang ldan pa bcas yin par bshad do/ /de yang dpal ldan bla ma zhes pa ni/ zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po rdo rje'i ye shes gang de slob ma'i rgyud la skyed par nus pas mchog gi dngos grub kyi lhan cig byed rkyen du gyur pa zhig yin par bshad cing / gong smos kyi mtshan nyid rnams las ldog pa ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa las phyi rol tu gyur pa mtshan nyid dang mi ldan pa'i skyon can yin pas/ 'du 'dzi snyan grags la sogs pa che yang dpyod ldan rnams kyis brtags la sngon bla mar 'brel na yang btang snyoms su bzhag cing / ma 'brel na thog ma nas mi bsten par spang bar bya ste/ sa skya paṇa chen gyis/ sangs rgyas bstan bzhin mi byed pa'i/ / bla 41

tho'i ma' sa rngo sa sda che 'tho'i ma tho'im yin kyang btang snyoms bzhag / ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / gzhan yang bsdus rgyud las/ nga rgyal dang ldan khro bas zil mnan dam tshig rnams bral rdzas la brkam zhing thos pa dag kyang med/ / slob ma rnams ni bslu ba don du gnyer zhing mchog gi bde ba'i gnas las sems nyams dbang ma bskur/ /longs spyod dag la kun chags bag med tsub mo'i tshig dang bcas shing dbang po'i don du 'dod ldan pa/ / de nyid dmyal ba bzhin du slob ma mkhas pa rnams kyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub rgyur ni spang bar bya/ / zhes pas mtshon gzhan dag las kyang mang du byung ba'i tshul shes par byas la spang ngo / / legs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad tshang ba yang dus dbang gis shin tu dkon pas/ de 'dra'i mtshan nyid yongs su tshang ba'i bla ma ma rnyed kyang skyon nyung zhing yon tan mang ba zhig bla mar bzung bar bya ste/ don dam bsnyen pa las/ rtsod ldan dbang gis bla mar skyon dang yon tan 'dres/ / rnam pa kun tu sdug dang bral ba yod ma yin/ / de phyir yon tan lhag pa yang ni legs dpyad nas/ / bu rnams kyis ni de la bsten par bya ba'o/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'tshol ba'i dus gong smos kyi mtshan nyid de dag tshang ba yin min la zhib tu brtags nas mtshan nyid tshang ba'i bla ma bsten par bya'o/ /sa bcad gnyis pa/ slob ma'i mtshan nyid/de yang bsten bya slob ma la nang gses kyis dbye na/ so thar dang /byang sems/ sngags kyi snod rung rnams yin zhing / so thar dang byang sems kyi slob ma'i mtshan nyid shes par 'dod pa dag gis gzhung gzhan la gzigs par zhu'o/ /42

༷:na3sde phab shā /ska' phara'/ can zugide las sngags kyi slob ma'i mtshan nyid skabs su bab pa'i tshul gyis brjod par bya ste/ ji skad du/ sngags kyi snod rung de steng bla mar gus/ /gsang thub blo che dam tshig sgrub la brtson/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gsang sngags kyi smin grol sbyin pa'i snod du rung ba ni/ bla ma la shin tu gus pa/ zab mo'i lta spyod la sogs pa gsang thub pa/ gsang sngags kyi don la the tshom med cing de nyid rtogs pa'i blo rgya che ba/ spang blang gi dam tshig dang sgrub pa la brtson nus pa zhig yin ridagos te/ snga 'gyur gyi rgyud sgyu 'phrul las/ ston pa mchod brtson rtogs pa gsal/ / dam tshig sngags dang phyag rgya rnams/ / ma nyams shes shing yo byad ldan/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des ston pa bla ma la mchod pas dbang rnams rim par thob pa/ gus sbyor dang rtag sbyor gyi brtson 'grus kyis thos bsam yal bar mi 'dor ba/ rtogs bya'i lta ba la rnam par dpyod pa'i blo gros phyin ci ma log par gsal ba/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig ma nyams shing / sngags dang phyag rgya la sogs pa'i don rnams kyang khong du chud la/ mthun rkyen gyi yo byad dang ldan pa dag lam 'dir bya ba'i snod ldan du bstan to/ / de bzhin du thal 'gyur las kyang / dadatshe pa shes rab ldan pa dang / / mos shing 'khrul nor med pa dang / / dbang po gsal la bla ma bsten/ /lta ba sgom pa spyod pa ni/ / dad pa rab dang brtson 'grus ldan/ /gtong bar nus shing bla mar gus/ / brtul zhugs ldan zhing sdig la 'dzem/ /'gyur med rab tu brtan pos 'dzin/ / zhes dang / rang shar las/ dad pa'i stobs dang brtson 'grus che/ / shes rab che zhing 'dzin chags med/ / phu dud che zhing gsang sngags spyod/ / rtog med sems la g.yeng ba med/ / dam tshig ldan zhing sgrub la brtson/ / slob dpon ji skad gsung bzhin byed/ / ces 43

waṃdamacas rdzogs pa chenacazhi rnamagazhagawaṃdang / o rgyan rin po che'i zhal nas/ shes rab che zhing sdug bsran che ba/mos gus dang / dag snang dang / nges 'byung dang / skyo shas che ba/ tshe 'di blos btang nas/ sgrub pa srog dang bsdo nus pa/ ci gsungs bka' nyan cing / mos gus la ltem rkyang med pa de lta bu btsal lo/ / zhes dang / gzhan yang / ji skad du/ gnyis pa rdo rje slob ma ni/ / 'jig rten blo spang chog shes ldan/ / chos phyir rtog pa kun gtod nus/ / dben pa bsten zhing nyams len brtson/ / de la man ngag 'di yang sbyin/ / zhes gsungs pa de dag gis slob ma snod rung ba'i mtshan nyid gsal bar bstan cing / de 'dra'i snod du rung ba'i slob mas bla ma sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes ma skyes na byin rlabs mi 'jug pa dang / byin rlabs ma zhugs na rtogs pa rgyud la mi skye ba'i gnad 'di snying gi thig ler bzung nas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma sangs rgyas dngos yin pa'i 'du shes bzung zhing / bla ma'i skyon mthong na yang dag snang sbyangs nas ci gsung gi bka' thams cad legs par sgrub pa dang / bla ma dang gdams ngag la yid rab tu spro zhing don du gnyer ba dang ba'i dad pa/ bsgrub bya'i 'bras bu la ched du gdung ba 'dod pa'i dad pa/ the tshom mi byed pa yid ches kyi dad pa/ nyi tshe ba'i rkyen gyis mi 'phrog pa mthar thug gi dad pa ste byin rlabs 'jug pa'i rgyu tshang ba/ bla na med pa'i byang chub sgrub pa la phyi bshol dang thang lhod med pa'i snying stobs kyi dam bca' brtan pa/ gnas lugs zab mo'i don la dpyod pa'i shes rab gsal bas nyams rtogs skye sla ba/ zas gos sogs srid pa'i bde 'byor la chags 'dzin shas chung ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la bsnyen bkur zhing phu dud che bas byin rlabs 'jug pa'i sgo tshang ba/gsang sngags kyi lam la the tshom gyi sgro 'dogs chod pas zab mo'i spyod pa la 44

06〉le phabacan la mas 'dishan min shā 'jug nus pa/ chags sdang rmongs gsum sogs tha mal gyi rnam rtog la sems mi 'jug pas g.yeng ba dang bral ba/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig gnyer du blangs pa las mi 'da' ba'i dam bca' brtan pa/ zab mo'i lam sgom pa la skyo ngal med cing / bla mas ji ltar gsungs pa las mi 'da' ba/ bla ma'i bka' zur ma bcag cing bza' btung gi phud sogs rang la dngos 'byor ci yod chags med du 'bul ba ste/ ye shes rgya mtsho'i rgyud las/ rang gi rdzas dang yo byad kyis/ / bla ma mnyes par sus byas pa/ / 'di nas khams gsum 'khor ba las/ / sprul pa'i zhing du dbugs phyung ste/ / mya ngan 'das pa'i sar gshegs so/ / zhes dang / rdo rje ro langs rgyud las/ gang gi bla ma rdo rje 'chang / / bza' btung phud kyis rtag tu mchod/ / 'dir yang bza' btung 'phel ba dang / / 'khor los bsgyur rgyal 'thob par 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ mtshan nyid de ldan gyi slob ma nyid 'chad yul du bzung bar bya dgos so/ /spang bar bya ba'i snod skyon can gyi slob ma ni/ gong du smos ma thag pa'i slob ma'i yon tan gang las ldog pa'i skyon can zhig yin zhing / de 'dra'i slob ma'i skyon gang zhe na/ o rgyan rin po che'i zhal nas/ kha mkhas shing rgyud ngan pa/ lag dam zhing stong zhus mkhas pa/ bka' bzhin mi sgrub par tshe 'di la zhen pa/ gdams pa thob pa chog byed cing / kha yengs pa dam tshig med cing drin la rtsod pa/ yon tan mi mthong skyon la rtog pa/ de lta bu'i slob ma chos kyi bdud de spang bar bya/ zhes dang / rang shar las/ bkur ste phu dud mi byed cing / / gsang sngags 'chal bar spyod pa dang / / rigs rgyud med cing rang rgyud med/ / shes rab chung bar gyur pa dang / / bka' drin khyad du 45

'kho macas rdzogs la che yo'i mgazha dza'irigasod pa dang / / don med 'chal bar gyur pa ste/ / slob ma ma brtags slob dpon dgra/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ de 'dra'i snod skyon can gyi slob ma mtshan nyid dang mi ldan pa rnams ni slob dpon la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i bdud yin pas nges par du spang dgos te/ klong gsal las/ yang snying bcud kyi thig pa 'di/ / snod min rnams su blugs pa na/ / snod chags bcud 'bo dmyal bar lhung / / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ mtshan nyid dang mi ldan pa'i slob ma rnams la rgyal ba'i bka' dang gsung rab spyi dang khyad par du rdzogs pa chen po sogs kyis mtshon pa'i gsang sngags kyis chos bstan na dam can ḍāk+ki'i bka' chad 'byung zhing / dngos grub med cing sgro 'dogs dang skur 'debs sogs 'byung bar 'gyur ba mngon par bstan yod pas/ bla ma rnams kyis slob ma snod ldan yin min nam mtshan nyid tshang ba yin min la brtags nas chos ston pa ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang lhag par du dam chos rdzogs pa chen po bskal ba nas bskal ba'i bar du skyon med par dar zhing rgyas pa ste 'phel 'grib dang 'brel ba yod pa'i gnad dam pa zhig yin pas shin tu gzab pa gal che'o/ /dengagi lnga bdo snyigs ma'i dus 'dir snod ldan gyi slob ma mang po zhig med cing / ma bslabs pa la mkhas pa 'dod pa/ ma sbyangs pa la yon tan 'dod pa/ ma byas pa la 'bras bu 'dod pa/ dad pa tsam nas dngos grub 'dod pa sogs rgyu med par 'bras bu 'thob par 'dod pa'i slob ma shin tu mang ba dang / phyi tshul nas bla mar bkur khul/ chos la dad khul/ byams dang snying rje yod khul/ nyams rtogs dang drod thob khul/ byin rlabs dang dngos grub zhugs khul sogs byas te snod ldan gyi slob ma'i tshul 'chos spras na 46

0yin3sde phab la zu saphara'/ can 3byezugayang / don la chos sgor zhugs shing nyams len byed pa'i dmigs yul ni rang la rnyed bkur snyan grags 'thob pa sha stag las gzhan ci yang min pas/ chos la thos bsam dang nyams len byed pa mtha' dag gi 'dun ma rtsa ba nas nor zhing 'khrul ba zhig byung yod/ de yang gtso bor rang gi rgyud kyi bdag 'dzin dang tshe 'dir chags 'dzin shin tu che ba'i rtags dang mtshan ma zhig yin tsa na/slob ma de'i rigs kyi rgyud thul ba dka' ba dang chabs cig tu thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pa ste mngon par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob mi thub pa yin/ de'i phyir mar gyur sems can thams cad la phan 'dogs pa dmigs yul du bcangs te mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa don du gnyer nas bla ma bsnyen ci/nga chos la thos bsam rnam dag byed dgos te/ gzhan don bsgrubs na rang don zhor nas 'grub ces grags pa'i phyir/ gzhan la phan btags na de'i lan du gzhan gyis khyod la phan 'dogs pa dang / gzhan la gnod bskyal na de'i lan du gzhan gyis khyod la gnod skyel ba yin zhing / de ni mi'i 'gro ba spyi'e chos nyid cig yin pa dang / chos nyid kyi gnas lugs zab mor zhib tu brtags te mar gyur sems can thams cad la phan 'dogs pa zhes pa dang sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa zhes pa'i don gyi snying bcud blo'i rgyan du bskyil ba na/ de ni rang gzhan gnyis kar phan pa zhig yin pa shugs nas rtogs thub pa yin/ der brten slob ma su dang su zhig yin na yang rang nyid snod du rung zhing mtshan nyid ldan pa zhig tu 'gyur bar g.yo zol med par brtson pa byas te/ ji skad du/ sdom 'byung las/ snying rje med cing khro la gdug / khengs dang ma bsdams rnam g.yeng can/ / ma rungs rmongs pa snyom las can/ / gzhan gyi srog la brtse ba bral/ /47

tho'i masngo sa rngo sa pa che 44'i maphag dza'ipha rol rdzas la mngon par zhen/ / bla mas rtag tu spang bar bya/ / zhes dang /rim lnga las/ bla ma la brnyas sgyu can dad pa med/ / sngags kyis rlom zhing glegs bam mthong bas khengs/ / dad pa med dang dbang bskur dman pa la/ /gdams pa'i rim pa'ang de la brjod mi bya/ / zhes gsungs pa dag las slob ma'i skyon bstan pa rnams 'jungs pa med par mig gi rdul dang / lam kha'i rtswa/ gser gseb kyi rdo ltar dor nas snod du rung ba'i slob ma zhig tu 'gyur ba'i thad la sha 'bad rus 'bad bya dgos/ gal srid gong smos kyi snod du mi rung ba'i slob ma'i skyon de dag mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin 'dor mi thub pa rnams bla ma dag gis slob mar 'dzin zhing gdams ngag kyang ston pa sogs byed mi rung ba yin zhing / yang skyon yon 'dres pa la dad pa sogs khongs nas don gnyer ldan pa zhig yin tshe/ slob ma de ni mtshan nyid thams cad ma tshang ba zhig yin na yang bla ma rnams kyis rjes su 'dzin par rigs te/ spyi rgyud las/ slob ma yan lag ma nyams dang / / lhag par yon tan ldan pa dang / / nad med rigs ni btsun pa dang / / dad cing brtul zhugs ldan pa dkon/ / dkon mchog gsum la gang dad cing / / theg pa chen po'i lugs la dga'/ / bsod nams ldan pa'i sems can ni/ / chen po de dag mdor bzung ngo / / bde gshegs gsang sngags sgrub pa la/ / don gnyer brtson pa slob ma ni/ / gzugs ngan yon tan mi ldan yang / / blo dang ldan pas gzhug parakhya/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des deng gi snyigs ma'i dus 'dir slob ma mtshan nyid yongs su tshang zhing de'i yan lag gi zur tsam yang ma nyams la/lhag par du mdo sngags la thos bsam byas pa'i yon tan ldan pa dang / nad med cing rigs btsun pa/ dad pa dang brtul zhugs ldan pa bcas kyi slob ma 48

waṃle wāzhi pa gdams ngag gi khri tshulata'ini nyin mo'i skar ma ltar shin tu dkon pas/ dkon mchog gsum la zhe thag pa nas dad cing / theg pa chen po'i lugs la thos bsam sgom gsum gyis 'jug par dga' ba dang / chos dang bla ma mtshan nyid ldan pa dag la mjal ba'i bsod nams ldan pa'i sems can zhig yin na ni/ de'i rigs kun bla ma rnams kyis slob mar 'dzin dgos tshul mngon par bstan yod do/ /ji ltar bsten pa'i tshul ni/ bshad pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa rin po che lta bu'i dpon slob tshogs pa na/ thog mar yas mas su 'brel bar brtag pa ni ci nas kyang gal che ste/ bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ bla ma dang ni slob ma dag /mtshungs par dam tshig nyams 'gyur bas/ / dpa' bos dang por slob dpon dang / /slob ma'i 'brel bar brtag par bya/ / zhes dang / phyag chen thig le las/ de lta bu yi bla ma yis/ / 'bad pas slob ma brtag par bya/ / ji ltar sreg la sogs pas gser/ / brtag mkhas pas ni rin po che/ / ji ltar bde ldan bu ma ni/ / de ltar slob ma brtag par bya/ / de bas thams cad rab 'bad de/ / phan tshun so sor brtag par bya/ / de ltar min na skyon du 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / khyad par gsang sngags kyi bla mas slob mar ma brtags par su rung la dbang bskur na snod min gyis dam tshig mi thub pas 'di phyi gnyis kar phung zhing dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ba dang / rang gi dngos grub kyang rgyang ring du byed pa dang bgegs kyi 'tshe ba sogs nyes pa mang du 'byung la/ slob mas kyang bla ma'i mtshan nyid la ma brtags par gang rung las dbang blangs na phog pa'i bshes gnyen gyis bslus par 'gyur ba dang / dam tshig bsrung mi nus pas dngos grub kyi rtsa ba chad pa dang / lam ngan par dkri bas dal 'byor chud 'dza' ba sogs kyi nyes dmigs mang du 'byung ba yin no/ /49

dza'i ma sa rngogs sda che yo'i ma zhagadza'i dngos su bsten pa'i tshul ni/ sdud pa las/ de lta bas na byang chub dam pa 'tshol ba yi/ / bsam pa drag ldan mkhas pas nga rgyal nges bcom ste/ /nad pa'i tshogs kyis gso phyir sman pa bsten pa ltar/ / g.yel ba med par dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten par bya/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thar pa bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang dam pa don du gnyer bar 'dod pa'i bsam pa gting tshugs pas g.yo dang sgyu med par bsnyen bkur ba'o/ / de la yongs grags su bsam pas bsnyen bkur ba zhes bya'o/ / sbyor bas bsnyen bkur ba ni/mdo sde rgyan las/ rnyed pa bkur sti dag dang rim gro dang / / sgrub pa'i sgo nas bshes gnyen bsten par bya/ / zhes don gsum du gsungs pa'i dang po rnyed pa stob pa yin/ bza' ba dang bgo ba dngul sogs yod cing 'byor na ji ltar bzhed pa bzhin spro ba dang bcas pas bla ma'am slob dpon la phul/ der ma zad rang nyid kyi bu dang chung ma dang rang gi lus tshun chad kyang bla ma slob dpon la 'bul dgos par gsungs/ bkur ste'i rim pa ni mthong phyag dang /ldang ba dang / bsngags pa brjod pa la sogs pa rtag tu gus pa'i spyod lam bsten cing / bla ma slob dpon gyi sku'i grib ma tsam la'ang 'gom par mi bya na gzhan la lta ci smos te na bza' bzhugs gdan nyer spyad mchil lham bzhon pa gzungs ma la sogs pa la bkas ma gnang bar mi 'gom mi spyad cing spyan sngar nyal bsnyes mchil snabs 'dor ba dang lkog tu bsngags pa ma yin pa brjod pa la sogs pa ma gus pa'i spyod lam rnam pa thams cad du spang dgos/ de nas rim gro bya ba ni/ phyag sngon du 'gro bas khrus bku mnye dril phyis sogs 'phral gyi bya ba thams cad zhi des dang yid gzhungs par bya dgos/ sgrub pa'i sgo nas bsten pa ni/ bla mas bsgo ba thams cad la sgrub pa bka' blo bde ba dang /50

༷:sa6) mchi 4gi zubapo ga rna zugichos bstan pa thams cad la thos bsam sgom pa sogs ci rigs par nan tan gyis sgrub pa ni snga ma rnams las kyang bsnyen bkur shrī mchog ste yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen sgrub pa'i mchod pas mnyes par bya ba yin gyi/ rnyed sogs kyis ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ / de 'dra zhig yin te/ sdong po bkod pa las/khyod kyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'tshol ba la yongs su mi skyo bar bya'o/ / rnyed nas kyang de'i rjes su sgrub pa la bsnyel ba med pa'i sri zhu bya'o/ / khur thams cad kyis mi skyo bas sa lta bu'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ / ci bsgo ba nyan pa bran lta bu'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gong smos kyi de ltar bsten pa'i dgos pa ni/ ji skad du/ tshangs spyod ril po ma 'dres yongs rdzogs dag / da lta bshes gnyen nga bsten sdug bsngal las/ / grol ba'i rigs pa ltos zhes rgyal bas gsungs/ / zhes pa ltar/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pas tshangs par spyod pa ril po dang ma 'dres pa yongs su rdzogs pa dang shin tu rnam par dag pa'i bar du 'gyur ba dang / da lta dge ba'i bshes gnyen nga bsten pas srid pa'i sdug bsngal las tshegs med par grol ba'i rigs pa'am dpe la ltos zhes rgyal ba ston pa thugs rje can des legs par gsungs shing gdams par mdzad de/ mdo las/ kun dga' bo 'di lta ste/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang dge ba'i grogs po tshangs par spyod pa yongs su rdzogs pa yin no/ / zhes dang / bshes springs las/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa tshangs par spyod/ / yongs su rdzogs par thub pas gsungs de'i phyir/ / dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten bgyi bshes gnyen la/ /bsten nas rab tu mang pos zhi ba thob/ / ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / de las gzhan yang mdo rgyud rnams las dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa'i phan yon 51

'ji ma' sa rdzo sa ba che 0sdo'i ma gatho'imang po mtha' yas pa zhig gsungs te/ sdong po bkod pa las/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su zin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni ngan 'gror mi lhung / bya ba ma yin pa rnams khong du chud par mi byed/ bag med pa'i gnas las zlog 'khor ba'i grong khyer nas 'don/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa las 'gal bar mi byed/ 'jig rten thams cad las mngon par 'phags/ las dang nyon mongs pas thub par dka'o/ / rigs kyi bu de lta bas na de ltar yid la byed pa rgyun ma chad pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi drung du 'gro bar bya'o/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/ de'i lung rnams kyi don bsdus ni klong chen rab 'byams pa dri med 'od zer gyi zhal nas/bla ma bsten pa'i yon tan mtha' yas te/ / yang dag lam chud blang dor dmigs rnam phyed/ / tshogs rdzogs sgrib sbyangs bar chad rab zhi zhing / / rang yangaskye bo dam pa'i gnas thob nas/ / myur du thar pa'i grong du phyin pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di yin par bshad do/ / gzhan yang bsten tshul log na/tshe 'dir nad dang gdon du mas 'tshe ba dang phyi mar ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa myong ba dang / yon tan ma skyes pa rnams mi skye/ skyes pa rnams kyang nyams par 'gyur bas na/ lag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud las/ gsang ba'i bdag po slob dpon la slob mas ji ltar blta bar bya zhe na/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la ji lta ba de bzhin du'o/ / zhes dang / theg pa chen po'i mdo sde dang 'dul ba las kyang de ltar gsungs yod pas skyon rtog gi blo spangs te sangs rgyas las lhag pa'i gus pa chen pos bsten par bya'o/ / bla ma mchod pa'i phan yon kyang bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ gsang 'dus las/phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas mchod pa bas/ bla ma'i ba spu'i khung bu 52

༷:༷6) gi cab /ska' la na zugigacig mchod pa bsod nams che'o/ /zhes dang / dpal 'byung ba'i mdo las/dge ba'i bshes gnyen mgu bar byas na sangs rgyas kyi byang chub thob bo/ /zhes sogs 'byung zhing / mdor na bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs pa dang / rkyen ngan pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / dpal dang 'byor ba che ba dang / myur du sangs rgyas thob pa sogs mthong ba dang / ma mthong ba'i chos kyi yon tan dpag tu med pa thob bo/ /sa bcad gsum pa/ gnas kyi mtshan nyid/ de yang gnas kyi mtshan nyid ni/ o rgyan rin po che'i zhal nas/ nyams su len pa la gnas khyad par can gal che ste/ mtshan nyid dang mi ldan pas rkyen dang bar chad 'byung bas gnas khyad par can gyi mtshan nyid brtags pa ni/ lung stong ni dge sbyor 'phel ba'o/ / ri rtse ni shes pa gsal ba'o/ / dur khrod ni skyo shas skye ba'o/ /shin tu dben pa ni nyams len 'phel ba'o/ / dwangs shing mtho ba ni dbyings rig gsal ba'o/ / gnas khyad par can de rnams su phyin pa la dgos ched gnyis te/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug go / gnas skabs su dge sbyor ngang gis 'phel ba'i dgos pa yod/ mthar thug tu dbyings rig la myur du brtan pa thob pa'i dgos pa yod do/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ spyir sgrub pa snying por mdzad pa'i gnas ni sgrub pa po'i yid dang rnam par mthun pa dang / dgra rkun la sogs pa'i gnod pa dang 'tshe ba med pa/ skye bo'i rgyu 'grul dang ca co 'ur zing sogs kyi rnam g.yeng chung ba/ sa phyogs yul phyogs bkra shis pa/ yul lha gzhi bdag chos la dkar ba/ bla ma dang mkha' 'gro lkedang grub thob gong ma sogs skyes chen dam pa'i zhabs kyis 53

dza〉 ma' sa casdo sa sda 3) bsgo:sdi ma tsan tho'ibacags shing byin gyis brlabs pa/ gangs ri dang / g.ya' ri/ dur khrod/mtsho gling / nags khrod/ lung stong / brag ri sogs rang bzhin gyis rig pa dwangs pa/ sa phyogs mtho ba/ shar gyi mdangs 'phro zhing nub kyi zer sdud pa zhes nyi ma snga mor 'char zhing phyi mor nub pas tshe ring ba/ chu 'jam zhing nyams dga' ba/ mthun rkyen thams cad rnyed par sla ba la sogs pa'i gnas ni mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i gnas yin pas/ de 'dra'i gnas su sgrub pa snying por mdzad na yar skyed chen po 'byung ste/ klong gsal las/ lung stong gangs khrod ri rtse dur khrod dam/ / shin tu dben zhing dwangs mtho bsil ba'i sar/ /skal ldan skyes bus nyams len byed pa'i gnas/ / bsam gtan 'phel zhing brtan pa myur du thob/ / mtshan ldan gnas bral rkyen dbang myur du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / —sa bcad bzhi pa/ dus kyi mtshan nyid/dus kyi mtshan nyid ni/ o rgyan rin po che'i zhal nas/ dbyar ma ston dang / dgun tha chung / dpyid dus su na bun dang / 'tshub ma dang bser bu med pa'i nam mkha' shin tu dwangs pa'i dus su dbyings rig gsal ba'o/ /khyad par du ngo sprod pa'i dus ni/ zer gnyis kyi dus su shin tu gsal ba'o/ /de ltar dus khyad par can la yon tan gnyis te/ gnas skabs su ngo sprod pa mgyogs/ mthar thug tu nyams kyi 'phel ba che'o/ / zhes gsungs shing / de bzhin du dus dang / tshes/ grangs/ gza' skar sogs shin tu bzang ba'i dus su 'jug dgos pa dang / khyad par du thod rgal bsgom par 'os shing rigs pa'i dus ni/ klong gsal las/ ngo sprod dus kyi khyad par ni/ / mkhas 54

0min6sgo phabaḥsgo la ga rgyu sapharag shā pas dus gnad batrel bar bya/ / zhes dang / dbyar ma ston dang dgun chung dpyid kyi dus/ / zer gnyis dus ni mchog tu bshad pa yin/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de 'dra'i dus ni mtshan nyid ldan pa zhig yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ dus der bsil drod snyoms pa'i dbang gis byings rmugs kyi rkyen nyung zhing / bye brag nyi ma 'char ba dang nub pa'i 'od zer gnyis te/ de'i skabs sam gnas ni ye shes 'char ba'i rkyen du 'gyur bas ngo sprod kyi dus su bshad pa'o/ / de las ldog pa ni/ ji skad du/ mkhas pas dus gnad bsten par ma byas na/ / ngo bo 'gas shing nyams len 'phel dang bral/ / zhes gsungs pa lta bu yin pas/ mtshan nyid ldan pa'i dus kyi gnad bsten pa'ang gal bo che la nan tan bya dgos pa zhig yin tshul rang bzhin gyis rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /sa bcad lnga pa/ yo byad kyi mtshan nyid/yo byad kyi mtshan nyid ni/ o rgyan rin po che'i zhal nas/ gdams pa khyad par can zhu ba la yo byad cha tshang bar dgos te/ de ma tshang na mkha' 'gro'i chad pa 'byung bas yo byad tshang bar bsags pa ni/ phyag rten dang /dbang yon dang / tshogs 'khor dang / gtor ma'i rgyu dang / rang gi khams gsol dang / dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad tshogs pa bsags dgos/ de ltar bsags pa la dgos ched gnyis te/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug go / gnas skabs su gdams ngag lon cing mthar thug dngos grub thams cad thob pa'o/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'tsho ba'i yo byad bza' btung gos stan dang / bsten pa'i yo byad dam rdzas/ mkho ba'i yo byad rdo rje dril bu sogs/mthun pa'i yo byad sman dang rten 'brel gyi rdzas/ khyad par gyi yo byad dbang 55

dza'i mayos rdzogs sda che sto'i mgazha 'ji yon dang gtor tshogs kyi rgyu la sogs pa ste/ mdor na gang gi phyir yang gnas skabs de dag tu brel mi dgos par gong du tshogs par bya ba ste/ klong gsal las/ gsang sngags thab sa kyi lam yin phyir/ / rten 'brel yo byad rdzas rnams bsag / ces dang phyag rten dbang yon gtor tshogs rgyu/ / nyams len dus su khams kyi rten so btsal/ / mthun pa'i yo byad kun dang ldan par bya/ / rten 'brel rdzas med dngos grub yal bar dor/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gong gsal gyi yo byad 'di dag tshang bar ma bsags na dngos grub 'dod pa rnams la dngos grub til 'bru tsam yang mi thob pa ma zad/ da dung mkha' 'gro'i chad pa 'byung ba'i nyen kha yang yod pas/ yo byad de dag tshang bar gsog pa'i las la 'bad dgos so/ /sa bcad drug pa/ grogs kyi mtshan nyid/grogs kyi mtshan nyid ni/ a ti rdzogs pa chen po'i chos sam gdams pa'i rjes su 'brang ba zhig yin na/ rang nyid rgyun par 'grogs par bya ba'i grogs sam mi ni dam tshig gtsang zhing dri ma med pa ldan pa dang / dag snang che ba/ nyon mongs dug lnga shugs chung ba/ blo brtan zhing khog yangs pa ngang rgyud ring zhing zab lam bsgoms pa'i nyams myong yod pa/ rgyud zhi zhing dul ba/brtse sems che ba la sogs pa'i yon tan lhan skyes su yod pa zhig ci nas kyang yin dgos te/ klong gsal las/ dam tshig gtsang ldan dag pa'i snang ba che/ /dug lnga shugs chung blo brtan khog yangs pa/ / ngang rgyud ring zhing brtse ba'i grogs dang 'grogs/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de 'dra'i mtshan nyid ldan pa'i grogs dang 'grogs na chos la 'jug par skul lcag 'debs shing /56

chos min gyi spyod pa la 'jug pa las ldog par byed pa dang / de la brten nas mthar byang chub 'thob par gyur te/ klong gsal las/ dam pa'i grogs kyis chos ldan byang chub 'thob/ / ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / de ltar nyams len gyi sgrom du 'jug pa'i cha rkyen thams cad phun sum tshogs pa zhig dgos so/ / / /

le'u lnga pa/ thun mong phyi'i sngon 'gro/de yang thun mong phyi'i sngon 'gro 'di ni snga rabs mkhas grub dam pa rnamasakli gsung rgyun las cung tsam yang 'da' ba med par smra ba'i ro 'dzin g.yo ba'i zlos gar du zhugs na/ de la ldang ba'i rnal 'byor dang / blo sbyong ba'i rim pa ste gnyis yod do/ /sa bcad dang po/ tho rangs ldang ba'i rnal 'byor/de yang tho rangs mal nas ldang ba'i dus su bab pa na/ mdun gyi nam mkhar 'ja' zer 'od phung gi klong na rtsa ba'i bla ma o rgyan mtsho skyes rdo rje'i rnam pa can zhal 'dzum mdangs rgyas pa la 'khor dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba kun gyi phyag na ḍā ma ru dkrol ba'i sgra sngags kyi gdangs su bsgrags pas bskul te gnyid las sad par bsam zhing mal nas har gyis langs shing / skye bo rgyu 'grul dang sgra'i klog spyor la sogs pa bsam gtan la gegs dang bar chad gtan nas mi 'byung ba'i gnas dben pa zhig tu stan bde ba la 'khod pa dang / ma 'ongs pa na rnam pa snang mdzad kyi ngo bor 'tshang rgya ba'i rten 'brel lus la bsgrigs pas rtogs pa sems la 'char ba'i slad du lus rnam par snang mdzad kyi chos bdun dang ldan pa'i tshul gyis mi yo bar drang por bsrangs shing / rkang pa gnyis las g.yon pa 'og dang g.yas pa steng du byas pa'i rdo rje'i skyil krung bca'/ lag pa'i mthe bong gis srin lag gi rtsa ba 58

dza'ile lnga pa mong zi'i smo thobromanan te khu tshur brkyangs pa brla g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi khug par bzhagalag yu drang por bsrangs/ dpung mgo gyen la 'then zhing lhod de brgyang ba/lto ba mdun du phul/ sgal tshigs gser gyi dong tse brtsegs pa ltar drang por bsrangs pa/ ltag rtsa bsrangs te/ mgrin pa ol kos mdud mnan pa trem yud tsam dgug pa/ lce ya rkan la sbyor ba/ mig gnyis mig 'bras mi rgyu zhing rdzi ma'am mig spu thab thib mi byed par sna rtse'i thad kyi bar snang la ce re bzhagamago bo ya yom med par gzeng bya zhing lus kyi cha thams cad hril gyis bsgrims la 'jog dgos te/ ji skad du/ lus ni rdo rje skyil mo krung / / sgal tshigs rin chen gatreng la brgyus/ / thong kha rgyun du yangs pa dang / / stong sko shin tu sba bar bya/ / lce ni ya rkan nyid du gtad/ / mnyam bzhag phyag rgya lte 'og btsir/ / mig dang shes pa ma 'gyur bar/ / rlung sems dril la drag tu gcun/ / rdo rje skyil krung rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de yang rkang pa g.yas steng du bton pa'i rdo rje skyil krung dang / lag pa gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya lte 'og tu bcer ba'i gru mos stod gcun pa dang /mthe bong lto sbyar ba dang / sgal tshigs dong tse brtsegs pa ltar drang por bsrang ba dang / thong kha yangs par byed pa dang / ol skos mdud mnan te mgrin pa bya ngang pa'i mgrin pa ltar dgug pa dang / lce ya rkan la sbyar ba dang /mig gnyis sna rtse'am yang na thad ka'i bar snang la blta ba bcas bya'o/ / de las rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung du sdod pa'i dgos pa ni/ phyi bdud bzhi 'joms/nang bar chad sel/ gsang ba 'khor ba'i rtsa bzhi dbu mar 'jug pa/ de kho na nyid gzung 'dzin gnyis nub pa/ mthar thug myur bar 'tshang rgya ba'i 'dug stangs te/ de ltar bsdad pas thur sel gyi rlung rtsa dbu mar chud 59

tho'i ma chos rngogs sda che bsdo'i ma galde'ipa'o/ /lag pa mnyam bzhag lte 'og tu bcer ba'i dgos pa ni/ rtsa dbu ma ut+pal gzhon nu kha 'byed pa dang / rgod ma kha hūṃ sgra sgrogs pa/ tshangs pa'i me sbar ba ste/ de ltar byas pas mnyam gnas kyi rlung rtsa dbu mar chud pa'o/ /mthe bong lto sbyar ba'i dgos pa ni/ rig pa rtse gcig tu sdud pa/ khams gsum dbang du byed pa/ gzhan snang zil gyis gnon pa'o/ / sgal tshigs gser gyi dong rtse brtsegs pa ltar bsrang ba'i dgos pa ni/ lus drang bas rtsa drang / rtsa drang bas khams drang / khams drang bas rlung drang / drang po bzhi'i rten 'brel gyis srog 'dzin rlung rtsa dbu ma'am rang gnas su chud pa'o/ /mgrin pa cung zad dgug pa'i dgos pa ni/ rlung gi sgo 'phrang gcod pa dang /kos kos ol mdud gnon pa/ steng rlung rab tu non pa/ ting nge 'dzin mi rtog pa skye ba ste/ gyen rgyu'i rlung rtsa dbu mar chud pa'o/ / mig sna rtser dbab pa'i dgos pa ni/ dmigs pa byings rgod spong dang / rig par gsal cha bskyed pa/ nang gi 'byung ba snyoms pa/ tshul bzhin yid la byed pa ste/ khyab byed kyi rlung rtsa dbu mar chud pa'o/ / lce rkan la sbyar ba'i dgos pa ni/ rkan gyi ba 'jo ba dang / khams gso ba/ tshe dang lus kyi bcud len sgrub pa/ lce bde ba ste/ so dang mchu cung zad ma reg pa tsam bya/ dbugs dal bur rgyu/ ro stod dgye tsam bya'o/ / gzhan yang sngar bzhin la/ lus tsog pu re'u mig bzhin bsnol ba/ sgom thag khug pas mgo bo 'khor ba'i tshad de/ des lham sgrog chings nas lus bsdams/ mtshang ra'i gdan du 'bebs gdan khru gang /dpangs su sor bzhi yod pa nang tshangs can byed dgos par gsungs so/ / de dag gi dgos pa yid la nges par byas nas gong du smras pa ltar 'jog pa gces su 'dzin par bya ste/ de ltar 'jog dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/60

dza'ile sku sda 'a nga phyi'i spo lhunalus ni grong khyer dang 'dra/ rtsa ni lam srang dang 'dra/ rlung ni rta dang 'dra/rnam shes ni mi zha bo dang 'dra bas byed pa bcings na gsang sgo khegs pas/mi rta nang du tshud de 'gro mi thub pa dang mtshungs te/ dper na sbrul la yan lag yod kyang ma gcur na mi gsal ba dang 'dra bas na/ lus kyi gnad dang chun khyer yong ba'i thabs byas pas ye shes kyi snang ba rnams gong nas gong du 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang chabs cig tu rten 'brel lus la bsgrigs pas rtogs pa sems la 'char ba'i dgos pa khyad par can yod ces gsungs/gong gi de ltar lus gnad khrig ge bcas zin mtshams de nas thun gyi thog mar rlung ro dgu phrugs dang / 'og ma rnams su rlung ro sum phrugs su 'bud par bya'o/ /rlung ro dgu phrugs su 'bud tshul ni/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur bcings pa'i mthe bong gis las rlung rgyu ba'i lam srin lag gi rtsa mnan zhing /lag pa g.yas pa'i khu tshur gyis brla g.yas pa'i rtsa bo che mnan/ lag pa g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyi mdzub mos sna bug g.yon pa bkag ste/ sna bug g.yas nasarlung ro phyir 'bud pa dang / yang lag pa g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis brla g.yas pa'i rtsa bo che mnan zhing / lag pa g.yas pa'i khu tshur gyi mdzub mos sna bug g.yas pa bkag ste/ sna bug g.yon nas rlung ro phyir 'bud/ de ltar sna bug g.yon nas rlung ro che 'bring chung gsum dang / sna bug g.yas nas rlung ro che 'bring chung gsum bcas re re lan gsum gsum 'bud/ yang lag pa gnyis kyi khu tshur gyis las rlung rgyu ba'i lam brla g.yas g.yon gyi rtsa mnan/sna bug gnyis nas rlung ro che 'bring chung gsum re re ste lan gsum 'bud pa ste rlung ro dgu phrugs su 'bud par bya'o/ / rlung ro dgu phrugs su 'bud pa'i 61

tho'i ma' sa rngo sa pa che bsdo'i ma tho〉dus su dmigs pa ci yang med par 'bud pa ni 'os pa zhig min pas/ de'i tshe dmigs pa ni/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib gegs dang bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad 'ub kyis 'dus nas sna sgo'i rlung dang 'grogs te phyir sang sang song bas/ mdor na lus nang bshal ba ltar gyur ro snyam du bsam/ 'di ni dper na bcud bzang po zhig blug par byed pa la snga logs su snod bkru bshal byed pa dang 'dra gsungs/ mdor na sna bug g.yas pa nas rlung ro lan gsum 'bud skabs zhe sdang gi rlung dkar smag smag phyir sang gis thon te sor bcu drug gi mtshams kyi mdun gyi bar snang la yal bar bsam pa la tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas zhe sdang gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags nad gdon dang bcas pa lhag med du dag par bsam/ sna bug g.yon pa nas rlung ro lan gsum 'bud skabs 'dod chags kyi rlung dmar smag smag phyir sang gis thon te sor bcu drug gi mtshams kyi mdun gyi bar snang la yal bar bsam la/ tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas 'dod chags kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags nad gdon dang bcas pa lhag med du dag par bsam/ sna bug gnyis nas rlung ro lan gsum 'bud pa'i skabs su gti mug gi rlung sngo smag smag phyir sang gis thon te sor bcu drug mtshams kyi mdu na gyi bar snang du yal bar bsam la/ tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas gti mug gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags nad gdon dang bcas pa lhag med du dag par bsam/ de ltar lan gsum gyi mthar cung zad ngal gso zhing shes pa rnal du dbab par bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems kyi kun slong legs par bca' dgos shing / de 62

dza'ibe lnga pa moja byi'i sngo gni nyams len rgyun 'khyer la mtshon na gnad che shas shig yin te/ yid bzhin mdzod las/ khyad par theg chen dge ba rlabs po che/ / sbyor ba sems bskyed sagazhi dmigs pa med/ / rjes la bsngo bas yongs su zin pa ni/ / thar lam bgrod pa'i gces pa rnam gsum nyid/ / ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ dge ba che chung gang dang gang zhig byed na'ang dam pa rnam gsum gyi rtsis zin pa ha cang gal che'o/ /de yang dam pa rnam gsum zhes pa ni/ dge rtsa thabs kyis zin pa sbyor ba sems bskyed dam pa dang / dge ba rkyen gyis mi bshig pa dngos gzhi dmigs med dam pa dang / dge ba gong 'phel du 'gro ba mjug bsngo ba dam pa ste gsum mo/ /dang po dge rtsa thabs kyis zin par byed pa spyor ba sems bskyed dam pa ni/ dge sems rgya chen por 'gyur ba la dge rtsa thabs kyis zin pa'i sbyor ba sems bskyed dam pa ni med du mi rung ba zhig yin par gsungs/ de yang sems bskyed ji ltar rgya che na dge ba yang de ltar rgya che zhing / sems bskyed ji ltar rgya chung na dge ba yang de ltar rgya chung ba zhig yin te/ bsam pa dge dang mi dge'i 'phan byed las/ / dge sdug gzugs brnyan che chung rjes mi 'gro/ /zhes dang / spyod 'jug las/ sems thasal gcig bskyed 'bras bu gang / /tshangs la sogs pa yin pa ltar/ / lus ngag bcas pa'i 'bras bu yang / / spyod pa zhan pas de lta min/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na/ rang nyid gcig pur phan pa'i ched du chos nyan pa dang sgrub pa yin na/ de 'dra'i sems bskyed rgya shin tu chung ba zhig yin pas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bsams shing / de ltar bsams pa ni rgya che ba theg chen gyi sems bskyed yin no/ / de'i 63

dza'i ma chos rdzogs pa che yo'i mgazha dza'iphyir thog mar kun slong legs par bca' dgos shing / de 'dra'i kun slong la'ang bsam pa rgya che ba byang chub sems kyi kun slong dang thabs rgya che ba gsang ba sngags kyi kun slong gnyis yod do/ / de las dang po bsam pa rgya che ba byang chub sems kyi kun slong ni/ thog ma med pa'i dus nas bdag 'dzin 'di'i dbang gis rang don zhig bsams kyang ci yang ma 'grub par da dung 'khor ba na 'khyams pa 'di la ltos/ da ni gzhan don kho na la bsams te chos nyan pa dang bsgrub byas pas kyang rang don zhor la 'grub cing / gzhan don yongs su 'grub pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lta bu zhig tu 'ong ste/ dper na me 'dod nas bud shing bsregs nas me dngos su byung tshe drod dang du ba mi 'dod bzhin zhor la 'byung ba lta bu yin te/ rgyal sras zhi ba lha'i zhal las/mang du bshad lta ci zhig dgos/ / byis pa rang gi don byed pa/ / thub pas gzhan gyidon byed pa/ / 'di gnyis kyi ni khyad par ltos/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ sems bskyed de yang rtsa ba snying rje las skye dgos shing / snying rje de yang sems can thams cad la dmigs nas skye dgos pas/ 'di ltar bsam par bya ste/ nam mkhas gar khyab sems can gyis khyab cing / sems can gyis gar khyab las dang nyon mongs sdug bsngal gsum gyis yongs ba dang / de 'dra'i sdug bsngal gyis khyab pa'i 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyis bdag gi pha dang ma ma byas pa gcig kyang med/ skye ba brje len byas pas da lta de dag rang gi pha ma yin par ngo ma shes kyang / sems can re res sems can gzhan re re'i pha dang ma ste pha ma byas pa'i grangs ni thug pa med pas/ sems can thams cad lta ci smos/ tha na dud 'gro be'u lug skyes ma thag pa tshos mang po'i nang nas rang rang gi ma gang yin pa 'khrul ba med par ngo shes pa de yang thog 64

dza'ile lnga sda mong phyi'i sngo 'akro ma med pa nas bag chags yod pa'i dbang gis yin pa ni su zhig gis kyang bsnyon par mi nus te/ sngon gyi dus na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pa byon pa'i lam kha zhig tu rgan mo zhig yod cing / des sangs rgyas mthong ma thag tu bu bu zhes 'bod bzhin brgyugs nas sangs rgyas kyi mgul du 'khyud de dga' dga' byed par rtsom pa na/ dge slong rnams kyis rgan mo de bkag go / bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di tshe rabs lnga brgya'i bar du brgyud mar nga'i ma byas pa'i bag chags dran pa yin pas/ khyed rnams kyis ma 'gog ces gsungs pa lta bu yin pa'i phyir te/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis kyang / ma yi thug mtha' rgya shug tshig gu tsam/ / ril bur dril kyang sa yis langs mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / chos rgyal in+d+ra bhu ti'i zhal las/ pha dang ma ru ma gyur pa'i/ /sems can gang yang yod ma yin/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar ma ngo shes nas drin dran dgos shing / pha mar gyur pa'i dus su da lta'i pha ma bzhin dang po du bskyed/ bar du skyes nas gces spras sna tshogs kyis ni legs par bskyangs/ zas kyi phud ni byin/ gos kyi rtses ni legs par g.yogs/ shin tu byams pa'i sgo nas skyed bsrings pa yin/ tha na khra dang spyang ki rnams kyis kyang rang gi phru gu rnams byams sems kyis skyong ba la ltos dang / smra shes don go ba'i mi yi pha ma rnams kyis lta ci smos/ de yang pha mar gyur pa'i dus su yag dga' nyes sdug skyid sdug gi re dogs dang / bu brgyud kyi don du chags sdang gi las ngan bsags nas rigs drug gi gnas na sdug bsngal myong bzhin yod pa'i pha ma sems can thams cad ngo ma shes shing gnyen po dman pas/ pha ma bsad pa'i grangs kyang bgrang gis mi langs pa dang / las ni ma byas pa dang ma myong ba bya ba gcig kyang med de/ kun mkhyen 'jigs meska gling pas/65

dza'i ma chos rngogs la che yo'i ma gadza'i khyad par sems can thams cad pha dang mar/ / phan tshun res mos yin la the tshom med/ / de phyir da lta'i pha mar chags bzhin du/ / tshe rabs snga ma'i pha ma gsod pa 'di/ / smra shes don go mi yi rnam thar du/ / 'dug pas blo sems nang du khug la soms/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / srid pa thog ma med pa'i dus nas bdag la shin tu brtse ba tshad med pa'i sgo nas rang gi srog las kyang gces shing phangs par byas te drin chen pos yang yang skyong bar byed pa'i drin can gyi ma rgan rigs drug gi sems can 'di rnams/ spyir 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang khyad par ngan song gi sdug bsngal shugs drag la rgyun ring pos mnar bzhin pa lags na/ de la ci yang mi sems par rang nyid gcig pu'i don du mtho ris kyi bde ba don du gnyer ba dang / der ma zad nyan rang dgra bcom gnyis kyi go 'phang lta bu'i thar pa des kyang ci zhig bya ste/ pha ma rnams bde thabs la mi brtson par rang zhi bde gnyer ba ni shin tu khrel bor ba skyes bu chen po rnams kyis smad pa'i gnas theg chen gyi gol sa tha chad pa yin/ da res tshul de lta bu'i gnad rnams ji bzhin du go zhing / theg pa chen po'i lam zab mo dang mjal ba'i dus 'dir/ mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad srid pa las bsgral te sangs rgyas 'thob par bya ba'i phyir du/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis thugs ji ltar bskyed pa bzhin du bdag gis kyang byang chub tu sems bskyed par bya'o snyam du byang chub kyi sems khyad par can ci nas kyang bsgom dgos te/ dngul chu thogs med kyis/ thog med dus nas bdag la brtse ba can/ / ma rnams sdug na rang bdes ci zhig bya/ / de phyir mtha' yas sems can bsgral bya'i phyir/ / byang chub sems bskyed rgyal sras lag len yin/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de yang sngar pha mar gyur pa'i 66

tho〉le lnga la mong sbya'i sngo lhunasems can de rnams kyis bde ba kho na nyid 'dod kyang bde ba'i rgyu chos dge ba bcu sgrub mi shes pa dang / sdug bsngal gtan nas mi 'dod kyang de'i rgyu mi dge ba bcu spang mi shes par lag len dang zhe 'dod phyin ci log tu song nas/'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du dbang med par lhung / gti mug gi mun mthug pos yongs su bsgribs/ yang dag pa'i lam ston gyi bshes gnyen dang gtan nas bral/ skyabs dang skyob pa mgon dang dpung gnyen re ltos dang skyabs gnas ci yang med de/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ sdug bsngal 'dor 'dod sems yod kyang / / sdug bsngal nyid la mngon par rgyug / bde ba 'dod kyang gti mug pas/ / rang gi bde ba dgra ltar 'joms/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / lam log mgo rmongs su gyur pa long ba thang dkyil du lus pa lta bu'i ma rgan sems can 'di rnams snying re rje snyam du zhe thag pa nas bsam dgos/ de lta bu'i sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje ni/ sems bskyed skye ba'i rgyu ma nor ba dang / byang chub kyi sems ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu yin te/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu ni byang chub kyi sems so/ / rtsa ba ni snying rje chen po'o/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/al rnams kyis snying rje'i bsam pas sems can thams cad bde ba la 'god pa'i slad du lus srog gtong phod pa lta zhog tha na thun re re tsam yang snying rje bsam pa rgyud la skye mkhan dkon par 'dug pas/ de 'dra la rnam mkhyen ni lta zhog tha na thar pa'i re ba tsam yang med/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'khor gnas 'dir sdug bsngal che chung ji snyed cig yod pa de rnams bdag bde bar 'dod pa'i rang gces 'dzin las byung zhing / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bde ba mthar thug pa sogs 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phan bde ci 67

dza'i ma chos rdzo sa sda che yo'i mgazhagadza'iyod thams cad ni gzhan gces par 'dzin pa'i gzhan phan gyi sems las byung ba yin te/ rgyal sras lag len so bdun las/ sdug bsngal ma lus bdag bde 'dod las byung / / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gzhan phan sems las 'khrungs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ sngon pa'i dbang po nyid rgyal po pad+ma bya bar 'khrungs tshe/ dus re zhig na khong gi mnga' ris su nad yams chen po byung nas mi mang po shi bas/ rgyal pos sman pa rnams bos nas/ 'di la cis phan dris pas/ de dag na re/ nya ro hi ta'i sha yod na phan/ gzhan gang zhig phan pa yang nad grib kyis rmugs nas mi shes par 'dug pas/ rgyal pos dus la bab pa'i snga dror khrus byas/ gos gsar pa gyon/ gso sbyong blangs/dkon mchog la mchod pa rgya chen po phul/ gsol ba drag po btab nas/nad pa la snying shin tu rje ba'i bsam pas/ bdag shi ma thag tu chu klung ldog byed du nya ro hi tar skye bar gyur cig ces smon lam btab nas khang bzang gi kha nas mchongs te lcebs so/ / de ma thag tu sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang gis rgyal po chu klung ldog byed du nya der rdzus te skyes so/ / des mi'i skad du nga nya ro hi ta yin pas nga'i sha zo zhig ces smras pas thams cad kyis sha blangs te/gzhogs gcig gi sha zad pa na gzhogs nas bcad pas/ gcig zad tsa na gcig gi sha skyes nas de ltar res mos kyis zos pas mi thams cad nad las thar bar gyur to/ / dus der mi rnams la khyed rnams kyi don du ngas 'di ltar byas so zhes lo rgyus gsungs shing / drin lan du khyed rnams kyis sdig pa spongs la dge ba ci nus sgrubs shig ces gsungs pas de dag gis kyang bka' bzhin bsgrubs/ de nas bzung ste de dag kyang ngan 'gror ma ltung ngo zhes gsungs so/ / gsung de nyid kyis byang chub don du gnyer ba la bdag bas 68

dzajime lnga pa na moja phyi'i sngo librokhriyigazhan gces pa'i snying rje chen po sbyang dgos pa'i gnas lugs zab mo mngon par bstan/ deng sang gi mi la la zhig gis de ni sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa yin pas/ bdag lta bu'i so skyes kyis mi nus snyam nas sgyid lug par gnas pa yangagor ma chag de ni chos lug 8 sdo pa zhig gi ngos nas bshad na de lta bu'i bsam sbyor yod par mi 'os pa dang / las ci zhig bsgrubs nas 'grub pa la thog mar ngas nus so zhes pa'i snying rus zol med pa dgos la/ de 'dra'i snying rus yod na mi 'grub pa'i bya ba gang yang med de/ sngon gyi gtam rgyud du/bya sa ko khar ko ba gcig gi nang du btsun pa drug dang bang phyin pa gcig rnams zhugs te ko ba btang bas chu'i bzhi cha tsam song ba dang ko mkhan na re/cung ljid 'dug pas rkyal shes pa zhig yod na phyir thon rogs mdzod/ gal srid phyir 'don mkhan med na nga rang phyir 'don par bya'o/ / khyed rang gcig pus rkyal ba zungs zer ba la/ de ga'i mi thams cad kyis rkyal dang rkyal ba 'dzin pa gnyis ka mi shes par lus/ skabs der bang phyin pa de na re/thams cad shi ba las nga gcig pu shi ba dga' zer nas chu la mchongs/ de ma thag 'ja' shar zhing me tog gi char pa babs/ rkyal mi shes kyang sems can skyob pa'i slad du rang srog phangs med du 'dor bar spobs pa'i sems bskyed rnam par dag pa'i dbang gis ma shi bar grags/ mi de sngar chos tsam byas pa'i rigs su mi 'dug skad/ blo rnam par dag pa re res ni de 'dra ba'i dge ba'i las rlabs po che sgrub phod cing 'bras bu de lta bu'ang 'byung bar nus pa yin pas/ de dag la bsam gzhigs yang yang btang nas rang nyid kyi kun slong 'chos pa'i snying stobs bla na med pa bskyed par 'bad dgos pa yin/ de yang yin te/ ji skad du/ bsam pa bzang na sa dang lam yang bzang / /69

dza'i ma chos rdzo sa pa che bsdo'i ma zhagatho'i bsam pa ngan na sa dang lam yang ngan/ / de'i phyir bsam pa dag la rag las pas/ /rtag tu bsam pa bzang la nan tan bya/ / zhes 'byung ba ltar sems can la phan 'dogs pa'i bsam pa bzang po zhig sngon du 'gro ba gal che/gal srid de 'dra sngon du ma song na/ sems bskyed kyi tshig kho na tsam brgya tshar khri tshar longs pa zhig bton na yang / de la brten nas sems bskyed rnal ma zhig skye bar mi nus pas/ dus nam zhig yin kyang bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas sngon gyi rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mdzad spyod rlabs po che la bslab cing 'gro ba kun rigs drug so so'i las snang sdug bsngal bag chags dang bcas pa bral nas/ 'khor ba na sems can gcig kyang mi gnas pa de tsam du brtson 'grus bskyed na byang chub kyi sems de rang rgyud la mi skyed pa'i thabs med snyam du bsam dgos te/ rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa'i zhal nas/ gang la rang don sems pa yod ma yin/ / bkres pas zas dang skom pa chur gdung bzhin/ / sems can 'ba' zhig don du rnam mkhyen gyi/ / go 'phang gnyer la byang chub sems zhes grags/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang gzhan gyi rgyud la byang chub kyi sems ma skyes pa skyed par byed pa dang / skyes pa mi nyams shing gong 'phel du byed pa'i thabs la ltogs pas zas dang skom pa chu la gdung ba lta bu'i don gnyer gyi 'dun pa chen po sus kyang bzlog tu med pa zhig cis kyang dgos pa'o/ / de yang mgon po byams pas/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ / yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ / ces gsungs pa ltar/don gnyis dang ldan pa ste/ gang gi ched du bya ba snying rjes gzhan don la dmigs pa dang / gang gi ched du bya ba shes rab kyi rdzogs byang la dmigs pa 70

dza'ile lnga pa mong byi'i rjo wāganyis po de ma tshang na/ gzhan la phan 'dod tsam dang rdzogs byang thob 'dod tsam ni sems bskyed du mi 'gro ba yin/ o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po'i zhal nas/ blo sbyong blo sbyong rang gi blo 'di sbyong / / byang chub sems kyis rang gi blo sbyangs na/ /lus ngag dge ba sna gcig ma 'grub kyang / / rang gzhan don gnyis ma 'bad shugs kyis 'grub/ / ces gsungs pa ltar/ gzhan gyis mthong du yod pa'i gzugs brnyan mi che yang bsam pa po byang chub kyi sems kyis rgyud sbyangs na nam zhig sgo gsum longs spyod dang bcas pas bya ba ci bsgrubs thams cad theg pa chen po'i lam du ngang gis 'gyur te/ yon tan mdzod las/ sa gzhi bzang pos brten pa'i zhing sa las/ / dge ba'i lo tog phun sum tshogs pa ltar/ / byang chub sems kyi ljon shing srid pa na/ / 'bras bu mang zhing zhi ba'i bar du 'phel/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / gzhan du na/rgyalasras zhi ba lha'i zhal nas/ srid pa'i sdug bsngal brgya phrag gzhom 'dod cing / /sems can mi bde bsal bar 'dod pa dang / / bde mang brgya phrag spyad par 'dod pas kyang / / byang chub sems nyid rtag tu gtang mi bya/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sems can rnams kyis las ngan sna tshogs bsags nas thar pa thob pa'i go skabs bde blag tu rnyed pa ni shin tu dka' ba'i gnas yin pas/ mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad gdon pa'i snying stobs chen po'i go cha brtan po legs par bgo ba ni byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa kho na yin/ de yang byang chub kyi sems la dbye na/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dang / don dam byang chub kyi sems nas gsum dang bzhi dang drug la sogs pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyi bar du dbye sgo shin tu mang yang bsdu na/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems de mdor bsdus na/ / rnam pa gnyis su shes bya 71

tho'i ma chos rdzo sa pa che bsdo'i ma gadza'iste/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ smon pa dang 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems gnyis su nges so/ / de 'dra'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che ni sgrib pa mtha' dag gi gnyen por 'gro zhing sangs rgyas 'thob par byed pa'i rgyu ma nor ba yin te/rgyal sras zhi ba lha'i zhal nas/ 'gro ba'i 'chi bdag 'joms byed pa'i/ /bdud rtsi mchog kyang 'di yin no/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems ni rgyal bas chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa thams cad kyi snying po dril ba/ yod na des chog pa dang / med na thabs chag gi gdams pa/ nad brgya sman gcig sman dkar po chig thub lta bu yin te/rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ 'gro ba'i nad rab zhi byed pa'i sman gyi mchog kyang 'di yin no/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan tshogs bsags pa/ sgrib pa sbyang ba/ lha bsgom pa/ sngags bzla ba la sogs pa'i chos nyams su len pa thams cad kyang byang chub kyi sems yid bzhin gyi nor rin po che 'di rgyud la skye ba'i thabs tsam nyams su len pa yin gyi/ byang chub kyi sems la ma brten par rang rang so so'i lam gyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob mi nus pa dang / byang chub kyi sems 'di rgyud la skyes pa na chos gang bsgrubs thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob pa'i rgyur 'gro ba yin pas/dus dang rnam pa thams cad du rgyud la byang chub kyi sems nyag ma re skye ba'i thabs la sgo du ma nas bslab dgos so/ / gnyis pa thabs rgya che ba gsang ba sngags kyi kun slong ni/ tshul gsum sgron me las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang / / thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / / dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas/ / sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rdo rje theg pa'i skabs 'dir/ 'jug sgo'i lam mang po/ tshogs bsags pa'i 72

dza'ile lnga sda mong phyi'i spo rithabs mang po/ dka' ba chen po rang spyad mi dgos par 'bras bu lon du byed pa'i thabs zab mo yod pa yin te/ thabs zhags las/ gsang sngags tshul chen shin tu rmad byung ni/ / lam gyi nang nas nye lam chen po ste/ / thabs kyi nang nas ma nor dam pa nyid/ / shes rab nang nas shes rab khyad par can/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de yang skabs 'dir stong pa nyid dang snying rje zung du 'brel ba ni shin tu gal bo che la nan tan bya dgos shing / de gnyis zung du ma 'brel na ya bral gyis lam rnam dag tu 'gro bar mi nus te/ 'jam dpal rnam par 'phrul ba las/ stong pa nyid la so sor rtog cing sems can yal bar 'dor ba yang bdud kyi las so/ / shes rab kyis rnam par dpyod cing snying rje chen po la dmigs par 'dzin pa yang bdud kyi las so/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsal cha nas snying rje'i gdangs su su shar yang / stong cha nas zhen pa med pa dgos te/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos/ kun 'dus byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin ni/ / snang ba ma yin snang ba'i chos las 'das/ / stong pa ma yin stong pa'i chos las 'das/ / yod pa ma yin dngos po mtshan ma med/ / med pa ma yin 'khor 'das kun la khyab/ / ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ / de yang tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas gzhan la bsam ngan bsgoms padang sems bskyed go ldog tu spyad pa la sogs pa'i sems dang sems byung thams cad ni sbyang gzhi yin zhing / sems bskyed kyi rnal 'byor ni sbyong byed dang / de gnyis zung 'jug tu nyams su len pa ni don dam pa'i sems bskyed ces bya ba yin la/ de la yongs grags su 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi sems bskyed ces kyang grags so/ / spyir gsang sngags nyams su len pa la bdag sgra sbyar na/ sngags pa zer ba yin phyir/ da lta'i tha mal mtshan 'dzin 73

tho'i ma'adzus rngo sa la che bsgo'i ma zha tho'igyi dngos snang / 'khrul rtog rang ga ma 'di nyid sngar drin ldan gyi bla mas ngo sprad pa'i gshis rig stong rjen pa'i ye shes zang ma thal byung spro bsdu bsal bzhag las 'das pa'i gnas lugs lta ba'i rang mdangs/ dmigs med snying rje'i rtsal snang dag pa rab 'byams sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor ye nas yin pa la yin par shes pa'i nges shes dang ldan na/ lhag bsam rnam dag gi sems dang don dam byang chub kyi sems sogs ming gi rnam grangs mang por bsnyad kyang / don la stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can 'di nyid yin no/ / gzhan yang mar gyur sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral thabs shig byed thub na ci ma rung snyam pa'i snying rje'i mchi ma 'khrug pa re yid la byas na snying rje tshad med ces bya ba'ang de yin/ de tsam bsams pa'i dgos pa'ang bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ bzang spyod las/ nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa ci tsam par/ /sems can ma lus mtha' yang de bzhin te/ / ci tsam las dang nyon mongs mthar gyur pa/ / bdag gi smon lam mtha' yang de tsam mo/ / zhes dang /'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ sems can khams ni tshad med la/ / phan 'dod de ni de 'dra'o/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar snying rje tsam gyis mi chog cing /da dung de'i drin lan 'jal dgos kyang / sems can thams cad bde ba la bkod nas drin lan sod nus pa ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kho na nyid du nges tsa na/ bdag gis de ring chos nyan pa nyams su blangs nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya zhing / pha ma sems can thams cad kyang sa la dgod par bya'o/ / de 'dra zhig nus pa bla ma dkon mchog gsum khyed mkhyen snyam pa ni byed pa don yod du 'gyur bas/ chos nyan dus dang bsgrub dus gang zhig yin yang ma brjed na dge rtsa thabs kyis zin pa spyor ba sems bskyed 74

dza'ile lha pa mong phyi'i smo ribrodam pa yin pas shin tu gal che'o/ /gnyis pa dge ba rkyen gyis mi bshig pa dngos gzhi dmigs med dam pa ni/ chos nyan pa'i dus su rigs kyis sgra la nyan pa lta bu dang / chos bsgrub pa'i dus su g.yag ltogs kyis rtswa za ba lta bu dang / mgo tshugs pa nas mjug mardzogs pa'i bar du kha g.yeng mig g.yeng sogs bag med kyi bya byed thams cad mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin yongs su spangs te nyan pa dang bsgrub par bya dgos/ khyad par du chos zhu ba'i dus su rna ba gtad nas ma nyan na snod kha sbubs kyi steng du bdud rtsi blugs pa bzhin don ci yang sems la mi zin zhing /ngag 'chal bshad na rang gzhan gyis chos nyan pa'i bar chad chos spong gi las su 'gyur ba yin/ chos la nyan pa'i dus su bdud kyi bar chad dang las ngan pa'i rlung 'khrugs te gnyid dang rmugs pa shin tu chen po rang dbang med par 'ong zhing / gnyid rmugs shugs kyis bsad nas chos thams cad yid la nges pa zhig ma byas na/ rang gis nyan pa'i chos de yang go log dang brda log tu 'gyur ba yin/ de yang sngon gyi dus na rgan mo zhig phyug po nyams song ba'i khang stong zhig tu nyal yod pa na/ rkun ma zhig der 'ongs nas lag snyob byed pas rdza snod cig dang thug nas sgra grags pa dang / rgan mos sgra de thos nas na re/ kye bzhin bzang / re zhig ngas nyin mo'i ngogs la btsal kyang ci yang ma rnyed pas/ khyed kyis mtshan mor mun khang du lag snyob byed pas ci yang rnyed re skan/ zhes pa'i dpe ltar/ blo rnam par gsal ba snang ba dang bcas pas re zhig sangs rgyas kyi gsung gi don go dka' na/ gnyid kyi mun pas non bzhin chos la nyan na de'i don ga la go ste mi go ba yin pas/ blo rig bsgrims nas nyan dgos pa dang / chos nyan pa'i dus su rnam g.yeng gis g.yo ba med 75

tho'i ma chos rdzo sa pa che 'dza'i maphagazha dza〉par blo rtse gcig tu gtod pa dang bsgrub pa'i dus su lta ba'i ting nge 'dzin las ma yengs na de ni dngos gzhi dmigs med dam pa yin la/ de ltar min na dang po nyan blo dang bsgrub blo trem byas kyang bar du rnam rtog ngan pas bshig 'gro ba dang / de ni chos nyan pa dang bsgrub pa'i dus kyi dmigs med dam pa lags so/ / de yang shes pa gang bas cig la tsen gyis glod nas gang la yang mi sems ci la yang mi rtog pa'i ngang la sa le sangs nge ma yengs spro bsdu dang bral bzhag bzhag pas/ phyi yul du rtog pas phyi'i dngos po dang / nang sems su mi rtog pas nang gi dngos po med pa ni gzung 'dzin gnyis dang ba ste/ bsgom pa'i blo la'ang dgag sgrub med pas na de las gzhan pa'i chos su ma grub pas dmigs bya blo'i mdun na med pa zhes pa dang / dmigs pa med par so so rang rig ye shes khong nas rig pa nyid du nges te/ spyod 'jug las/gang tshe dngos dang dngos med dag / blo yi mdun na mi gnas pa/ / de tshe rnam pa gzhan med pas/ / dmigs pa med par rab tu zhi/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bden gyi dmigs pa'i gtad so mtha' dag med par spros pa ma lus pa rab tu zhi ba yin zhing / so so rang rig pa'i ye shes tsam gyis rab tu phye ba smra bsam brjod du med pa nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu'i mnyam pa nyid do/ / 'di ltar nam mkha' ni gzung du med pa bstan du med pa/ gzugs can ma yin pa/ mtha' dang dbus med pa zhig yin pa bzhin du sems kyi rang bzhin ye nas rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings su mnyam par bzhag pa na bsgom pa'i don chos nyid dang yul can gyi ye shes gnyis ro gcig tu gyur pa las tha dad du yod pa ma yin zhing / chos nyid dang ro gcig tu gyur pa'i sems kyi gshis lugs de la dngos po'i mtshan ma med pas gzugs sogs phung po lnga dang /76

'jile lja pa mong byi'i glon 'gro'adus ma byas yin pas rnam par shes pa tshogs brgyad po rnams kyang yod pa ma yin te/ yum las/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni nam mkha' bsgom pa ste/ nam mkha' la ni gzugs ma mchis tshor ba ma mchis/'du shes ma mchis/ 'du byed ma mchis/ rnam par shes pa ma mchis zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas ma mchis zhes pa'i bar du gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / de yang med ces yod mtha' blo yis bkag nas med pa zhig glo bur du bsgom par byar med pa gshis la mi gnas pa'i phyir na gshis kyi gnas tshul shes pa'i shes rab nyid dang 'gal ba yin zhing / sems kyi rang bzhin rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum du gnas pa 'di ni cang med phyang chad pa nyid ma yin par de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sku dang ye shes kun gyi 'byung gnas yin pa dang / so sor rtog pa'i shes rab so so skye bo'i blo'i yul las 'das pa mngon du byas pa la rgyu mtshan nyid theg pa'i rtse mo dbu ma'i lta bar bzhag pa'o/ / des na ji bzhinaganas lugs ji bzhin pa mngon sum du mthong ba ni 'phags pa kho na yin pas chos rnams kyi rang bzhin chos nyid du rnam par dag zin pa'i yang dag pa'i don nyid la bcos ma'i blo yis ma bslad par yang dag par lta bar byed cing / rang bzhin ma bcos pa'i ngang de las gzhan du ma yengs shing mi bsgom pa'i tshul gyis ma g.yos na/ gnas lugs ji bzhin pa bsgom pa yin pa'i phyir gzhan las mchog tu gyur pa ste/ mkhyen brtse rin po che'i zhal nas/rang bzhin nyid du rnam dag pa'i/ / yang dag nyid la yang dag blta/ / blta zhes bya ba'ang kun rdzob ste/ / ngang las ma g.yos sgom pa'i mchog / ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar mnyam par bzhag pa'i ye shes de yi mdun na sems sems byung gis bsdus pa'i rtog tshogs gzung 'dzin gyi spros pa thams 77

dza'idam chos rngo sa ba che yo'i ma zhagadza'icad gnas pa min pa ni dbu ma'i lam so sor rtog pa'i shes rab yang dag pa yin te/ 'od srung gis zhus pa las/ dbus gang yin pa de ni dpyad du med pa/ bstan du med pa/ rten ma yin pa/ snang ba ma yin pa/ rnam par rig pa med pa/ gnas 'di la de bzhin gshegs pa nyid las tshad mar gyur pa gzhan med pas dogs pa cung zad kyang nye bar na par mi bya'o/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de kho na nyid khong du chud pa'i dam pa ston pa bla ma rin po che'i zhal rgyun ltar/ phyi snang ba snod kyi 'jig rten dang nang srid pa bcud kyi sems can thams cad dag mnyam pa chen po'i rang bzhin du ye nas gnas pa la/ de nyid kyi yin lugs shes pa'i ngang nas chos byed po bdag dang / bya rgyu'i chos bya ba'i las nga bcas pa 'khor rtog pa med par/ dmigs med khyab gdal du thag chod pa de yin/ 'on kyang rnal 'byor pa rnams phyag rdzogs dbu gsum gyi lta ba'i ngang la gnas bzhin du chos spyod la 'jug pa ni/ sdud pa las/ ji ltar shing mkhan bzo bo mkhas pas skyes pa bud med dang / / 'dra ba'i bzo byas de yang bya ba thams cad byed/ / de bzhin shes rab spyod mkhas byang chub sems dpa' yang / / rnam par mi rtog ye shes bya ba thams cad byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ lta ba'i nang nas kha bton bzlas brjod phyag skor chos nyan pa sogs yod dgos/ de ltar lta ba'i nang nas lha bsgom sngags bzla sogs ni snga 'gyur rnying ma'i khyad chos dang / bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi lam/ mchog gi dngos grub la myur du sbyor byed yin/ gsar phyogs pas tshogs lam na bskyed rim kho na dbyibs kyi lam mam/ bcos ma'i lam/ sbyor lam drod bcas nas thabs lam la nye bar brten nas dpe'i 'od gsal bsgom pas bskyed rim ma bcosapa'i lha skur 'char ba de gnyis po 'dir 78

tho'ime lja pa moja sbya'i rjo rigrotshogs drod zung 'jug tu bsgom pas mchog gi dngos grub thob byed du 'gyur ro/ / de ltar ma nus na chos thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu rgyas 'debs su shor ba yin yang / las dang po ba'i dngos zhen gyi gnyen po yin te/ spyod 'jug las/ stong nyid bag chags goms pas na/ / dngos po'i bag chags spong 'gyur zhing / / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ sa ma thob kyi bar du gtan la tshul rnam grangs min pa'i don dam yin kyang rtogs tshul rnam grangs las mi 'da' bas/ grangs med gcig gi bar blos sgom pa kho na byed dgos pas sgyu ma lta bu'i nges shes kyis zin par bya dgos/ de 'dra zhig kyang mi nus pa'i phal pa yin na lha dang sngags la dad pa dang mos gus kho na dgos shing / tshig rjes don dran dang / de las sems ma yong bar byas na des dmigs med rjes mthun gyi go chod pa yin gsungs/ gzhan du na/ dmigs med kyis zin pa'i dge rtsa rnams khong khro sogs rkyen gyis 'jig par byed mi nus shing / dngos zhen dang bcas pa'i dge rtsa ni/ sdud pa las/ ji ltar dug dang 'dres pa'i kha zas bzang za ba/ / dkar po'i chos la dmigs pa'ang de 'drar rgyal bas gsungs/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ srid pa sgrub byed kyi rgyu kho na las med pa yin la/ srid pa'i rtsa ba bdag 'dzin gcod byed kyi lta ba bdag med rtogs pas zin pa med cing / sbyin sogs la sbyin pa las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po dang / tshul khrims las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po bsam gzugs sogs sgom pa las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po zhes srid pa'i las sogs byed tsam las med de/ skyes rabs las/ khyod kyi bstan las phyir phyogs pa/ / srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar song nas/ / slar yang ngan song gnas su lhung / / zhes dang / mdo sde rgyan las/79

tho'i ma chos rdzo saphab che 'dza'i ma tho'ibyams sogs rmongs dang 'gal med phyir/ / des ni nyes pa tshar gcod min/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na/ de lta bu'i dmigs med ni shin tu gal che ba zhig yin no/ / gang zagabadag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin na phyi rol pa dang thun mong las khyad par du 'phags pas/ de dag lhag pa tshul khrims dang / lhag pa ting nge 'dzin dang / lhag pa shes rab rnams yin/bdag med gnyis rtogs kyis zin na/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin sogs pha rol tu phyin pa'i ming 'thob ste/ sdud pa las/ dmus long dmigs bu med pa bye ba khrag khrig rnams/ /lam yang mi shes grong khyer 'jug par ga la 'gyur/ / shes rab med na mig med pha rol phyin lnga 'di/ / dmigs bu med pas byang chub reg par nus ma yin/ / gang tshe shes rab kyis ni rab tu zin gyur pa/ / de tshe mig rnyed gyur cing 'di yi ming 'thob bo/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ srid mi gnas pa'i myang 'das thob pa yin no/ /de ltar dngos gzhi dmigs med dam pa 'phros don dang bcas pa song ngo / /gsum pa dge ba gong 'phel du 'gro ba mjug bsngo ba dam pa ni/ chos tshig gcig nyan pa dang / dge sems skad cig tsam dran pa dang / dge sdig gi blang dor sna gcig byas pa yan chad de ma thag tu bsngo dgos la/ ma bsngos na las dang po ba'i dge rtsa ni rtswa skam po dang chu'i thigs pa bzhin shin tu nyam chung bas zad sla ba'o/ /khong khro dang nga rgyal sogs mi dge ba'i rnam rtog ni me dang nyi ma bzhin shugs chen po yin pas/ khong khro skad cig ma res dge rtsa chen po 'joms pa yin te/ ji skad du/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsags nas ni/ /ma bsngos yang na log par bsngos/ / gzhan la bsgrags dang 'gyod pa skyes/ / de ni zad pa'i rgyu bzhi yin/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ bsngo ba chen po byas na rtsa ba 80

'jibe ljari yoja byi'i sngo rinas 'dzad rgyu med de/ ji ltar chu thigs rgya mtsho'i nang du lhung / / rgya mtsho ma zad bar du de mi 'dzad/ / de bzhin byang chub yongs bsngos dge ba yang / /byang chub ma thob bar du de mi 'dzad/ / ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ / 'o na ji ltar bsngo zhe na/ bsngo ba chung ngu lha dang mi yi go 'phang tsam thob pa'i ched du bsngos na yun ring rtag pa'i bde ba med cing / mthar dngos med du zad nas rang don gzhan don gang yang mi 'grub pa yin/ bsngo ba 'bring nyan thos rang rgyal gyi go 'phang tsam thob pa'i phyir du bsngos na lhag med kyi gnas su zad nas rang don tsam las gzhan don rgyun chad de dang po sems bskyed ka de yangardzun du 'gyur bas na/ de ltar bsngo ba byed mi rung ngo / / 'o na gang la bsngo zhe na/ bdag gi dge ba 'di dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis ji ltar bsngo ba ltar du rang gzhan sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i don du bsngo dgos shing / sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thob gyur cig sangs rgyas ma thob bar du nub phyogs bde ba can du skye bar shog ces bsngo ba dang smon lam chen po gnyis kyis rgyas 'debs dgos so/ /dang po ci zhir+ghaṃ bsngo na/ bdag gis da ltar gyi dge ba 'dis mtshon te bdag gzhan rnams kyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i phung po thams cad gcig tu bsdus shing bzlums te bsdoms nas/ mdo phal po che las/ 'gro kun dge tso ji snyed yod pa dang / / byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag / ces gsungs pa ltar 'gro ba gzhan thams cad kyi dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang / rang gi dus gsum gyi dge ba thams cad do/ /gnyis pa ci la bsngo zhe na/ da lta'i lus srog skyed pa'i drin can gyi pha ma gnyis dang bzang ngan gyi 'brel ba thogs tshad gtso bor byas te/ nam mkha'i mtha' khyab kyi 'gro 81

tho'i ma' sa rdzo sa la che zusgoji ma tho'ib semasacan thams cad la'o/ / gsum pa ji ltar bsngo zhe na/ mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i g.yo med kyi ngang las/ rjes thob snying rje'i gsal snang sgyu ma lta bu'i tshul gyis 'khor gsum dmigs pa med pa'i shes rab kyis rgyas 'debs pa dang bcas/ dus gsum bsags pa'i dge rtsa kun/ / byang chub chen po'i rgyu ru bsngo/ / zhes brjod par bya'o/ / de las 'khor gsum zhes pa ni/gang bsngo rgyu'i dge rtsa dang / bsngo ba'i gang zag ci'i phyir bsngo ba'i dmigs yul dang gsum yin zhing / de gsum ni bden med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i bsngo ba dug med ces gsungs pas dmigs pa med pa'i shes rab kyi rtsis zin dgos te/ rgyal sras thogs med kyis/ de ltar brtson pas bsgrubs pa'i dge ba rnams/ / mtha' yas 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal bsal bya'i phyir/ /'khor gsum rnam par dag pa'i shes rab kyis/ / byang chub bsngo ba rgyal sras lag len yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de ltar brtson 'grus chen po'i sgo nas rang gzhan yongs kyis dus gsum bsags pa'i rnam dkar dge ba ma lus pa rnams mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba'i tshogs kyi sdug bsngal bsal bar bya ba'i phyir du/ bsngo bya bsngo byed bsngo tshul gyi 'khor gsum la bden 'dzin gyi dri ma rnam par dag pa'i bden med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sgo nas gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur bsngos na dge tshogs chud za zhing gong nas gong du spel bar byed pa'i thabs mkhas kyi lag len yin/ de ltar ma yin par 'khor gsum la bden zhen gyi dri mas bslad na bsngo ba dug can pa ste/ des na de 'dra'i bsngo ba dug can las log pa'i bsngo ba dug med pa ni/so so'i skye bo'i sa 'dir mi 'ong bas na 'phags sa thob pa'i bden tshig grub pa dag gi rjes su 'brang ba dang / yang na sngon gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub 82

dza'ile lja pa mong byi'itsā zhagrosems dpa' dag gis ji ltar bsngos pa de ltar du bsngo bar bya'o snyam du sems te bsngos na 'khor gsum yongs dag gi bsngo ba'i go chod par 'gyur te/ ltung bshags las/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis yongs su bsngos pa dang / ji ltar ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis yongs su bsngo bar 'gyur ba dang / ji ltar da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis yongs su bsngo bar mdzad pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang yongs su bsngo bar bgyi'o/ / zhes dang / bzang spyod las/ 'jam dpal dpa' bos ji ltar mkhyen pa dang / / kun tu bzang po de yang de bzhin te/ / de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag slob cing / / dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ / de yang 'gro ba kun gyis dge ba spyad nas de dag la nye ring chags sdang 'thab rtsod sogs med par bde ba dang ldan par shog cig ces smon lam dang 'brel ba/ ldan na ci ma rung zhes 'dun pa dang 'brel ba/ ldan pa zhig bdag gis bya'o zhes dam bca' dang 'brel ba/ de ltar byed nus par bla ma sras bcas kyis de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig ces mthun 'gyur mdzad pas 'gro rnams bde ba dang ldan par bsam par bya'o/ / bzhi pa gang gi phyir bsngo zhe na/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i phyir du bsngo ba ste/ yum bar ba las/rab 'byor dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di sangs rgyas kyi sa kho nar bsngo bar bya'o/ / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang de bzhin gzhan gyi sar bsngo bar mi bya ste/zhesagasungs pa'i phyir/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa kho na ma gtogs/tshe 'di'i phun sum tshogs pa tsam dang theg dman gyi blos bsngo bar mi bya'o/ /de yang rgyal ba bu ram shing pa mchog gis byang chub kyi spyod pa la bslab tshe/83

dza'i ma chos rngogs la che yo'i mag gadza'irgyal srid gces dgu mtha' dag phangs med du sbyin pa'i dus su yang / sbyin pa 'di yis bdag ni nam du yang / / mtho ris 'dod dang rgyal srid phyir ma lags/ /'gran phyir ma yin grags pa sgrub phyir min/ / bla med byang chub kho na'i phyir bsngo'o/ / zhes gsungs pa'o/ / lnga pa ci'i phyir du bsngo zhe na/ dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su mi zad pa'i phyir te/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/ji ltar chu thigs rgya mtsho che nang ltung / / rgya mtsho ma zad bar du de mi 'dzad/ /de bzhin byang chub yongs bsngos dge ba yang / / byang chub ma thob bar du de mi 'dzad/ / ces gsungs 5'i phyir/ 'di ltar dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams 'khor gsum yongs dag chen po'i klong du bsngos pas bdag byang chub ma thob kyi bar du 'dzad pa med cing lam gyi stegs khyad par can du 'gyur bar gsungs so/ / drug pa bsngo ba'i ngo bo ni/ lcags khams la gser 'gyur gyi rtsis thebs pa bzhin dge rtsa byang chub tu 'dun pas bsgyur ba ste/ 'jam dpal zhing gi yon tan bkod pa las/ chos rnams thams cad rkyen yin te/ / 'dun pa'i rtse'i rab tu gnas/ / gang gis smon lam ji btab pa/ / de 'dra'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ tshul 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi thabs mkhas pa'i khyad chos las gzhan gyi lugs la ni grags pa med de/ khyad par 'phags bstod las/ bsod nams bya ba'i tshogs dag ni/ / sems can rnams la yongs bsngo ba/ / thub dbang khyed kyis gang gsungs pa/ / de gzhan bstan bcos las ma bshad/ / ces gsungs pa'i phyir na/ rang gis dge ba byas pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur mi 'gyur bsngo ba'i dbang las 'byung ba yimā la/ 'dus byas kyi dge ba ci tsam rgya che ba bsags kyang bsngo bas kha ma bsgyur na thar pa'i lam du mi 'gro bar 84

tswa'ime lja pa moja byi'itsā ribrobashad do/ /de lta bu'i bsngo ba 'di ni dus dang rnam pa thams cad du dge rtsa che phra gang byas kyi mjug tu ma brjed par nyams su len dgos shing / de ltar ma bsngos na dge 'bras lan cig smin nas zad par 'gyur ba dang / gnad kyis ma zin pa sogs la rkyen gyis 'dzad pa'i rgyu bzhi ni gong du bshad pa bzhin no/ /'dus byas kyi dge ba mtha' dag ma bsngos par lung ma bstan du lus pa dang / bsngos kyang 'bras bu phyin ci log tu bsngos pa dang / bdag gis dge ba 'di lta bu byas so zhes nga rgyal gyi bsam pas gzhan la bas pa dang / 'dod pa'i dbang gis 'gyod sems dang ser sna skyes pa sogs kyis 'bras bu lan gcig thob nas slar 'dzad par 'gyur ro gsungs/ de bzhin du rang gi pha ma nye 'brel la sogs pa'i ched du dge ba byed pa dang / shi bo la sogs pa'i don du dge ba byed pa yang ma bsngos na mi thob la/ bsngos na ji ltar bsngos pa de ltar thob ste/ sngon yangs pa can gyi grong khyer na yod pa'i skye bo rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das sang nyin gyi gdugs tshod la spyan drangs shing / spyan 'dren pa dag slar song ba'i rjes su yi dwags lnga brgya 'ongs pa dang / sang nyin yangs pa can pa dag gis bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa la bsod snyoms phul ba'i dge rtsa de nged rnams la bsngo bar zhu zer/ bcom ldan 'das kyis mkhyen bzhin du khyed rnams su yin/ yangs pa can gyi dge rtsa dag khyed rnams la ci'i phyir bsngo/ zhes gsungs pas/ nged rnams yangs pa can gyi grong gi pha ma rnams yin zhing / ser sna'i las kyis yi dwags su skyes pa yin zer/ 'o na sang nyin bsngo ba byed pa'i dus su khyed rnams kyang shog cig dang bsngo bar bya'o gsungs pas/ nged rnams lus ngan 'di lta bu blangs pas ngo tsha nas 'ong mi phod par 'dug zer/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas khyed rnams 85

tho'i ma' sa rdzo sa pa che bsgo'i ma tho'ilas ngan bsags pa'i dus su ngo tsha dgos rgyu yin pa la/ de dus ngo ma tsha nas da lus ngan blangs tshar steng ngo tsha bas ci phan/ mi 'ong na bsngo ba'i thabs med gsungs/ 'o na 'ong lags zer nas song ngo / / sang nyin bsngo ba'i dus su yi dwags rnams bsngo ba zhu bar 'ongs pas/ yangs pa can gyi skye bo rnams skrag nas bros pa na/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas khyed rnams skrag mi dgos/'di dag khyed rang tsho'i pha ma rnams yi dwags su skyes pa yin zhing / 'di dag gis 'di ltar zer ba 'dug pas/ dge rtsa bsngo'am mi bsngo gsungs/ 'o na cis kyang bsngo zhu zhus pas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ sbyin pa 'di yis dge rtsa gang / / de dag yi dwags rjes su song / / yi dwags lus ngan med pa dang / / mtho ris bde ba thob par shog / gsungs pas yi dwags de dag tshe 'phos te sum cu rtsa gsum gyi yul du skyes par gsungs/ de bas na dge ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur ba'i gnad ma 'chugs pa ni mjug bsngo ba'i rgyas yongs su thebs pa kho na la rag las pa yin pas/ dge rtsa bsngo ba la rnam pa kun tu 'bad par bya'o/ / dam pa gsum gyis zin pa'i dge ba ni thar pa cha mthun zhes dge rtsa rgya che chung gang rung bsgrub na'ang / 'bras bu rgya che ba sa byang 'thob byed kyi rgyu dang rgyun ring po de ma thob kyi tshe rabs rnams su lha mi'i bde 'bras lan grangs du mar smin pa'o/ / gzhan yang dam pa gsum gyis ma zin pa'i dge ba ni zhag bcas bsod nams cha mthun zhes dge rtsa rgya chen po zhig bsgrubs kyang 'bras bu lha mi'i bde 'bras phun sum tshogs pa tsam thob nas/ de nyid kyang myong stobs kyis zad par 'gyur ba yin te/ spyod 'jug las/ dge ba gzhan kun chu shing bzhin du ni/ / 'bras bu bskyed nas zad par 'gyur ba nyid/ / byang chub sems kyi ljon shing rtag par yang / /86

dza'ime lnga pa mong phyi'i smo lhuna'abras bu 'byin pas mi zad 'phel bar 'gyur/ / zhes gal che ba'i tshul du gsungs pa'i phyir/ tshegs chung la don chen po dang ldan pa'i man ngag gi zab gnad 'di gsum don spyi tsam du ma bzhag par rang gi yid dang 'dres nges shig cis kyang byas nas nyams len gyi snying po ru byed dgos pa yin no/ /'dir dam pa gsum gyi tshul cung tsam zhig brjod zin zhing / da ni gong du smras pa'i 'phro dang mthud nas 'di ltar/ sems kyi gnad mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi don du man ngag rdzogs pa chen po'i gdams pa zab mo 'di nyid nyams su blang bar bya'o snyam du sems bskyed dung pa zhig sngon du btang rjes/ rang gi spyi bor rtog pa'i mtha' brgyad rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin can gyi sna tshogs pad ma 'dab ma brgyad ge sar ze phon dang bcas pa'i steng du thabs dang shes rab mtshon byed kyi nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor rnams reg la ma 'byar ba'i tshul du gsal btab/ de rnams la gsal snang thon byung ba na/de'i steng du rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid rgyun gyi sku'i rnam pa can phyag gnyis chos 'chad pa'am mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya gang bde bar bzhugs shing /gzi byin mchog tu 'bar ba'i mtshan dpe'i lang tsho rab tu rgyas pa'i sku can du lam gyis gsal gdab par bya/ de'ang las dang po bas thog mar tsab tsub ci drag mang po mi bsam par lam gyis gsal btab ste rtse gcig tu bsgom par bya/de la gsal snang thon byung ba na/ mos gus gdung shugs drag po'i ngag tu/dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs dang / dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che mkhyen/ bdag gi rgyud smin cing grol bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zab lam gyi rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ tshe 'di nyid la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub 87
