dza'i mazhesas rngo saphabasgyu yo'i ma tho'inang gi sgrib pa can ni/ zas skom gang yang mi dbang zhing / dbang du srid kyang kha khab kyi mig lta bu'i nang du mi 'drongs shing / kha'i dug gis skem 'gro/ ma skems kyang mgrin pa phra bas mi 'drongs/ 'drongs kyang lto ba yul ljongs tsam mi khengs pa dang / khengs kyang yan lag 'jag ma tsam pas mi theg gi sdug bsngal myong ba zhig yin/ zas skom can ni/ zas skom khar slebs ma thag kha nas me 'bar zhing /mthar nang long rgyu ma thams cad bsregs pa dang / lto ba nas me lce dmar lhag lhag 'bar ba'i sdug bsngal myong ba zhig yin/ gzhan yang dus tshigs thams cad phyin ci log tu gyur pa'i dbang gis/ dbyar dus zla bas kyang tsha reg mi bzod/ dgun dus nyi mas kyang grang reg bzod dka' ba yin/dpyid kyi dus char sprin yang me char du 'bebs shing / gzhan yang kha lud dang / sna lud dang / mi gtsang ba dang / me mdag la sogs pa duḥkha skye ba'i zas kho na bsten dgos/ ltogs skom sogs la ngoms shing 'grangs pa'i dus med cing / rtag tu 'tshol 'gros kyis ngal zhing dub pa dang / nyams zhan pas rus tshigs khrog ste me 'bar ba/ phan tshun dgrar gyur pas 'chi ba dang / brdog pa dang / gsod pa dang / bsdigs pa dang / gtad so med par 'jigs skrag chen pos 'bros pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal dos drag pa yun ring myong ba yin/de'i tshe tshad kyi khyad par ni/ mdzod las/ zla ba nyin zhag gis lnga brgya/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mi'i zla ba gcig la zhag tu byas pa'i rang lo lnga brgya dang / bshes springs las/ lnga stong dag dang khrir yang 'chir mi 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ yi dwags la la'i tshe tshad lo lnga stong dang / kha 182

waṃbe ljari yongasbya'i rigrocig ni lo khri gcig yin par bshad/ de lta bu'i sdug bsngal gyi rgyu ni ser sna dang 'jur gegs sogs las grub pa yin pa'i phyir/ da lta'i gnas skabs su kun tu bsgrims te bag yod par bya ste/ 〈rdzong sngon 'bru 'grel 〉las/ sngar dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal bstan pa de bzhin du dbul zhing zas skom gyis phongs par gyur la nyams mi dga' ba'i yul du bza' ba dang btung ba longs spyod kyi ming tsam yang mi grags par zas dang skom lo zla ba'i bar du mi rnyed cing yid la btags pas yi dwags su grags pa'i lus ni skam la rid cing yar la ldang ba'i stobs nyams pa spyi mthun yin la/ de yang rigs rnam pa gsum ste/phyi'i sgrib pa can ni/ tsha grang go ldog pa la sogs phyin ci log bzhi'i snang ba rgyun chad med pa dang / nang gi sgrib pa can ni/ kha khab mig tsam mid pa rta rnga tsam lto ba yul ljongs tsam yan lag 'jag ma tsam gyis mi theg pa dang /gal te zas cung zad rnyed kyang glo snying nas me 'bar zhing / sna nas dud pa 'thul bar 'gyur ba can dang / sgos khur gyi sgrib pa can ni/ yi dwags re re'i lus la srog chags mang pos tshang bcas nas lus kyi nang nas za bar byed cing bdeg btsog byed pa'o/ / de dag gang las byung ba'i rgyu ni ser sna yin pas rgyu spangs pa la 'bad par bya'o/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal ni/ dud 'gro byings dang kha thor ba gnyis yod cing / byings zhes pa ni byings na gnas pa phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po la yod pa la zer ba dang / kha thor ba ni lha dang mi'i yul du yod pa'i dud 'gro rnams yin/byings na gnas pa nya sogs phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po la yod pa rnams ni/de la klu rnams nyin re bzhin bye tshan gyi 'jigs pa dang / mkha' lding gi gnod pa byung dogs pa/ chu'i rlabs kyis mtha' la 'khyer te gnod pa byung 183

tswa'i mazhesas rngo sa ba che po'i ma zha dza'idogs pa/ che ba gcig gis chung ba mang po dus gcig la za ba/ chung ba mang pos che ba gcig rub ste za ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal myong ba da lta'i brnyan 'phrin 〈dud 'gro'i 'jig rten 〉zhes pa'i le'u la bltas na shes thub pa yin/kha thor ba'i dud 'gro ni/ lha dang mi'i yul na yod pa zhig yin zhing /de rnams bdag tu bzung ba rnams ni phan tshun gcig gis gcig la dbang che bas chung ba gson zas byed pa sogs gnod pa byed pa dang / gzhan yang mi la sogs pas sha lpags rus pa sgro la sogs pa'i ched du dbang med du gsod pa dang / bdag tu bzung ba rnams ni zhon pa'am khal mi theg bzhin du 'gel ba/ sa zhing rmo ba/ 'o ma bzho ba/ spu 'thog pa/ bal 'breg pa sogs byed pa'i khar/ rdung ba dang / btsog pa/ brdeg pa la sogs pa ste/ tha na bsad nas pags pa bshu zhing snying 'don pa dang / sha za zhing rus pa brdungs te bcud len pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal myong dgos pa yin la/ ma bsad par bzhag na rdung btsogasasgyubardeg gsum gyi sdug bsngal bzod bsran bskyed de mi rnams la g.yog dbang med du bya dgos pa yin/ de ltar thun mong du glen lkugs bkol spyod kyi sdug bsngal drag po bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig myong dgos pa yin te/ 〈bshes springs 〉las/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas na yang gsod pa dang / / bcings dang brdeg sogs sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong / / zhi 'gyur dge ba spangs pa rnams la ni/ / gcig la gcig zar shin tu mi bzod 'byung / /kha cig mu tig bal dang rus pa khrag / sha dang pags pa'i ched du 'chi bar 'gyur/ / dbang med gzhan dag rdog pa lag pa dang / / lcags dang lcags kyu rnams kyis btab ste bkol/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rang cag gis dam pa'i chos byed pa dang / dge ba sgrub pa spangs te sdig pa'i las la ci 184

dza'ile lha pa mong byiri sngo pharakromi snyam par spyod pa byung na/ skye ba phyi mar dud 'gro ru mi skye ba'i gdeng med cing / gal srid dud 'gro ru skyes na gcig gis gcig za ba dang / mi sogs kyis gsod pa'am bkol spyod sogs kyi sdug bsngal bsran mi bzod pa re myong dgos tshul da lta'i 〈dud 'gro'i 'jig rten 〉zhes pa'i brnyan 'phrin la bltas na rang bzhin gyis shes par 'gyur ba yin/ blo kha chos dang dge ba la phyogs pa'i slad du rang nyid dud 'gro ru skyes te rdung btsog brdeg gsum dang gsod spyod bkol gsum sogs kyi sdug bsngal bsran mi bzod pa mang po zhig myong dgos snyam du bsam par bya dgos te/ 〈rdzong sngon 'bru 'grel 〉 las/byings na gnas pa dang / kha 'thor sogs kyi sdug bsngal ni/ gcig la gcig za zhing / go rar 'dzud pa dang / bya gcod pa dang / gson khrag 'byin pa dang / gsod par byed pas 'jigs pa chen po yod pa dang / rtag tu bkol zhing spyod pa'i sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag cing blang dor rmongs pa sogs pha mtha' med pa'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba de'i rgyu'am sa bon gang yin na gti mug gi mun par 'khyams pa can bdag gi blo sna chos la sgyur cig gu ru rin po che mkhyen no/ / zhes gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de bzhin du 'dod gzugs lha'i 'pho ltung sogs dang / 'thab cing rtsod pa lha min dang / mi la khyab pa 'du byed dang / 'gyur ba dang / sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal te rtsa ba'i sdug bsngal chen po gsum dang / skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal gyi chu bo chen po bzhi dang / gnyen sdug pa dang bral ba/dgra mi sdug pa dang 'phrad pa'i sdug bsngal sogs bsams nas 'khor ba zhen log gi nges 'byung lam bden pa bzhi yi thog ma sdug bsngal shes par bya ba kho nas bskyed par bya'o/ /185

dza'i ma chos rngogs la che yo'i mag gadzaji lnga pa thar pa'i phan yon ni/ nyan thos rang rgyal rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gsum gyi go 'phang gang thob kyang sdug bsngal zhi ba/ de las lhag pa'i lus sems bde ba/ bsil ba/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi 'phrang las thar ba can yin pas de'i nang tshan las kyang / da res theg pa chen po dang mjal ba'i dge ba bcu dang / tshad med bzhi dang / phar phyin drug dang / bsam gtan bzhi dang / gzugs med bzhi dang / zhi lhag gnyis la sogs pa dge ba thabs kyis zin pa sbyor ba sems bskyed dam pa/ dge ba rkyen gyis mi bshigs pa dngos gzhi dmigs med dam pa/ dge ba mi zad cing spel bar byed pa rjes la bsngo ba dam pa ste/ dam pa gsum gyis zin par nyams su len pa'o/ /drug pa ma nor lam ston gyi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa bsam pa dang / sbyor bas tshul bzhin du bsten pa gnad kyi don dang po yin pas tshul bzhin bsten tshul shes par bya ba ni 'phros don du smras pa sems la bzhag par 'tshal/ de nas bla me byin rlabs dpung zhus kyi sgo nas rang gi skyon mtshang thon par gsol ba 'debs pa na/ dang po so sor thar pa'i chos kyi lam du zhugs par gyur kyang / lus ngag yid gsum gyi nyes spyod kyi sgo mi sdom zhing /bar du theg chen byang sems kyi sgo ru zhugs kyang gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems dang bral ba dang / bla ma'i drung nas dbang bzhi thob par gyur kyang thabs bskyedacopa'i rim pa dang / shes rab rdzogs pa'i rim pa mi sgom pa'i lam gol bar shor ba 'di las bla mas bsgral du gsol/ yang lta sgom spyod gsum nor ba ste yang dag pa'i lta ba ni/ yin lugs ye ji bzhin pa ma rtogs bzhin du grub rdzu tho co'i spyod pa can dang / sgom pa goms pas nyams myong cung zad kyang ma thob ste yangs par gyur kyang / dpe thog bro brdung lta bu'i go yul tsam 186

dza'ile lnga pa mong byi'i sngo rigroblo la bzhag ste kha 'ud chen po 'don pa/ dper na nang khong snying pos stong yang phyi sgra che ba/ rnga sogs gog pa brdung ba'am/ 'thag pa lta bu dang / de yangaspyir lta ba mtho la spyod pa rtsing por shor ba ma yin par lta spyod zung du 'brel bar dgos phyir/ o rgyan rin po che'i zhal nas/ lar lta ba nam mkha' bas kyang mtho/ / las rgyu 'bras bag phye bas kyang zhib/ / ces gsungs pa ltar/ dgos rgyu de 'dra ma yin par las 'bras khyad du gsod pa'i spyod pa nor bar gyur kyang / rang skyon yin par mi sems pa'i 'jig rten chos dred kyi dbang du song ba 'di las bla ma rdo rje 'chang gis bsgral du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab pa dang / sang nangs par rang 'chi rgyu yin yang da dung 'dug pa'i gnas mal dang / bgo ba'i gos dang / bsags pa'i nor rdzas la rab tu sred cing lo rgas nas na tshod thams cad song ste yol bar gyur na yang da dung nges 'byung dang skyo shas rgyud la skye ba'i go skabs bral ba dang / rgya chen thos pa ma btsal bar chung ba ste dman par 'phyan yang da dung yon tan can yin du rlom pa'i nga rgyal gyis khengs pa/ 'di lta bu'i ma rig pas sgrib pa 'di las bla ma thugs rje can gyis bsgral du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /nyams len rnam g.yeng gi rkyen khar 'chor yang da dung 'du 'dzi byed bzhin gnas skor byed pa lta bu re chos su sems pa dang / gnas ri khrod dben pa la bsten nas bsdad kyang chos nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por ma song bar da dung rang rgyud shing ltar rengs pa ste gyong ba dang / kha nas rgyud dul yod par smra yang rkyen dang 'phrad tshe rang phyogs la chags pa dang / gzhan phyogs la sdang ba dang / gnyis ka la rmongs pa gsum ma zhig par je thur song 187

dzabadam chos rdzogs pa che yo'i mgazhagadza'inas yod pa'i chos brgyad 'gong po'i dbang du gyur pa 'di dag las bla ma rin po ches bsgral du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab pa dang / thog med nas bdag 'dzin ma rig pas bsgribs pa 'di las bla mas bsgral du gsol/ gti mug gi gnyid 'thug po 'di las ring po mi thogs par myur du sad du gsol/'khor ba'i gnas btsan sa khri mun te btson dong du bcug pa lta bu 'di las bla mas myur du dbyung du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ da lta rang cag rnams kyis me'i nang du mdzub mo yud tsam 'dug gam/ dgun grang sgang 'khyag sbubs su gcer bur bsdad na bzod thub bam/ nyin zhag kha yar bza' btung ci yang med par lus na zas skom gyi snga phyi'i sgug sdod dang / lus la sbrang ma dang lji shig sogs srin bu phra mo tsam gyis so btab pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rkyen phra mo tsam yang bzod par dka' na/dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal ji ltar bzod dam ang snyam du da lta'i rang nyams la dpag cing / nges 'byung skyo shas drag pos bskul nas tshe 'di'i dal 'byor don yod par bya'o snyam du bsam mo/ /mtho ris kyi sdug bsngal ni/ bsod nams cha mthun gyi dge ba'i las chung 'bring chen po bsags pa'i mthu las mi dang 'dod pa'i lha dang khams gong ma'i lha la sogs par rim gyis skyes nas gnas skabs kyi bde 'bras phra mo tsam thob pa tsam gyis chog gam snyam na mi chog ste/ 'khor ba mtho dman gyi rang bzhin gang du skyes kyang zug gzer rgyun mi 'chad pa'i nad pa ltar bde ba'i go skabs skad cig tsam yang mi 'dug pa rang cag rnams kyis mngon du gyur pa 'di kas mtshon pas/ mi'i sdug bsngal bsam pa'ang dang po rang cag rnams ma'i mngal du rtsa mdud dog cing mun nag 'thibs pa'i tsha grang gi 188

'jile 5rji la mong phyi'i sngo pharagro'agyur ldog bzod dka' ba der zla ba bgrangs nas sdod dgos/ de'i tshe na'ang mas zas tsha ba rnams zos pa'i tshe/ tsha dmyal du tshud pa lta bu dang /grang ba rnams zos pa'i tshe grang dmyal du tshud pa lta bu/ zas mang po zos pa'i tshe ri bos mnan zhing ri brag gi bar du gcur ba lta bu/ pho mo 'khrig pa spyod pa'i tshe me nyil du tshud pa lta bu/ lus 'gul skyod sogs byed pa'i tshe rbab tu bsgril zhing g.yang la lhung dogs pa lta bu bcas kyi sdug bsngal myong ba yin/gzhan yang thom thom/ gong zhor/ ling ling byed pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa zhig myong dgos pa yin/ de nas zla dgu zhag dgu thim ste ma'i mngal nas thon pa'i tshe na'ang ma'i mngal nyid dog pa'i dbang gis 'jur mig nas drangs te pags pa bshu ba lta bu/ lte ba bcad pa'i tshe nang khrol yod tshad phyir thon zhing snying la tsher ma zug pa lta bu/ ma'i sha dang reg tshe lcags bsreg dang she'u yis reg pa lta bu/ gos 'jam po g.yogs pa'i tshe tsher mas reg pa lta bu/ pang du blangs pa'i tshe byi'u khras 'khyer ba lta bu la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal myong dgos pa yin/ der ma zad bu rdzi la sogs pas nyar tshags ma byung ba'i dbang gis dbang po'i sgo rnams su srog chags zhugs pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal dang / lus la sbrang bu dang lji shig gis so btab pa/'og nas dri chu la sogs pas mi bde ba ste mdor na yid la mi 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal mang po zhig myong ba yin/de nas na tshod yar 'phel te lus kyi lang tsho dar la bab pa na/ sha rtsi dkar la dmar mdangs rgyas shing yid 'phrog pa zhig tu gyur na yang / mthar kha dog nyams nas bzhin ras kyi mdog sngo chil gyis song zhing / gnyer mas gang / mgo bo'i skra yang skya yer gyis song / dbyibs nyams pas kha'i so 189

'ji mazhe sa rngo saphab che zusgo'i ma gatho'irnams rim gyis lhung / drang por skyes pa'i lus de yang sgur zhing 'khogs/yan lag rnams kyang 'khyog por gyur/ de ltar mthong na kun gyi yid du mi 'ong ba zhig tu 'gyur ba yin/ dbang po rnams nyams nas mig mi gsal zhing rna ba 'on pa/ longs spyod 'ju ba'i me drod nyams nas kha zas mang na mi 'ju/nyung na ni bkres/ lus stobs nyams nas yar ldang ba dka'/ 'gro na ni 'khyor/ 'dug na ni bug smra ba ldab ldib tu gyur/ de ni skye ba dang rga ba'i sdug bsngal yin/ gzhan yang rang cag rnams gson gyi 'jig rten 'dir 'tsho ba'i dus su sngon las 'phral rkyen gyi 'byung gzhi 'khrugs pa'i nad kyis btab nas zug rngu ldang zhing lus rgud/ 'dod pa'i gnyid dang bza' btung la sogs par spyod dbang med/ mi 'dod pa'i sman dang gtar bsreg la sogs par brten dgos/ 'chi bar dogs pa'i sdug bsngal la mtha' med/de ni na ba'i sdug bsngal yin/ 'chi ba'i dus su bab pa na zas nor shed stobs sman dpyad rim gro rig sngags rten 'brel sogs gang gisarkekyang mi phan/sngar chags sdang dang 'bad pas bsgrubs pa'i rgyu nor longs spyod dang /mkhar dang khang pa/ 'khor dang dbang thang / thob dang snyan grags/ grogs dngaganyen tshan/ bu dang bud med thams cad blos gtong mi thub bzhin du khab skud tsam yang 'khyer dbang med par kha bral nas phyi ma'i yul du 'gro dgos pa ma zad/ da dung rang gi sha rus gdos bcas kyi phung po yang bzhag ste mnar gcod kyi sdug bsngal drag po myong bzhin 'chi bar 'gyur/ de ni 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal yin/skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal 'di ni 'dzam bu'i gling gi srog chags gang dang gang zhig yin kyang khyad par med par spyi mthun du myong dgos pa zhig yin/190

dza'ile lja sda mongañca'i sngo 'brogazhan yang 'dzam bu'i gling 'di'i smra shes don go ba'i mi la cha mtshon na/ mi su zhig yin na yang gson 'jig rten du gnas shing 'tsho ba'i skabs su longs spyod dbang thang sogs tshe 'di'i bde 'byor phra mo tsam bsgrub pa'i ched du lus srog gshed la bor te dka' ba ji snyed cig spyad na yang / 'dod pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du ma grub pa'i sdug bsngal dang / tsha grang bkres skom nad gdon dgra jag sogs yid du mi 'ong ba'i rkyen rnams mi 'dod bzhin du phrad pa'i sdug bsngal/ gnyen grogs 'khor 'dab longs spyod ji tsam che ba rnams gzhan gyis 'khyere bar dogs te bsrung dgos pa'i sdug bsngal bcas myong dgos shing / khyad par du rgyal po la sogs pa'i dbang thang can rnams kyis dbang med du chad pa sogs byung dogs pa'i sdug bsngal dang / dbul po rnams kyis zas skom sogs 'dod pa'i longs spyod btsal kyang ma rnyed par dbul zhing phongs pa'i sdug bsngal myong dgos pa yin te/ 〈skyes rabs 〉las/gcig ni bsrung bas nyon mongs la/ / gnyis pa 'tshol bas sha thang ngo / phyug gam yang na dbul yang rung / / gang na'ang dga' ba med par 'gyur/ / zhes dang / 〈bzhi brgya pa 〉las/ mchog la yid kyi sdug bsngal dang / / tha ma rnams la lus skyes so/ / sdug bsngal gnyis kyis 'jig rten 'dir/ / nyin re bzhin du 'joms par 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ / 'jig rten mi yul du skyes na'ang gong du bshad pa'i sdug bsngal myong dgos shing / sdug bsngal 'di dag myong ba ni ji 'dra'i bzod dka' ba zhig red ang snyam du bsam par bya'o/ / —lha min gyi sdug bsngal bsam pa ni/ deng sang gi mi chos la ma 'dris pa rnams kyis lha min zhes pa ni zas nor longs spyod sogs lus kyi rtsol bas 191

waṃdam chos rdzogs pa che wo'i rnamagazhagawaṃbasgrub mi dgos par rang byung rang grub tu yod pas ci 'dra'i skyid pa la ang snyam bzhin yid smon shor bzhin yod mod/ 'on kyang lha min gyi yul na'ang sdug bsngal mtha' klas pa zhig yod pa ste/ lha min rnams ni lha dang 'dra ba'i phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal ci yang med pas/ lha'i phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal rnams mthong ba na/ de dag la phrag dog skyes te yid la mi bzod pa'i gdung ba drag po byung zhing / skabs skabs su lha rnams la ci mi snyam par 'thab cing 'dzing ba yin/ lha min rnams ni bsod nams kyi mthu chung ba'i dbang gis lha rnams kyis dka' ba med par cham la phab nas gsod pa dang /brdeg pa dang / yan lag gcod cing 'dral ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzod pa 'byung ba yin/ de'i tshe lha rnams ni mgo bo dang rked pa man chad na gnad du phog kyang slar 'tsho zhing / lha min rnams ni mi dang 'dra bar gnad du phog na 'chi ba dang / shi zin pa rnams kyi gzugs brnyan gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du kun snang zhes pa'i mtsho zhig yod pa'i nang du mngon par shar ba nye du rnams kyis dmag ma log pa'i gong nas mthong ste mya ngan gyis gdung ba zhig yin par bshad/ gzhan yang lha min rnams nag phyogs yin pas chos lugs gang la'ang dad pa med cing / 'ga' zhig chos la dad cing mos na'ang rnam smin gyi sgrib pa can yin pas khyad par rtogs pa'i dus ni med/ de 'dra'i lha min la bye brag gi rigs bzhi yod de/ tshe dpal lha'i rigs/gdug pa klu'i rigs/ srog gcod pa srin po'i rigs/ stobs ldan gnod sbyin gyi rigs te phal cher nag po'i phyogs kho na las med pas/ lha min gyi gnas su skyes kyang sdug bsngal de lta bu mang po zhig myong dgos par 'dug snyam du bsam par bya'o/ /192

dzajile lha la mong phyi'i sngonaribrolha'i sdug bsngal ni/ dang po 'dod pa'i lha rnams ni rang rang gi 'dod yon la bag med du spyod cing / des kyang tshim pa med par gzhan gyi 'dod yon la bag med du spyod pa dang / de ltar 'dod yon la bag med du spyad pa'i mthar tshe 'grib pa ma tshor bar 'chi ltas rnams rim gyis phog ste/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog rnams kyang char rjes kyi 'ja' tshon yal ba ltar rang bzhin gyis nub/ khrus kyi rdzing bu rnams kyang rang bzhin gyis bskams/ 'dod 'jo'i ba yang rang bzhin gyis shi/ dpag bsam shing rnams kyang rang bzhin gyis bskams/ de nas sngar med pa'i dri ma nag po zhig mi 'dod bzhin du chags shing / me tog gi phreng ba rnams kyang rim gyis rnyings/ mchan 'og gnyis rim gyis rul/ pad+ma'i stan la bsdad kyang sdod snying mi 'dod par kun tu 'khyams snying 'dod/ de'i skabs su sngar brtse zhing gus par blta ba'i rang gi lha mo lha phrug la sogs pas rang mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin spangs te lha gzhan gyi drung du song / dus de tsam na lha la zag bcas kyi mngon shes yod pa'i dbang gis rang nyid dus nam zhig gi tshe shi ba ni shes/ shi nas ngan song gi sdug bsngal myong dgos pa'ang shes/ de ltar 'pho ltung gi sdug bsngal nya bye tshan la bsgres pa lta bu'i lha'i zhag bdun du myong dgos shing / shi nas lhar skye ba ni srid mtha' tsam ste mir skye ba'ang ches nyung ba dang / phal cher ngan song du skye ba de'i sdug bsngal bzod dka' ba yun ring du myong dgos pa shes nas sdug bsngal snying la tsher ma zug pa lta bu'i bzod glags med pa zhig 'byung / de 'dra'i sdug bsngal 'byung ba ni sus kyang bzlog tu med pa zhig yin te/ 〈dran nye 〉las/ lha yi gnas nas lhung ba yis/ / sdug bsngal rab tu skye ba gang / /de la sems can dmyal ba yi/ / bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ / zhes gsungs 193

dza'i macas rdzogs pa che yo'i mgazhagadza'ipa'i phyir/ mi rnams kyis bshad pa ltar lha ni sdug bsngal ci yang med par bde zhing skyid pa zhig yin zhing / ngal rtsol sogs byed mi dgos par zas rang grub dang gos rang grub nyid du nges pa dang / nyin rgyun rang rang gis ji ltar 'dod pa'i rtse dga'i dpal la de ltar du rol bzhin bsdad chog pas/ lha la nam yin kyang sdug bsngal med par 'dod pa ni 'khrul ba ste/ lha ru skye ba na rgas te 'chi ba'i bar gyi sdug bsngal ni mi las kyang che ba dang / shi nas ngan 'gro gsum gang rung du lhung ste skye ba'am yang na mi dang lha min sogs gang rung du skye ba ma gtogs yang bskyar lha'i skye ba len pa ni shin tu dka' ba zhig yin te/ 〈bshes springs 〉las/ brgya byin 'jig rten mchod 'os gyur nas kyang / /slar yang las kyi dbang gis sa steng lhung / / 'khor los bsgyur rgyal nyid du gyur nas kyang / / 'khor ba dag tu yang bran nyid du 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / gzhan yang lha'i rigs la'ang bsod nams che chung gi khyad par yod cing / lha bsod nams che ba dag gis 'dod yon gyi dpal mthong ba na/ bsod nams chung ba rnams sems khong du chud cing spa bkong ba zhig tu 'gyur ba ste/ lha mthu che ba dag gis lha mthu chung ba rnams rang rang gi gnas nas pha rol du skrod pa'i sdug bsngal myong dgos/ khyad par du rgyal chen bzhi pa'i rigs dang sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams dus rgyun par lha ma yin dang 'thab cing rtsod pa'i g.yul du zhugs te lus mtshon gyis gcod cing 'dral ba'am yang na gsod pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig myong dgos pa yin/ gzugs dang gzugs med pa rnams sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal mngon du gyur pa med kyang 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal kho na'i rang bzhin las ma 'das shing / ting nge 'dzin gyis myos pa ltar gyur pas so skye 194

dza'ile tho la moja ci'i sngonalibrokhrimirnams yon tan gong 'phel du 'gro ba med cing / ting nge 'dzin gyis myong bas ro myong can gyi ting nge 'dzin las 'bral mi phod pa dang / de nas rang rang gi ting nge 'dzin sgom pa'i skabs dang / skabs der bsam gtan gzugs med kyi ting nge 'dzin la nyams bde bde 'dra bar 'dug kyang yid brtan mi 'grub par mda' nam mkha' la 'phangs pa cis kyang sa la 'bab pa dang chos mtshungs par zag bcas kyi dge ba'i 'phen shugs zad pa na slar ngan song du ltung bar 'gyur te/ 〈bshes springs 〉las/ lha yul 'dod bde shin tu chen po yang / / tshangs nyid chags bral bde ba thob nas slar/ / mnar med me yi bud shing gyur pa yi/ / sdug bsngal rgyun mi 'chad pa brten 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas 'di mtho dman gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal/khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal te sdug bsngal gyi 'khor lo las ma 'das pa ste/zugagazer rgyun mi 'chad pa'i nad pa ltar bde ba'i go skabs skad cig tsam yang mi 'dug des na da res rang cag rnams bstan pa gnas pa'i yul dbus su ni skyes/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis thugs brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas rjes su ni bzung / gdams pa'i man ngag zab mo dang ni mjal/gsang sngags zab mo'i chos sgor 'jug pa'i skal ba ni ldan/ chos byed pa'i thabs ni shes/ chos byed pa'i dbang ni yod/ chos byed pa'i lam gyi rgyu rkyen rtel 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i skabs 'dir/ chos ma byas par kha rgyab khang pa sogs nyer mkho 'ba' zhig sgrub pa'i las la mgo 'khor nas nyi ma phud pa ni rang gis rang bslus pa lta bur 'gro bar 'dug cing / mi lus dal 'byor thob pa 'di chud 'dza' ba'am stong log byed pa ni shin tu blun pas/ rang la 195

dza'idam chos rdzo sa pa che yo'i mgazhagadza'irang dbang yod pa'i dus 'dir 'khor ba mtho dman gyi rang bzhin gang du'ang mi skye ba'i dam pa'i chos gsha' ma zhig nges par bya dgos snyam du bsam par bya'o/ / zhes pa ltar yin/ 'di ltar bsam par ma byas na blo kha chos la mi phyogs shing / chos byed pa'i blo nam yang mi skye bas/ ngan song gsum du skye ba'i rgyu sgrub pa'i las la ji mi snyam par 'jug par gdon mi za ba yin/ de ltar sdig pa'i las 'ba' zhig sgrub pa'i las la ci mi snyam par zhugs na ni/skye ba phyi ma phar zhog tha na skye ba da thengs kyang rang nyid kyis spyi tshogs bde 'jags sogs la gnod pa'i bya ngan mang po zhig brtsams nas rang gzhan gnyis ka 'phung bar byed pa yin la/ mthar rang nyid kyang gzhan gyis gsod pa'am yang na rang gis gzhan bsad nas btson khang lcags kyi dra ba can du 'dzul te mnar gcod kyi sdug bsngal myong ba yin pas/ gong smos ltar bsams nas blo kha chos la phyogs pa zhig ci nas kyang yong thabs bya dgos pa yin no/ /ngo mtshar ba zhig la deng sang gi tshan rig 'phrul gyi gnas la mkhyen dpyod kyi 'jug pa yangs pa dag gis sa'i go la'i pha rol gyi go la gzhan pa'i steng du sems can gzhan yod med ma shes par kha cig gis yod shas che zhes dang / yang kha cig gis gtan nas med ces rang nyid rang la'ang yid ches med pa'i sdom tshig 'ol tshod kyis 'jog pa'i las su brel na yang / nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs kyi gzhung du/ 'jig rten khams 'dir sa'i go la yis mtshon pa'i mi yi gling dang / sa'i go la pha rol gyi nam mkha'i dbyings mtha' med pa'i skar ma'i go la yis mtshon pa'i lha min gyi gling / mi dang lha min las bar thag ha cang ring po yod pa'i nam mkha'i dbyings mtha' med 196

dza〉le lnga pa mong phyi'i sngonawāgropa'i skar ma'i go la yis mtshon pa'i lha'i gling ste/ mi'i 'jig rten dang / lha min gyi 'jig rten dang / lha'i 'jig rten sogs yod tshul legs par gsungs pa dang / lha min dang lha la deng sang yongs grags su 'jig rten gzhan pa'i mi zer ba yin/ nang pa sangs rgyas pas gna' snga mo ste mi lo nyis stong lhag gi sngon nas sa'i go la'i steng gi mi ma gtogs nam mkha'i dbyings mtha' med pa'i skar ma'i go la gzhan pa dag gi steng du'ang mi las mchog tu gyur pa'i sems can shes rab can zhig gnas shing 'tsho bzhin yod pa dang de dag gi 'tsho thabs 'tsho stangs sogs kyang gsal po zhig gsungs yod cing /phyis 'byung 'gro ba mi'i tshan rig 'phrul gyi rtsal 'di mi'i blo ngor mi shong ba zhig tu 'phel rgyas su song na/ da gzod nang pa sangs rgyas pas bzhed pa 'di ni yang dag bden pa'i gnas lugs shig yin pa rtogs thub pa yin/gzhan yang deng sang gi tshan rig 'phrul gyi gnas la mkhas pa'i mi rnams kyis kyang sa'i go la min pa'i go la gzhan pa'i steng du'ang sems can nam shes rab ldan pa'i sems can zhig yod par nges zhes sgrog bzhin mchis pa spyi dang /lhag par du rgyus med 'od sder byung ba'i rjes su go la gzhan pa'i steng du mi las mchog tu gyur pa'i sems can zhig yod ces kha tshon gcod bzhin yod pa des nang pa sangs rgyas pas bzhed pa'i don de rnams yang dag bden pa zhig yin pa rim gyis bden dpang byed bzhin yod tsa na/ deng sang gi blo dman pa 'ga' zhig gis sangs rgyas chos lugs ni rmongs dad yin zhes tha chad kyi ngag 'khyal smra ba'i rmongs pa'i mun pa'i phugs su mtshang 'byin gyi srid gsum gsal ba'i sgron me zhig sbar ba ma zad/ da dung nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs ni mi'i rgyud kyi mthu nus shes rab rtsal du 'don par byed pa'i tshe srog 197

dzaji macas rdzo sa la che rtswa'i ma gatho'igi tshan rig cig dang 'jig rten khams kyi gsang ba lkog gyur gyi gnas lugs ma lus gsal bar byed pa'i phyi snod kyi 'jig rten dang nang bcud kyi sems can gyi tshan rig cig yin par bden dpang byas yod/ des na nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs ni rmongs dad kyi lag cha zhig yin zhes brjod pa ni rmongs shing 'thoms pa'i gtam snying po med pa zhig yin pa rang bzhin gyis rtogs pa'i khar/ de ni 'dzam bu'i gling na bsgrun thabs med pa'i tshe srog gi tshan rig dang / 'jig rten gyi tshan rig rang byung khams kyi tshan rig rin thang gzhal du med pa zhig yin pa'ang tshegs med bde blag tu rtogs thub pas/ mi rnams kyis rang rang gi lus la rang chas su mnga' ba'i mthu nus shes rab rdzu 'phrul dag gi rtsal ma lus bton nas mi las mchog tu gyur pa zhig tu 'gyur snyam na/ nang pe sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs la thos bsam sgom gsum byed par 'bungs dgos/ de yang nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs ni/ lag len gyi nyams myong las gzhung lugs mtha' dag byung ba dang / slar yang de ltar byung ba'i gzhung lugs kyis lag len la khrid ston bya dgos zhes bshad pa ltar/ rang cag gi mnyam med ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas dka' ba shi la khad pa mang po zhig spyad nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mngon du byed pa'i lag len gyi brgyud rim dang thabs shes la sogs pa'i nyams myong phyogs bsdoms byas pa'i gzhung lugs khyad par can zhig yin/ de yang mdor bsdus nas bshad na nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs ni ston pa shākya thub pa sangs rgyas pa'i nyams myong phyogs bsdoms mdzad pa'i gzhung lugs shig yin stabs/ gzhung lugs 'dis 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pa'i gang zag rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mngon du byed par khrid ston byed pa yin 198

dza'ime lnga pa moja phyi'i smo 'grozhing / gzhung lugs 'dis khrid ston gnang ba ltar dam pa'i chos bsgrubs na sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob thub pa ni the tshom med pa zhig yin te/ dper na rlangs 'khor la kha lo bsgyur bar 'dod pa zhig gis thog mar rlangs 'khor kha lo bsgyur stangs la dpyis phyin par bslabs pa na phyis rlangs 'khor la dngos su kha lo bsgyur thub pa lta bu zhig yin no/ / de'i phyir chos byed par 'dod pa'i gang zag cig yin na/ thog mar mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma zhig btsal zhing /denas dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba dang / 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ las rgyu 'bras/'khor ba'i nyes dmigs sogs bcos ma min pa zhig bsams nas blo kha chos kyi phyogs su bskul ba de nyid gal bo che la nan tan bya dgos pa zhig yin par sems so lnga pa/ theg pa spyi'i rmang rdo skyabs 'gro/theg pa spyi'i rmang rdo skyabs 'gro ni/ dz+nyordzogs chen ma rig mun sel 〉las/ lnga pa skyabs 'gro ni/ de lta bu'i mi rtag pa dang 'khor ba spyi bye brag gi sdug bsngal legs par bsams te de la 'jigs nas sdug bsngal de dag las nges par skyob nus pa mchog gsum ma gtogs gzhan su gang gis kyang skyob par mi nus te/ o rgyan rin po che'i zhale nas/ 'khor ba'i dpon ni ji ltar bzang yang bslu/ / skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la bslu ba med/ / ces gsungs/ des na yid ches pa'i sgo nas skyabs su 'gro dgos te/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis kyang / bdag nyid lhag par 'jigs pa dang / /dkon mchog skyob pa'i nus ldan du/ / shes las byung ba'i skyabs 'gro ba/ /thams cad mkhyen pa khyod nyid bzhed/ / ces gsungs pa ltar/ skyo shas nges 199

dza'i ma chos rdzogs pa che yo'i mgazhagadza'i'abyung gis rgyud bskul nas yid khyed shes kyi dad pa shugs drag gis skyabs su song na/ dkon mchog gis bslu mi srid pa yin phyir/ bslu med dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo ste/ zhes gsungs/ de ltar na gang la skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul ni/ grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rje btsun mi la'i zhal nas/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum/ / 'di gsum phyi yi skyabs gnas lags/ / mi nged kyang khong la skyabs pas 'tshengs/ / khyed kyang khong la skyabs na legs/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum/ / 'di gsum nang gi skyabs gnas lags/ /nged kyang khong la skyabs pas 'tshengs/ / khyedangakyang khong la skyabs na legs/ /rtsa dang rlung dang thig le gsum/ / 'di gsum gsang ba'i skyabs gnas lags/ /nged kyang khong la skyabs par nyatshengs/ / khyed kyang khong la skyabs na legs/ /snang dang stong dang dbyer med gsum/ / 'di gsum don gyi skyabs gnas lags/ / nged kyang khong la skyabs pas 'tshengs/ / khyed kyang khong la skyabs na legs/ / zhes gsungs/ / de ltar shes nas dngos gzhi'i skyabs yul gsal 'debs ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkha' laḥ pad+ma stong brtsegs 'ja' 'od kyiḥ dbus dang phyogs bzhir gyes pa'i klong ཿ dbus su chos sku kun bzang laḥ dgongs brda' snyan brgyud bla rabs bskoraḥ g.yas su rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas laḥ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskoraḥgayon du pad+ma rgyal po yiḥ g.yas su rdor sems yab yum dngaḥ g.yon du mu khri btsan po laḥ sngags 'chang grub thob rgya mtshos bskoraḥ mdun du thugs rje chen po laḥ yum mchog gsang ba ye shes 'khrilaḥ yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bskoraḥ rgyab tu theg chen mdo lung chosaḥ gang 'dul chos kyi sgra dbyangs sgrogaḥ mtha' skor mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnamasaḥ ma 200

dza'ile lnga la mong phyi'i sngo wābrolus sprin ltar gtibs par 'gyuraḥ zhes pa ltar tshogs zhing gsal gdab/de nas skyabs 'gro dngos ni/ rang gi mtha' skor na rigs drug gi sems can thams cad lha mi'i rnam par yod par dmigs nas rang gis byang drangs te/dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob kyi bar du khyed rnams ma gtogs skyabs mgon gzhan ma mchis pas khyed rnams kyis bdag gzhan sems can thams cad 'khor ba 'di las myur du bsgral nas sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par mdzad du gsol snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag pos/ na moḥ skyabs yul dkon mchog bde gshegs gsumaḥ dngos grub stsol mdzad yi dam lhaḥmakha' 'grod dam can srung mar bcasaḥ skyabs su mchi'o byin gyis rlobasaḥzhes kha zhe gnyis med glo snying brang gsum gtad nas skyabs 'gro lan ci mang bya'o/ / de ltar skyabs su song bas skyabs yul la bcos min gyi nges shes skye ba dang sems can la snying rje dung nge 'char ba dang / 'khor ba'i chos la blo sna thung du 'gro ba ni skyabs song gi 'chad do/ /de nas skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya dang mi 'gal bar byas nas skyabs su 'gro ba la 'bad par bya'o/ / de ltar skyabs su song ba la/ phan yon mdo rgyud nas mtha' yas pa gsungs kyang / bsdu na brgyad du 'dus te/ nang pa sangs rgyas par chud pa'i phan yon dang / sdom pa thams cad kyi rten du 'gyur ba dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pas mi tshugs pa dang / sdig pa dang sgrib pa byang zhing srab par 'gyur ba dang / rgyud la bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po gsog cing 'phel ba dang / shi nas ngan 'gror mi ltung ba dang / lam khyad par 'phags pa rgyud la skye ba dang / mthar bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par gsungs so/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lam log pa las 201

༷:na zub lha mu casdo tho che 3) zudza:ni /sko 0yinakhyad par byed pa theg pa spyi'i rmang rdo lta bu'i skyabs 'gro la dbye na/ skyabs 'gro'i khyad par dang / skyabs su 'gro tshul/ skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya sogs yod/de las skyabs 'gro'i rtsa ba'am rgyu ni/ 〈yon tan mdzod 〉 las/'jigs dang dad dang snying rje rnam gsum gyis/ / gzhan don sems bskyed skyes bu chen po'i blos/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar mtha' med 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la 'jigs pa dang / skyabs yul gyi yon tan shes nas mi phyed pa'i dad pa skyes pa dang / mtha' yas pa'i sems can 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las sgrol ba'i khur 'khyer ba'i snying rje dang ldan pa gsum ni/ skyabs 'gro'i ngo bo yin zhing / yang de la dbye na/ dang po rang gcig pu ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal las thar bar 'dod pa 'bras bu lha mi'i go 'phang don du gnyer ba la skyes bu chung ngu'am nyi tshe ba'i skyabs 'gro zhes bya ba dang / de la 'jigs pas 'gro ba dang / 'dun pas 'gro ba/ zhe sdang gis 'gro ba/ gti mug gis 'gro ba bcas yod cing / de las 'jigs pas 'gro ba ni/ dgra gdon la 'jigs nas skyabs su 'gro ba zhig ste/ dper na mi zhig la dgra'i nyenakha byung ba'am yang na gdon gyi gnod pa byung ba sogs rang nyid dka' nyen zhig la phrad pa na da gzod skyabs su 'gro ba lta bu zhig yin/ 'dun pas 'gro ba ni/ rang dga' ba tsam gyi slad du 'gro ba ste/ dper na rang nyid dga' bar byed pa'i phan pa'am 'bras bu gang rung zhig 'thob pa'i ched du skyabs su 'gro ba lta bu zhig yin/ zhe sdang gis 'gro ba ni/ pha rol gzhan sde las rang rgyal bar 'dod pa'i ched du skyabs su 'gro ba zhig ste/ dper na rang gzhan gnyis kyis phan khe gang rung zhig rtsod pa'i dus su/ rang nyid pha 202

'jile lnga pa mong phyi'i sngo ribrorol las rgyal bar byed pa'i slad du skyabs su 'gro ba lta bu zhig yin/ gti mugagis 'gro ba ni/ skyabs yul gyi yon tan sogs ma shes par 'gro ba ste/dper na skyabs su 'gro ba'i phan yon dngos sam yon tan ma shes par gzhan mang po zhig gis skyabs su 'gro ba mthong ste ri bong cal 'drogs kyi tshul du skyabs su 'gro ba lta bu yin/ gnyis pa rang nyid gcig pu 'khor ba mtha' dag gi sdug bsngal las thar zhing / 'bras bu nyan rang gi go 'phang don du gnyer ba la skyes bu 'bring ngam mchog gi skyabs 'gro zhes bya'o/ / gsum pa skyes bu chung ngu dang 'bring gi cha logs nas rang don yid byed spangs shing /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la bsgral ba'i slad du skyabs su 'gro ba la skyes bu chen po zhes bya'o/ /skyabs su 'gro tshul ni/ 〈rgyud bla ma 〉las/ 'byung ba dkon phyir dri med phyir/ / mthu ldan phyir dang 'jig rten gyi/ / rgyan gyur nyid dang mchog nyid phyir/ / 'gyur ba med phyir dkon mchog nyid/ / ces gsungs pa ltar/dpe la mtshon nas bshad na/ nor bu rin po che ni 'jig rten na 'byung ba ches dkon pa dang / 'dam rdzab sogs kyi dri ma med pa/ dgos 'dod thams cad yid bzhin du 'jo ba'i mthu dang ldan pa/ 'jig rten na lha klu mi'i rgyal po sogs kyi gtsug gi rgyan yin pas rin po che kun las rab dang /phul dang / mchog tu gyur pa/ ngo bo gzhan du mi 'gyur ba dang drug gi yon tan lhun gyis rdzogs pa ltar/ sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun te dkon mchog gsum ni/ rin po che lta bu 'jig rten na dkon zhing mchog tu gyur pa zhig yin zhing / de yang bsod nams ma bsags pa la snang ba min pas 'byung ba dkon pa dang / rang bzhin gyis rnyog pa'i chos can ma yin 203

'ji ma chos rdzo sa pa che bsgo'i maphanazha dza〉pas dri ma med pa dang / rang gzhan gyi don sgrub pas mthu dang ldan pa/ 'gro ba rnams kyi bsam pa dge ba'i rgyu yin pas 'jig rten gyi rgyan nam 'jig rten las mchog tu gyur pa/ rnam par 'gyur ba'i rang bzhin can ma yin pas 'gyur ba med pa bcas kyi yon tan dang ldan pa zhig yin te/ ji skad du/sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum/ / thar pa 'dod pa rnams kyis skyabs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thun mong phyi'i skyabs yul ni/ theg chen gyi lugs ltar cung zad bshad na/ sangs rgyas la dbye na rten sku/ de la brten pa ye shes dang mdzad pa 'phrin las so/ / rten sku la rang bzhin ye dag dang /glo bur 'phral dag gi ngo bo nyid sku dang / de'i mkhyen cha ye shes chos kyi sku dang / nges pa lnga ldan (gnas nges pa 'og min stug po bkod pa kho nar bzhugs pa/ sku nges pa mtshan dpe yongs su gsal rdzogs kyis spras pa/'khor nges pa byang sems 'phags pa sha stag gis bskor ba/ chos nges pa theg chen gyi chos 'ba' zhig gsungs pa/ dus nges pa 'khor ba ji srid bar du bzhugs pa ste lnga'o/ / )gyi longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / mchog dang skye ba bzo sogs kyi sprul pa'i sku ste sku bzhi dang / de la brten pa'i ye shes ni/ chos nyid de bzhin nyid dbyings kyi ye shes dang / de'i mkhyen cha la ma 'gags pa me long dang / 'khor 'das gnyis su med pa rtogs pa'i mnyam nyid dang /shes bya ji snyed ma 'dres pa sa ler mkhyen pa'i sor rtog dang / gzhan don lhun grub tu mdzad pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes dang lnga'o/ / mdzad phrin ni/ 'gro ba'i don 'bad med rtag pa khyab pa lhun grub tu mdzad pa nyid yin/ dam chos ni/ lung dang rtogs pa gnyis yin zhing / de yang lung gi chos ni/ lung gi dam pa'i chos ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na rnam pa bcus legs par gsungs pa'i 204

tho'ile lnga pa mong phyi'i sngo dzinagrobaka' dang / bka'i dgongs 'grel bstan bcos gnyis te/ 〈lha'i bus zhus pa'i mdo 〉las/ chos rnams thams cad bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis su 'dus/ / legs par gsungs dang de yi dgongs 'grel pa/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang lung gi chos ni gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis te/ de gang zhe na/ tshig mdor bsdus shing don sde tshan du bcad pa mdo sde dang / dang po tshigs bcad kho nas gsungs pa tshigs su bcad pa'i sde dang / ma 'ongs pa na chos dang gang zag 'di lta bu 'byung bar lung bstan pa lung du bstan pa'i sde/ sngar tshigs lhug par gsungs pa slar tshigs su bcad nas gsungs pa dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa'i sde/ gzhan gyis zhu ma dgos par bstan pa gnas pa'i ched du bstan pa ched du brjod pa'i sde/ 'di lnga ni theg dman gyi mdo yin par bshad/ gang zag gi spyod pa la brten nas bcas pa mdzad pa gleng gzhi'i sde dang / de dus kyi gang zag gzhan gyi rtogs pa brjod pa rtogs brjod kyi sde/ sngon gang zag sogs 'di dang 'di lta bu byung bar brjod pa de lta bu byung ba'i sde ste gsum ni/ theg dman gyi 'dul ba yin par bshad cing /byang chub sems dpa'i slob lam gyi rnam thar brjod pa'i skyes rabs ni/ theg chen gyi 'dul ba dang / zab pa stong nyid dang / rgya che ba byang chub kyi sems gnyis rgya cher bstan pa shin tu rgyas pa'i sde dang / gzhi'i chos phung khams skyed mched/ lam gyi chos sa lam ting 'dzin/ 'bras bu'i chos sku dang ye shes su gtan la phab par bstan pa'i gtan phab sde ni/ theg pa che chung gnyis kas mngon par 'dod pa zhig yin no/ /rtogs pa'i chos ni/ 'gog lam gyi bden pa gnyis te/ 'gog pa'i bden pa dang ngo bo nyid sku/ spangs pa phun tshogs rnams don gcig ming gi 205

dza〉 ma chos rdzogs pa che yo'i ma zha dza'irnam grangs yin pas/ spang bya spangs pa'i cha 'bras bu zhi ba chos sku ste/ṭ+wāṃrgyud bla ma 〉las/ gang zhi gang gis chags bral ba/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/de la gang gis chags pa dang bral bar byed pa lam bden ni/ rtogs pa phun tshogs dang lam gyi bden pa gnyis don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin pa la/tshogs lam chung ngur dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi dang / 'bring du yang dag spong bzhi dang / chen por rdzu 'phrul rkang bzhi rnams bsgom pa dang / sbyor lam nges 'byed cha bzhir/ drod rtse gnyis su dbang po lnga dang / bzod chos gnyis su stobs lnga bsgom pa dang / mthong lam du byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang / sgom lam sa dgur 'phags lam yan lag brgyad bsgom pa sogs kyi yon tan de rnams lam gyi bden pa yin pas rtogs pa'i chos yin no/ / dge 'dun ni theg dman dge 'dun dang / theg chen dge 'dun gnyis las/ theg dman ni/ rgyun zhugs dang / lan gcig phyir 'ong dang /phyir mi 'ong ba dang / dgra bcom pa lam zhugs dang / 'bras gnas gnyis re btsis pa'i zung bzhi dang ya brgyad do/ / theg chen byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun de la/ rig pa'i yon tan gsum ni/ ji lta ba rig pa zhes stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa dang / ji snyed pa rig pa zhes shes bya'i gnas khong du chud pa dang / nang ye shes gzigs pa zhes thos bsam las lhag pa'i bsgom pa'i shes rab kyis gzigs pa yin no/ / grol ba'i yon tan gsum ni/chags sgrib las grol ba zhes chags sogs kyi dbye ba'i rang sa'i ngos skal gyi nyon sgrib las grol ba dang / thogs sgrib las grol ba zhes rang sa'i ngos skal gyi shes sgrib rags pa grol ba dang / dman sgrib las grol ba zhes rang don yid byed kyi blo dang bral ba yin no/ / yul de dag la skyabs su 'gro tshul ni/206

dza〉le lja pa mong phyi'i smo wābrosangs rgyas ni skyabs chos ston pa po yin pas na/ gus pas mchod par bya ba'i sgo nas 'gro ba dang / chos skyabs dngos yin pas/ bsgom zhing nyams su len pa'i sgo nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang / dge 'dun ni skyabs chos sgrub pa'i zla grogs yin pas/ de dang lhan cig 'grogs par bya'o snyam pas 'gro dgos pa yin no/ / gnyis pa thun min nang gi skyabs 'gro ni/ dkon mchog gsum de dag gi dngos zhes spyi gzugs sam ngo bor gyur pa de gang zhe na su ga ta zhes pa'i sgra las drangs na/ su ni legs pa'am bde ba/ ga ta ni gshegs pa ste/ lam nas 'bras bu'i bar du spangs rtogs mthar phyin pa'i byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam/ phrin las kyi rtsa ba mkha' 'gro chos skyong ste/gsum po la skyabs su 'gro tshul ni/ rang gi sgo gsum bla ma la 'bul/ yi dam la brten/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong la lam sgrub pa'i grogs byas nas skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /gsum pa gsang ba thabs mchog rdo rje snying po'i skyabs 'gro ni/ rtsa sprul skur brten/ rlung longs skur sbyangs/ thig le chos skur dag pa'i myur lam la skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /bzhi pa mthar thug bslu ba med pa gnas lugs rdo rje'i skyabs 'gro ni/sems dang chos kyi de bzhin nyid stong gsal 'dus ma byas pa'i gshis lugs sam rang bzhin ni/ rtsa shes las/ rang bzhin gyis rī bcos min dang / /gzhan la ltos pa med pa'o/ / zhes dang / bu ram rang bzhin mngar ba dang / /me yi rang bzhin tsha ba dang / / chu yi rang bzhin gsher ba ste/ / de bzhin choge rnams thams cad kyi/ / rang bzhin stong pa nyid du bshad/ / ces 207

dza'i ma chos rdzo sa la che yori ma zhagatswa'igasungs pa ltar/ de yang stong rkyang ma yin par rig stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems de nyid kyi ngo bo stong pa ye shes kyi snying po can/ chos sku'i mtshan nyid/ rang bzhin gsal ba 'od kyi snying po can/longs sku'i mtshan nyid/ thugs rje kun khyab rig pa'i snying po can/ / sprul sku'i mtshan nyid de rang rgyud la bsgrub byar byed cing / la zlo ba zhes thag gcig thog tu bcad par byas pa de yin/ de yang rgyu skyabs 'bras skyabs gnyis su phye ba'i/ mthar thug 'bras bu'i skyabs 'gro ste/ chos rgyal in+d+ra bhu tis mdzad pa'i ye shes grub pa las/ dag thob bral ba'i sems sangs rgyas/ /mi 'gyur dri med chos nyid dang / / yon tan lhun rdzogs dge 'dun te/ /yin phyir rang gi sems mchog nyid/ / ces so/ / de yang maṇ+ḍa la'i sgra las drangs na/ maṇ+ḍa ni snying po'am dkyil dang / la ni len pa'am 'dzin pa la 'jug pas/ snying po'i gzhi 'dzin pa zhes rnam pa gcig tu na gang gtso bo la 'khor gyis bskor ba'i don can gyis/ dkyil 'khor te/ thugs thig las/bkod pa gang rdzogs de ngo bo/ / zhes pa ltar/ 'di mjug sdud kyi tshig yin pas/ phyi gtso bo la 'khor gyis bskor ba dang / nang gsang de bzhin nyid gsum ni/ ngo mtshar ma bris pa/ rang bzhin lhun grub kyi dkyil 'khor yin pas/ de dag kun la mkha' mnyam gyi sems can thams cad ji srid byang chub snying po'i zhes/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su mchi zhes 'gro bar bgyi'o/ /tshogs zhing gsal 'debs tshul sogs dkyus ltar bya zhing /gsum pa phan yon dang bslab bya bstan pa ni/ phan yon mdor bsdus na brgyad de/ nang pa sangs rgyas kyi gral du tshud pa dang / sdom pa thams cad kyi rten du 'gyur ba dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pas mi tshugs pa dang /208

dza'ime lnga pa moja byi'i spo ribrosdig pa dang sgrib pa byang zhing srab par 'gyur ba dang / rgyud la bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po gsog cing 'phel ba dang / shi nas ngan 'gror mi ltung ba dang / lam khyad par du 'phags pa rgyud la skye ba dang / mthar thug bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par gsungs so/ / bslab bya ni/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song nas 'jig rten pa'i lha la phyag mi 'tshal/ chos la skyabs su song nas sems can la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i bsam pa spong / dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas grogs mu stegs can dang mi 'grogs pa gsum ni spang bya gsum dang /sangs rgyas la skyabs su song nas sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs tha na sāts+tsha chag dum yan chad la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bzhag nas gus par bya/ chos la skyabs su song nas gsung rten tha na yig 'bru gcig yan chad la/ dam pa'i chos kyi 'du shes bzhag nas gus par bya/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas dge 'dun gyi na bza' dang 'brel ba'i lhan pa dmar ser yan chad la/ dge 'dun dngos kyi 'du shes bzhag nas gus par bya ba gsum ni/ bsgrub bya gsum mo/ / gzhan yang ji skad du/ srog dang bya dgar dkon mchog gsum mi spang / / dgos gal che yang thabs gzhan mi 'tshol zhing / / dus mchod mi bcag rang gzhan skyabs 'gror 'god/ / gar 'gro'i phyogs kyi sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal/ / lnga rnams thun mong bslab byar jo bos bzhed/ / ces gsungs pa ltar dang / man ngag gi lugs la/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song ba'i brdar bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten/ chos la skyabs su song nas chos la thos bsam sgom gsum ci nus bya/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas dge 'dun gyi rtags dang mi 'bral bar bya ba dang gsum ni/ cha mthun gyi bslab bya zhes gsungs so/ /209

'ji ma chos rngo sa la che 0sgo'i ma zhagadza'ide yang 'di ltar bsam par bya ste/ 〈rdzogs chen snying tig sngon 'gro'i 'bru 'grel 〉las/ dang po lam thams cad kyi rmang rdo skyabs su 'gro ba'i khrid la/ skyabs 'gro'i dbye ba/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul/ phan yon dang bslab bya bstan pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni spyir chos thams cad kyi sgo dbye ba skyabs 'gro yin la/ skyabs 'gro'i sgo dbye ba ni/ dad pa yin pas skyabs su 'gro ba'i dang por rgyud la dad pa brtan po skye ba gal che/ dad pa de la'ang nang gses kyis dbye ba gsum yod de/ dang ba'i dad pa/ 'dod pa'i dad pa/ yid ches pa'i dad pa dang gsum yod/ dang po dang ba'i dad pa zhes bya ba ni/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rten dang bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams mjal ba'am/ de dag gi yon tan dang rnam thar thos tshe 'phral du sems la dang ba 'dren nas dad pa skyes pa de la dang ba'i dad pa zhes bya/ 'dod pa'i dad pa ni/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal las bral 'dod/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i bde ba thob 'dod skye ba/ dge ba sgrub 'dod/ sdig pa spong 'dod skye ba rnams yin/ yid ches pa'i dad pa ni/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi yon tan dang byin rlabs thun mong ma yin pa shes nas/snying thag pa nas yid ches/ skyid rung sdug rung na rung tsha rung shi rung gson rung dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du skyabs bslu ba med pa dkon mchog gsum po mkhyen snyam du blo bkal/ blo gtad dang re ltos gzhan na med par yidasted shes kyi dad pa dang ldan pa la yid ches pa'i dad pa zhes bya ste/ o rgyan rin po che'i zhal nas/ yid khyed shes kyi dad pas byin rlabs 'jug /blo the tshom dang bral na ci bsam 'grub/ / ces gsungs/ des na dad pa ni chos dkar po'i yon tan thams cad bskyed pa'i sa bon lta bu yin pas med 210

dza'ile thu sda mong byi'itsā lithabs med/ dad pa med na sa bon mes tshig pa dang 'dra ba ste/ mdo las/dad pa med pa'i mi rnams la/ / dkar po'i chos ni mi 'byung ste/ / sa bon me yis tshig pa la/ / myu gu sngon po ji bzhin no/ / zhes dang / yang / dad med brag phug byang bstan lta bu la/ / thugs rje'i nyi ma nam yang 'char dus med/ /cesagasungs/ des na bla ma dang dkon mchog gi thugs rje dang byin rlabs rang rgyung la 'jug pa ni mos gus dang ldan pa kho/ na la rag las te/ snying thag pa nas dad pa dang mos gus yod na sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje la nye ring med de/ji skad du/ gang gis mos pas yid byed pa/ / de yi mdun du thub pa bzhugs/ /dbang bskur byin gyis brlab par 'gyur/ / zhes dang / o rgyan chen pos/ dad pa can gyi gang zag pho mo la/ / pad 'byung gang du'ang ma bzhud sgo nyal yod/ / nga yi tshe la 'das grongs yod ma yin/ / dad ldan mi re'i mdun na pad 'byung re/ / zhes gsungs/ des na dad pa dang mos gus thun mong ma yin pa zhig gi sgo nas yid khyed shes kyi blo gzhan du mi 'gyur ba zhig ni/skyabs su 'gro ba'i sgo 'byed lta bu yin pas med thabs med/ de lta bu'i dad pa dang ldan pa'i skyabs 'gro de la yang / kun slong gi sgo nas dbye na gsum ste/'di ltar ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal la 'jigs shing skrag nas mtho ris lha dang mi'i bde ba tsam don du gnyer bas skyabs su 'gro na/ skyes bu chung ngu'i skyabs 'gro zhes bya/ 'khor ba'i gnas ris 'di mtho dman gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das par shes nas/ rang nyid 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las grol ba'i zhi ba myang 'das kyi go 'phang tsam don du gnyer nas/dkonaspachog gsum la skyabs su 'gro na skyes bu 'bring gi skyabs 'gro zhes bya/mtha'amed pa'i 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po na gnas pa'i sems 211

dza'i ma chos rngo sa la chenabasgo'i ma kadza〉can 'di dag thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pas mnar bar mthong nas/ de dag thams cad rnam mkhyen bla na med pa/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god pa'i ched du skyabs su 'gro na skyes bu chen po'i skyabs 'gro zhes bya ste/ 'dir da res sems can rnams sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyis skyes bu chen po'i skyabs su 'gro ba ni bsod nams tshad med pa'i 'jug ngogs yin pas de lta bu bslab par bya'o/ / gnyis pa skyabs su 'gro tshul ni/ thun mong theg pa'i lugs la sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan gyi sangs rgyas la ston pa/ lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid kyi chos la lam/rig grol gnyis ldan gyi dge 'dun la lam sgrub pa'i grogs su mos te/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang / thun mong ma yin pa gsang sngags spyi'i tshul gyis dkon mchog gsum dngos sam ngo bo bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi bdag nyid byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bla ma la sgo gsum 'bul/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam la bsten/'phrin las kyi rtsa ba mkha' 'gro la grogs kyi tshul du byas nas rtsa ba gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / khyad par thabs mchog rdo rje snying po'i lugs la co sprul skur bsten/ rlung longs skur sbyangs/ thig le chos skur dag pa'i rang bzhin byang chub kyi sems mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i myur lam la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / mthar thug bslu ba med pa'i gnas lugs rdo rje'i skyabs 'gro ni skyabs yul de dag gi thugs rgyud la bzhug pa'i gnyis med rang byung gi ye shes ngo bo stong pa/ rang bzhin gsal ba/ thugs rje kun khyab rnam gsum dbyer med chen po'i don gyi dkyil 'khor chen po rang rgyud la bsgrub byar byed cing la zlo ba'i tshul gyis/ dus byang chub snying po'i go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su mchi'o/ / zhes dang / de ltar skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul thams cad nges par 212

dza'ile lnga pa mong phyi'i rngo lhunabyas nas skyabs su 'gro ba dngos kyi skabs su skyabs 'gro'i tshogs zhing gsal 'debs pa ni/ rang nyid 'dug pa'i saphyogs 'di nyid rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i zhing khams mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba me long gi ngos ltar 'jam pa/ de'i dbus su rang nyid kyi mdun du dpag bsam gyi sdong po yal ga lnga pa lo 'dab dang me tog 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa la rin po che'i 'phyang 'phrul dril g.yer la sogs pas rnam par brgyan pas nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab pa de'i dbus kyi yal ga'i steng du selha chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan la sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa la/ rnam pa o rgyan rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i stabs su bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa sdigs pa'i tshul du 'dzin pa/ g.yon mnyam bzhag gi steng na ka pā la 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis bkang ba'i bum pa dpag bsam ljon shing gi kha rgyan dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ sku la za ber chos gos phod ka mnabs pa/ dbu la pad zhu gsol ba/ yum mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar zhal rang la phyogs pa'i tshul gyi bzhugs par bsgom/de'ispya bor brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad tho brtsegs kyi tshul du gsal gdab dgos pa la/ rdzogs chen snying thig rtsa ba'i brgyud pa/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rdo rje sems dpa'/ sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ gu ru shrī sing ha/ mkhas pa dz+nyā na su tra/ paṇa chen dri med bshes gnyen/ o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas/ de'i g.yas su chos 213

tho'i mthe sa rngo sa la che bsdo'i ma tho〉rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan/ g.yon du lo chen be+e ro tsa na/ mdun du mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal te thugs sras rje 'bangs grogs gsum/ kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams/ rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa/ 'jigs med 'phrin las 'od zer/ 'jigs med rgyal ba'i myu gu/ mkhyen brtse ye shes rdo rje/dpalaglo rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po sogs rang rang gi rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs par gsal la/ gong ma'i bzhugs gdan la 'og ma'i dbu ma reg tsam du bzhugs par bsgom/ de'i mtha' skor du 'phags bod kyi rdzogs chen snying thig brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang / yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ mdun gyi yal ga'i steng du bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba shākya thub pa la phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis bskor ba/ thams cad kyang mchog gi sprul sku tshangs par spyod pa'i cha byad can/ dbu la gtsug tor dang zhabs la 'khor lo sogs mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs thams cad rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ sku mdog thams cad dkar ser dmar ljang mthing gagayas kyi yal ga'i steng du rgyal sras rigs gsum mgon po gtso bor gyur pa'i nye ba'i sras chen brgyad la byang sems 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyis bskor ba/thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar ser dmar ljang mthing ga longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rgyan chas bcu gsum gyis mdzes shing / zhabs thams cad mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ g.yon gyi yal gar shā ri'i bu dang mo'u 'gal gyi bu ste nyan thos mchog gnyis la nyan rang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyis bskor ba/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po/ sku la chos gos rnam gsum gsol ba/ phyag na 'khar gsil dang lhung bzed sogs bsnams pa zhabs thams 214

dzajile hā la moja gyi'i sngo rigrocad bzhengs stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rgyab kyi yal gar chos dkon mchog glegs bam brtsegs pa'i rnam pa can 'od kyi drwa mig gi klong na gdong dar rang la bstan te ā li kā li'i rang sgra sgrog pa/ de dag gi bar mtshams thams cad ye shes dang las las grub pa'i dpal mgon chos srung pho rgyud thams cad zhal phyir phyogs nas rang gi dam chos byang chub sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad srung zhing phyi'i bar chad nang du mi gtong ba'i 'phrin las mdzad pa/ chos skyong srung ma mo rgyud thams cad zhal nang du phyogs nas nang gi dngos grub phyir mi gtong ba'i 'phrin las mdzad pa/ de dag thams cad kyang mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi yon tan dpag tu med pas bdag nyid la rjes su brtse zhing / 'dren pa'i ded dpon chen po gcig tu bzhugs par bsam/ rang gi g.yas su lus rten 'di'i pha/ g.yon du ma/ mdun du dgra bgegs gnyis kyis gtso byas khams gsum rigs drug gi sems can thams cad sa gzhi'i ngos na khrom tshogs pa ltar thal mo sbyar te sgo gsum gus pa'i sgo nas dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po ma thob kyi bar du bla ma dkon mchog rin po che khyed la bsten/khyed la 'bul/ khyed las gzhan pa'i skyabs dang re sa med do snyam pa'i gdung ba drag pos/ dkon mchog gsum dngos sogs skyabs 'gro ci nus bsags/mthar thun bsdu ba'i tshe rang gi mos gus dung dung ba byas pa'i rkyen gyis skyabs yul lha tshogs rnams kyi sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad la phog pas rang gzhan sems can thams cad bya khyu 'urardo gcig gis dkrogs pa ltar skyabs yul lha tshogs rnams la thim/ lha tshogs rnams kyang mtha' nas rim bzhin 'od du zhu nas dbus kyi bla ma skyabs gsum kun 'dus la thim/ bla ma yang 'od du yal te chos sku spros bral gdod 215

tho'i ma sna sa rngo sa ba can bsgo'i /sko tho'i ma'i ngang la ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag de las ldang ba'i tshe dge ba sems can gyi don du bsngo bar bya/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad du dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la yid khyed shes kyi dad pas blo bkal te skyabs 'gro kho na la brtson par bya'o/ / gsum pa bslab bya dang phan yon bstan pa la/dang po bslab bya la/ spang bya gsum/ bsgrub bya gsum/ cha mthun gsum las/ dang po spang bya gsum ni/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song nas rang nyid 'khor ba na 'khor ba'i tshangs dbang sogs 'jig rten pa'i lha dang / gnod sbyin dang rgyal po la sogs 'dre 'byung po rnams la phyi ma'i skyabs gnas su bzung nas phyag dang mchod pa la sogs mi bya/ chos la skyabs su song nas sems can rnams la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i bsam pa rmi lam du mi bya bar rtag tu brtse bar bya/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas grogs mu stegs can dang de dang cha 'dra ba'i lta spyod log pa rnams dang mi 'grogs/ gnyis pa bsgrub byagasum ni/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song nas sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi sku'i rten chag dum yan chad la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bskyed la gus pas mchod cing gtsang sar bzhag chos la skyabs su song nas gsung rab yi ge ras ser po dang ngur smrig gcig yan chad la dge 'dun dkon mchog dngos kyi 'du shes bskyed la gus par bya'o/ / gsum pa cha mthun gsum ni/rang la blang dor gyi gnas ston pa'i bla ma la sangs rgyas dkon mchog dngos kyi 'du shes bzhag nas tha na sku'i grib ma tsam la yang mi 'gom par zhabs tog dang bsnyen bkur la 'bad/ bla ma'i gsung rnams la chos dkon mchog dngos kyi 'du shes bzhag nas ci gsung dang du blang zhing gsung gi zur tsam yang mi bcag bla ma'i 'khor dang mched grogs rnams la dge 'dun dkon 216

dzajile lnga pa mong phyi'i sngo rimachog dngos kyi 'du shes bzhag nas sgo gsum gus pas bsten no/ / khyad par gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa 'dir skyabs yul gyi gtso bo bla ma yin pas/ bla ma'i sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs sangs rgyas yin pas yid khyed shes kyi dad pas bsten zhing gsol ba 'debs pa la 'bad/ gal te rang gi spyod pa ngan pas thugs sun phyungs na skyabs yul thams cad spang 'gro bas ci mdzad legs mthong gi mos gus dang snying rus kyis bla ma mnyes pa'i thabs la brtson par bya'o/ / spyir skyid sdug legs nyes ci byung yang blo bla ma dkon mchog kho na la gtad/ phan pa dang bde ba'i dngos po ci yod pa dkon mchogagi thugs rjer shes par bya/ nad dang sdug bsngal la sogs pa'i rkyen ngan ci byung yang dkon mchog gsum la blo gtod cing gsol ba 'debs pa ma gtogs thabs gzhan mi tshol/ dus rtag tu ci 'byor gyi mchod pa la brtson zhing / tha na'ang ci za ci 'thung gi phud kyis mchod cing yon tan dran pa'i sgo nas nyin mtshan dus drug la sogs par skyabs 'gro bya zhing / gzhan la'ang skul ma gdab/ bla ma'i yon tan brjod cing mdzad spyod la bslab/ dkon mchog gi yon tan brjod cing rjes su bslab par bya'o/ / des thar pa'i lam du zhugs shing nang pa sangs rgyas pa zhig yin phyin chad skyabs 'gro dang skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya srog la babs kyang mi 'dor bar nyams su blang dgos/ de ltar skyabs su song ba'i phan yon ni/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba 'di ni chos thams cad kyi gzhi rten yin te/ gang gis skyabs su song ba tsam gyis thar pa'i sa bon 'debs pa dang / mi dge ba'i tshogs las ringu du byed pa dang / dge ba gong du 'phel ba dang / sdom pa kun gyi rten gzhir 'gyur zhing / yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas su 'gyur ba dang / gnas 217

tho〉 ma chos rngo sa la che bsdo'i ma 4〉skabs su yang dkar phyogs kyi lha rnams kyis bsrung zhing smon pa yid bzhin du 'grub pa dang / rtag tu dkon sachog gsum gyi snang ba dang mi 'bral zhing tshe rabs dran pa dang / 'di phyir bde zhing mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa sogs phan yon dpag tu med de/ phar phyin bsdus pa las/ skyabs song bsod nams gzugs mchis na/ / khams gsum 'di yang snod du chung / / rgya mtsho chen po chu yi gter/ / phul gyis gzhal bar ga la nus/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar phan yon tshad med pa dang ldan pas chos thams cad kyi rten gzhi skyabs su 'gro ba'i gnas 'di la nan tan du bya dgos so/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ de ltar bsams nas blo kha chos su bsgyur par nyin mtshan kun tu 'bad par bya'o/ / drug pa/ theg chen rtsa ba sems bskyed pa/theg chen gyi rtsa ba sems bskyed pa ni/ 〈rdzogs chen ma rig mun sel 〉las/ drug pa sems bskyed pa ni/ mar gyur sems can thams cad 'khor ba spyi dang bye brag gi sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i tshul la bsam ste bu sdug shi ba'i dus kyi ma bzhin du bzod glags med pa'i snying rje shugs drag pos mchi ma 'khrug nus pa tsam gyis blo bskul nas/ 'di rnams da lta nyid du thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la 'god thub na ci ma rung / da lta 'di rnams sgrol ba'i nus pa mi 'dug pas da ni sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i phyir du da nas bdag gi lus dang srog la phangs pa med par 'di rnams kyi don du lam zab mo 'di rnams nyams su blangs nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byas te/ 'khor ba na gnas pa'i sems can gcig kyang mi 218

dza'ime lnga pa mong byi'i sngo lhunakroganas pa de tsam du brtson 'grus brtsam mo snyam pa'i ngag tu/ hoḥ dbyings rig ngo bo ma bcos pa'iḥ gcig tu shar ba snying rje'i yulaḥ cir snang ma gyur sangs rgyas zhingaḥ byang chub lam la sems mchog bskyedaḥ ces sems bskyed lan mang du bya'o/ /de ltar sems bskyed byas pa'i phan yon ni/ de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems kyi bsod nams gang / / de la gal te gzugs mchis na/ / nam mkha'i khams ni kun gang ste/ / de ni de bas lhag par 'gyur/ / sems can kun gyi bsod nams kyi/ / phung po ji snyed yongs bzung ba/ / de snyed byang chub sems dpa' yi/ / byang chub sems la rab tu 'byung / / zhes dang / spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems skyes gyur na skad cig la/ / 'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa'i nyam thag rnams/ / rgyal ba rnams kyis sras zhes rab brjod de/ /'jig rten lha mir bcas pas phyag byar 'gyur/ / zhes pa la sogs pa'i phan yon mtha' yas pa mdo rgyud nas gsungs so/ / mjug tu byang chub kyi sems mi nyams par rgyud la brtan phyir bslab bya ni/ rab sems can re re'i don du yang phan par 'dug na rang gi lus srog phangs med du gtong ba dang / tha ma'ang bdag pas gzhan gces kyi blo la gzhol bar bya'o/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar dang po sbyor ba tshad med bzhi la blo sbyong ba dang / gnyis pa dngos gzhi byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang /gsum pa rjes su bslab bya'i rim pa bcas ni sems bskyed kyi gzhi dang rtsa ba zhig yin/de yang tshad med bzhi ni/ theg chen pas sems can tshad med par dmigs nas bsgoms te bsod nams 'phen par byed pa'i sems bzhi ste/219

dza'i ma chos rdzo sa pa che yo'i ma zhagadza'ibyams pa tshad med dang / snying rje tshad med/ dga' ba tshad med/ btang snyoms tshad med bcas yin zhing / de las byams pa tshad med ces pa ni/ dmigs pa sems can tshad med pa la dmigs nas rnam pa bde ba rgyu 'bras gnyis dang ldan par bya'o snyam du sems pa zhig yin la/ byams pa'i dmigs yul ni/ sems can bde ba med pa la dmigs pa dang / rnam pa ni sems can de dag rgyu dge ba/ 'bras bu bde ba tshad med pa dang 'phrad pa'am ldan na ci ma rung 'dod pa'o/ / snying rje tshad med ni/ dmigs pa sems can tshad med pa la dmigs nas rnam pa sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral bar bya'o snyam du sems pa zhig yin zhing / snying rje'i dmigs yul ni/ rgyu sdig pa dang 'bras bu sdug bsngal la dngos su spyod pa rnams la dmigs pa dang / rnam pa ni rgyu mi dge ba dang 'bras bu sdug bsngal dang bral na ci ma rung snyam pa'o/ /dga' ba tshad med ni/ dmigs pa sems can tshad med pa la dmigs nas rnam pa sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dam pa dang mi 'bral bar bya'o snyam du sems pa zhig yin zhing / de'i dmigs yul ni sems can gnas skabs mthar thug kun tu bde skyid dang ldan pa zhig la dmigs pa dang / rnam pa ni bde ba tshad med pa rnams dang mi 'bral bar 'dod pa'o/ / btang snyoms tshad med ni/ dmigs pa sems can tshad med pa la dmigs nas rnam pa nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i ngang la gnas par bya'o snyam du sems pa zhig yin zhing / de'i dmigs yul ni sems can nye ring chags sdang can la dmigs pa ste/ blo'i rnam pa ni gnyen la chags pa btang / dgra la sdang ba btang nas/dgra gnyen la sems snyoms pa'o/ / de rnams lag len du 'khyer ba'i dus su dmigs pa yid la byed pa dang / smon pa yid la byed pa dang / rnam pa yid 220

dza'ile lja blo moja byi'itsā rikrol byed pa gsum las/ rnam pa yid la byas nas bsgom na rgyud la skye sla bar gsungs shing / sems can la dmigs pa dang / chos la dmigs pa dang /dmigs pa med pa sogs tshad bzhi re re la'ang spyor bar bya'o/ /dngos gzhi byang chub tu sems bskyed pa ni/ smon pa dang 'jug pa rang gi rgyud tshod dang mthun par khas blangs nas yang dang yang du blo sbyong ba zhig yin/rjes bslab bya'i rim pa ni/ smon pa'i bslab bya dang / 'jug pa'i bslab bya gnyis las/ dang po smon pa'i bslab bya ni/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa dang / brje ba dang / bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems gsum la blo sbyong ba'o/ / gnyis pa 'jug pa'i bslab bya ni/ 〈phar phyin drug 〉las/ dang po sbyin pa'i phar phyin gyi ngo bo ni/ khyad chos bzhi ldan gyi gtong sems dge ba sa bon dang bcas pa yin zhing / de la dbye na zang zing gi sbyin pa dang / chos kyi sbyin pa dang / mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa'o/ / gnyis pa tshul khrims kyi ngo bo ni/ khyad chos bzhi ldan gyi spong sems sa bon dang bcas pa ste/ de la dbye na nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang / dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims dang gsum yod/gsum pa bzod pa'i ngo bo ni/ mi 'khrugs pa'i sems sa bon dang bcas pa ste/ de la dbye na gzhan gyi log sgrub bzod pa'i bzod pa dang / chos phyir dka' spyad bzod pa'i bzod pa/ chos nyid zab mo'i don la mi skrag pa'i bzod pa dang gsum mo/ / bzhi pa brtson 'grus kyi ngo bo ni/ khyad chos bzhi ldan gyi dge tshogs la spro bzhin 'jug pa'i dge sems sa bon dang bcas pa ste/de la dbye na sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus dang / go cha'i brtson 'grus/ chog shes 221

tho'i ma' sa rngo saphab che 44'i ma tho'imed pa'i brtson 'grus dang gsum mo/ / lnga pa bsam gtan gyi ngo bo ni/ khyad chos bzhi ldan gyi dmigs pa la rtse gcig pa'i sems sa bon dang bcas pa ste/de la dbye na byis pa nyer spyod kyi bsam gtan dang / don rab 'byed pa'i bsam gtan/ de bzhin gshegs dge'i bsam gtan dang gsum mo/ / drug pa shes rab kyi ngo bo ni/ chos rab tu rnam par 'byedatshopa'i sems pa sa bon dang bcas pa ste/ de la dbye na thos pa'i shes rab dang / bsam byung gi shes rab/ sgom byung gi shes rab dang gsum mo/ / gong du smos pa'i phar phyin drug re re bzhin khyad chos bzhi dang ldan pa'i sgo nas nyams su len dgos te/〈mdo sde rgyan 〉las/ sbyin pa'i mi mthun phyogs nyams dang / / rnam par mi rtog ye shes ldan/ / 'dod pa thams cad yongs rdzogs byed/ / sems can rnam smin byed pa gsum/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de yang smon pa dang 'jug pa'i khyad par ni/ 'bras bu la dam bca' ba smon pa dang / rgyu la dam bca' ba 'jug pa yin par gsungs/ sems can gzhan don byed pa'i bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi ni/ sbyin pas 'khor du bsdu— ba dang / snyan par smra ba dang /gdul bya chos kyi don la spyod du 'jug pa dang / rang gzhan la bstan pa de bzhin de'i don dang mthun par spyod pa dang bzhi yin la/ de ltar don dam byang chub kyi rtsal snang kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems tshad med bzhi sogs kyi ngang nas sems bskyed par bya dgos te/ 〈rdzogs chen klong chen snying tig gi sngon 'gro'i 'bru 'grel 〉las/ dang po tshad med bzhi'i blo sbyong ba la/ dang po btang snyoms zhes bya ba ni/ dgra la zhe sdang btang / gnyen la dga' gdung btang / sems can thams cad la nye ring dang chags sdang med par snyom pa la btang snyoms zhes bya/ da lta'i gnas skabs na pha ma dang gnyen 'dun 222

dza'ile lja la mong byi'itsā risogs rang phyogs la shin tu chags/ dgra dang de'i phyogs la sdang zhen mi bzod par byed pa 'di yang ma brtags pa'i skyon du 'dug 'di ltar tshe rabs snga mar dgras kyang gnyen byas/ gnyen gyis kyang dgra byas pa la the tshom med/ da lta'ang dgrar bzung yang des rang la gnod thub pa'i nges pa'ang med/ rang gis bstun shes na gnyen bzhin phan thogs pa'ang srid la/gnyen yin kyang bu tshas pha ma bslu ba bzhin/ 'gal zla dang bsdongs nas de'i phyogs bzung / nor 'phrog pa rtsod pa 'gyed pa sogs mthong chos su gyur pa dang / gal te gcig la mdza' ba ltar snang yang / de la mi 'dod pa byung tshe rang la'ang sdug bsngal bskyed cing gnas skabs kyi bde ba 'joms pa dang /mthar thug dge ba'i gegs rlabs po che byas te ngan song du bskyur ba'ang yod na de las dgrar gyur pa ci zhig yod/ ma 'ongs pa'i cha la yang dgra gnyen du 'gyur ba dang / gnyen dgra ru 'gyur ba sogs nges pa med/ des na sems can thams cad la nye ring chags sdang dang bral te thams cad phan 'dogs pa'i yul du mnyam zhing snyoms par blta'o snyam du drang srong gis mgron 'gyed pa ltar nam mkhas gar khyab kyi sems can thams cad la khyad par med pa byung gi bar blo sbyong ngo / / de nas byams pa sgom pa ni sems can thams cad la dmigs nas/ bu tsha chung ngur pha mas brtse zhing log sgrub bzod pa ltar/sems can de dag bde ba dang legs pa'i dpal dang ldan na ci ma rung /thabs ji lta bus phan gdags par bya snyam du bsam la/ lus ngag gi spyod lam rnams kyang 'jam zhing snyan par smra ba la sogs pas sems can rnams bde thabs skyid thabs kho na la brtson pa bya mas byi'u gso ba ltar byams pa bsgom zhing rtsal sbyong ngo / / de nas snying rje sgom pa ni/ gang zhig nag can 223

tho'i mabatsus casdo sa la 3) bsgo'i zub 〈chobatson dong du bcug pa de nyid mthar gsod du nye ba'am/ shan pa'i mdun sar dud 'gro ba'i 'chi kha ma lta bu'i sems can sdug bsngal drag pos mnar ba zhig blo yul du bsams la/ de la brtse ba'i yul ma dang bu'i 'du shes bskyed de sdug bsngal 'di las da lta nyid du myur ba nyid du thar na ci ma rung snyam pa'i snying rje shas mi bzod pa mchi ma thon pa sgom zhing / de nas rim par ngan song gsum la sogs pa dang / der skye ba'i rgyu mi dge las la spyod pa thams cad la bsgom/ de rnams la snying rje skyes nas mthar nam mkhas gar khyab sems can gyis khyab/ sems can gyis gar khyab las ngan dang sdug bsngal gyis khyab pas/las ngan dang sdug bsngal kho na la spyod pa'i sems can 'di rnams snying re rje/'di thams cad rigs drug so so'i las snang sdug bsngal bag chags thams cad dang bral nas/ gtan gyi bde ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob na ci ma rung snyam du snying thag pa nas bsgom zhing mthar mi dmigs pa'i ngang du mnyam par 'jog go / de nas dga' ba ni/ mtho ris kyi yul na su zhig bde zhing skyid pa/ tshe ring ba 'khor mang ba/ longs spyod dang ldan pa zhig dmigs yul du bsams nas/ de la 'gran sems dang phrag dog med par/da dunge 'di bas kyang mngon mtho'i dpal gyis 'byor zhing 'tshe ba med pa/shes rab che ba la sogs pa'i phun sum tshogs par shog cig sems can gzhan rnams kyang 'di lta bu'i go 'phang la gnas na nga re dga' snyam pa dang /khyad par du rang la gnod byed kyi dgra dang sems la phrag dog gi gnas su gyur pa thams cad la/ gzhan 'byor phun sum tshogs pa la mi bzod pa'i blo ngan gyi rtsa ba drung nas phyungs te/ bde ba dang ldan pa'i cha thams cad la dga' ba khyad par can rnga mong gis rnge'u stor nas rnyed pa ltar dga' ba bsgom 224

dza'ile lnga pa mong ci'i sngo rigrozhing mthar dmigs pa med pa'i ngang la bzhag go / de ltar tshad med pa bzhi po yang tshur bsdus na bsam pa bzang po zhig la 'du ba yin pas dus rtag tu bsam pa bzang po kho na la bslab dgos te/ ji skad du/ bsam pa bzang na sa dang lam yang bzang / / bsam pa ngan na sa dang lam yang ngan/ / thams cad bsam pa dag la rag las pas/ / rtag tu bsam pa bzang la 'bad par bya/ / zhes gsungs so/ / gnyis pa sems bskyed pa dngos la/ blo stobs kyi sgo nas dbye na gsum yod de/ sngon la rang nyid sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byas nas rjes su sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par 'dod pa lta bu'i sems bskyed/ rang dang sems can thams cad lhan cig tu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'dod na mnyan pa lta bu'am ye shes dam pa'i sems bskyed/ sngon la sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la bkod de phyi nas rang nyid 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pa rdzi bo lta bu'am dpe med pa'i sems bskyed dang gsum/ sa mtshams kyis dbye na/ tshogs sbyor gyi lam na mos pas spyod pa'i sems bskyed/ sa dang po nas bdun pa'i bar la lhag bsam rnam dag gi sems bskyed/ dag pa sa gsum na rnam par smin pa'i sems bskyed/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na sgrib pa spangs pa'i sems bskyed dang bzhi/ sems bskyed rang gi ngo bos dbye na/ kun rdzob sems bskyed dang don dam sems bskyed gnyis yod/ kun rdzob sems bskyed la yang nang gses kyi dbye ba gnyis te/ smon pa sems bskyed dang / 'jug pa sems bskyed gnyis/ de yang spyod 'jug las/ 'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba yi/ /bye brag ji ltar shes pa ltar/ / de bzhin mkhas pas 'di gnyis kyi/ / bye brag rim bzhin shes par bya/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dang po ngas sems can 225

dza〉 ma'adzus rdzo sa pa che 'dza'i ma gadza'i thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa zhig bya snyam pa ni/'gro bar 'dod pa lta bu smon pa sems bskyed/ sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i ched du/ sbyin pa gtong ba sogs lam pha rol tu phyin pa drug la dngos su slob pa ni/ 'gro ba dngos lta bu 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems yin/ don dam sems bskyed mtshan nyid pa bsgom stobs kyis thob dgos pas cho ga la mi ltos/ 'dir las dang po pas kun rdzob sems bskyed cho ga la ltos pa yin pas bla ma las len tshul sems bskyed 'bog chog ltar bya/ de ltar thob pa'i sems bskyed de mi nyams shing brtan pa gong du 'phel ba'i phyir yang dang yang du blang dgos/ de yang mdun gyi nam mkhar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs sems bskyed kyi dpang por dmigs la/ 'di ltar nam mkha'i mthas khyab pa'i sems can 'di thams cad pha mar ma gyur pa ni gcig kyang med/ pha mar gyur pa'i tshe da lta'i sgo nas bskyed bsrings pa'i drin can sha stag yin par nges/ de lta ba'i ༄pha ma drin can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi gnas 'dir bzhag nas rang nyid gcig pu thar pa la dgos pa ci yod/ de'i phyir bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas sngon gyi rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mdzad spyod rlabs po che la bslab cing /'khor na sems can gcig kyang mi gnas pa de tsam du brtson 'grus brtsam mo snyam pas/ ho zhes pa ngo mtshar ba'i don te/ de yang 'di ltar sems can thams cad rang rang gis las mi 'dra ba du ma bsags pa'i las dang bag chags kyi dbang gis/ 'khor ba'i gnas ris dang / dngos po sna tshogs/bde sdug sna tshogs kyi tshul du snang ba rnams don la med bzhin du snang ba ma 226

dza'ile lnga pa moja byi'i smo wābro'agags pa'i chu zla'i gzugs brnyan snang yang bden par ma grub pa ltar rdzun gyis ris su bris pa kun rdzob kyi chos bslu ba'i rang bzhin can la zhen cing chags pas/ 'khor ba nas 'khor bar skye zhing rgyun 'brel te lu gu rgyud ltar bar ma chad par sdug bsngal kho na'i ngang du 'khyams pa'i 'gro ba 'di dag thams cad las snang sna tshogs kyi sdug bsngal bag chags dang bcas pa bral nas/ rang gi rig pa bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po 'od gsal ba'i ye shes spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i dbyings su dbugs 'byin gyi ngal gso thob tshoparakhya ba'i phyir du/ tshad med pa bzhi yi don rnams dran par byas la de'i ngang nas sems thams cad 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god 'dod kyis smon pa dang / de'i rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa rnams la bslab par bya ba 'jug pa'i semasaganyis bskyed do/ / zhes lan mang du brjod mthar/ tshogs zhing gi lha tshogs rnams la mos gus dung dung ba zhig byas pas/ lha tshogs thams cad mtha' nas rim bzhin 'od du yal te dbus kyi bla ma skyabs gsum kun 'dus la thim/ bla ma yang 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pa'i rkyen gyis skyabs yul lha tshogs de dag gi thugs rgyud na bzhugs pa'i don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems rang rgyud la lhang gis skyes par bsam la/ bsngo ba dang smon lam sogs bya/de lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa 'di ni/ chos thams cad kyi snying po dril ba yin pas/ yod na des chog med na thabs chag yin pas/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad du rang rgyud la byang chub kyi sems skye ba'i thabs la sgo du ma nas 'bad par bya'o/ / gsum pa/ bslab bya la smon 'jug gnyis las dang po smon pa'i bslab bya/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa/ brje ba/ bdag pas gzhan gces par bsgom pa dang gsum/ dang po ni 'di ltar bdag dang sems can 227

dza'i ma chos rdzogs la che yo'i ma zhagadza'ithams cad bde ba 'dod/ sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa blo gcig tu mthun kyang sems can rnams ni dge sdig blang dor gyi gnas la rmongs pas rtag tu sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras la spyod pa 'di snying re rje/ bdag dam pa'i chos kyi sgor zhugs pas khe nyen gyi khyad par shes pa yin pas/ ma rgan sems can thams cad rang dang khyad par med par brtse bas skyong / log sgrub dang phyogs ris bzod par byas te/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid du blta bar bya'o snyam du yang yang bsgom mo/ / gnyis pa bdag gzhan brje ba ni/ sdug bsngal gyis gdung ba'i sems can mthong chos su gyur pa'am min na sdug bsngal gyis gdungs pa'i sems can zhig mdun du bsams nas/ rang gi dbugs phyir rgyu ba'i tshe bdag gi bde ba dang legs pa/ lus dang longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa ba dang bcas pa gos phud de g.yogs pa ltar khong la byin/ khong gi sdug bsngal ci yod thams cad rang nyid kyis dang du blang bar bsam pa dang lhan cig dbugs nang du brngubs pas/ de nyid bde ba dang ldan zhing sdug bsngal dang bral bar bsam zhing gtong len sems can gcig nas thams cad kyi bar la rim par bsgom mo/ / gsum pa bdag pas gzhan gces par bsgom pa ni/bdag 'khor bar gnas rung dmyal bar skyes rung / na rung / tsha rung /nyams nyes ci byung yang bzod par bya yi/ sems can gzhan gyi sdug bsngal bdag la smin par shog cig bdag gi bde ba dang dge ba'i 'bras bu khong la rdzogs par shog cig snyam du zhe thag pa nas bsam zhing dngos su yang de ltar nyams su blang ngo / /gnyis pa/ 'jug pa'i bslab bya pha rol tu phyin pa drug ni sbyin pa tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus bsam gtan te/ thabs spyod pa'i phyogs kyi pha 228

dza'ile lnga pa mong phyi'i sngo ribrorol tu phyin pa lnga/ shes rab ye shes kyi tshogs te drug yin/ dang po sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la/ zang zing gi sbyin pa/ chos kyi sbyin pa/ tshi'ajigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa dang gsum/ zang zing gi sbyin pa la gtong ba dang / gtong ba chen po/ shin tu gtong ba dang gsum/ gtong ba ni sems can thams cad kyi don du nor rdzas la chags zhen med par yar mchod mar sbyin sogs dge ba'i phyogs su gtong ba de yin/ rje mi la'i zhal nas/ lto kha nas brus la sbyin pa thongs/ zhes gsungs so/ / gtong ba chen po ni rta dang glang po dang bu mo la sogs rang la lhag par tsis che ba dang / dkon pa'i rigs gzhan la sbyin pa de yin/ shin tu gtong ba ni/ rang gi lus dang srog dang yan lag la sogs sbyin par gtong ba ste/ dper na rgyal bu snying stobs chen pos stag mor lus sbyin btang ba lta bu yin/ chos kyi sbyin pa ni/ gzhan la dbang bskur/chos bshad/ lung 'bogs pa sogs gzhan rgyud dge ba la sbyor ba'i thabs byed pa de yin/ mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa ni/ sems can skyabs med pa la skyabs/ mgon med pa la mgon/ dpung gnyen med pa la dpung gnyen byed pa thams cad dang / khyad par sems can gyi srog bskyabs pa phan yon che bar gsungs so/ / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims dang gsum/ dang po nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims ni/ lus ngag yid kyi sgo nas mi dge ba bcu sogs nyes spyod sgrub pa'i blo rnams dug bzhin du spong ba de yin/ ji skad du/ sdig pa chung ngu tsam la yang / / mi gnod snyam du brnyas mi bya/ / me stag phra mo gcig gis kyang / / rtswa phung ri tsam sreg par byed/ / ces gsungs/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims ni/ dge ba'i rtsa ba cha 229
