dza'i mazhe sa rngogs sa che 0sdo'i ma zha dza'i phra mo re yan chad dus dang rnam pa thems cad du ci 'grub gang 'grub tu byed pa de yin/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims ni/ rang 'dod rtsa ba nas zad pa'i dus su/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la bsten nas sems can gyi don dngos su bsgrub pa la 'bad pa de yin no/ / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni/bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gsum ste gzhan gyi log sgrub bzod pa'i bzod pa/ chos phyir dka' spyad bzod pa'i bzod pa/ zab mo'i don la mi skrag pa'i bzod pa dang gsum/ dang po gzhan gyi log sgrub bzod pa'i bzod pa ni/gzhan gyis rang la dngos su rdung rdog dang / 'phrog bcom tshig ngan smra ba sogs dang / lkog nas mi snyan par brjod pa sogs la zhe sdang dang khong khro mi bya bar slar de la byams pa dang snying rje bskyed nas de dag la phan 'dogs pa de yin/ des na spyod 'jug las/ zhe sdang lta bu'i sdig pa med/ / bzod pa lta bu'i dka' thub med/ / de bas bzod la nan tan du/ / sna tshogs tshul gyis bsgom par bya/ / zhes gsungs/ chos phyir dka' spyad bzod pa'i bzod pa ni/dam pa'i chos sgrub pa'i ched du dka' tshegs tsha grang thams cad khyad du bsad nas bsgrub dgos te/ rgyud las kyang / me tshogs spu gri'i so yang brgal nas ni/ / phyi mthar thug gi bar du dam chos btsal/ / zhes gsungs so/ / bdag cag gi ston pa sangs rgyas shākya thub pas chu bo ne+e rañja na'i drung du lo drug gi bar du lo re la thigs pa re dang nas 'bru re gsol nas dka' spyad dang snying rus mdzad pa yin/ de bzhin du grub chen me long rdo rjes kyang / gla khe'i shun pa kho na gsol te/ lo dgu'i bar du sgrub pa mdzad pas grub pa thob pa dang /kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po klong chen rab 'byams pas kyang / dngul chu ril bu nyi shu rtsa gcig gis zla ba mang po'i 'tsho ba mdzad pa dang / kha ba babs dus 230

dza'ile lnga la mong byi'i smo zhabrosgye zhig gi nang du 'dzul nas gos gdan gnyis ka'i ko bcad de dka' ba spyad pa sogs/ sngon gyi grub thob thams cad dka' spyad dang snying rus kyi sgo nas bsgrubs te grub pa thob pa sha stag yin/ des na 'jig rten tshe 'di'i zhen pa thams cad rlung la bskur nas dka' tshegs dang tsha grang thams cad khyad du bsadade chos sgrub pa zhig cis kyang dgos pa yin no/ / zab mo'i don la mi skrag pa'i bzod pa ni/ zab mo stong pa nyid kyi gnas lugs dang / khyad par rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas lugs bya rtsol dang bral ba'i gnad/dge sdig rgyu 'bras las 'das pa'i rdo rje'i gad mo bcu gnyis dang / ngo mtshar ba'i tshig chen brgyad la sogs pa thos pa na/ de dag la log lta mi skye zhing de dag gi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa'i thabs la 'bad par bya ba yin no/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la'ang / gong ma'i brtson 'grus ni/sngon gyi dam gong ma rnams dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rnam thar dang mdzad spyod/ chos phyir dka' ba spyad pa'i lo rgyus sogasaji dang ji lta ba zhig thos kyang khong rnams sangs rgyas dang byang sems yin pas de ltar mdzad pa yin/ rang res de lta bu zhig ga la nus snyam du sgyid mi lug par khong rnam pas de ltar mdzad pas grub pa thob 'dug pas/ nga yang de dag gi rjes 'jug yin pas de las lhag pa zhig ma thon kyang / de lta bu zhig ma 'grub par thabs mi 'dug snyam pas/ snying thag pa nas chos shig mi sgrub re snyam du dam bca' ba de yin/ spyor ba'i brtson 'grus ni/ chos byed blo dang sgrub blo zhig yod kyang / sang bya'o dang gnangs bya'o zhes pa'i ngang du mi tshe 'dzad pa de ltar skad cig kyang mi bzhag par/ sdar ma'i pang du sbrul zhugs pa'am/ sgeg mo'i mgo la me shor ba ltar/ 'jig rten tshe 'di'i bya ba 231

waṃ ma chos rdzogs sda chenayo'i mgazhagawaṃthams cad cog gis bzhag ling gis bskyur nas le lo dang phyi bshol gyi dbang du skad cig kyang mi lus par 'phral dang 'phral du chos la 'jug pa de sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus yin/ chog par mi 'dzin pa'i brtson 'grus ni rang gis mtshams dang bsnyen sgrub kha ton dang dge sbyor la sogs pa cung zad re 'grub pa'i tshe/ de tsam gyis chog shes mi bya bar tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms pa'i dam bca' blangs nas ji srid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob bar du brtson pa rgyun ring la shugs drag pa chu bo'i rgyun lta bu zhig dgos te/ des na dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du chos la chog shes med par 'bad pa/thang lhod med pa'i brtson 'grus gzhu bdungs pa lta bu zhig byed dgos so/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ dang po 'du 'dzi dang rnam g.yeng thams cad spangs nas dben pa zhig ma brten na/ bsam gtan rgyud la skye mi nus pas/ dang po rnam g.yeng spang ba gal che/ de yang 'dus pa ni 'bral ba'i chos can yin te/ rtag pa med pa'i pha ma dang spun zla mdza' bshes sogs la mi chags par dbe+en par gcig pur gnas par bya dgos/ 'dod pa ni nyes pa thams cad kyi 'byung khungs/ ji tsam yod kyang chog mi shes/ser sna 'phel la rkun po la sogs rtsod pa can dang thun mong pa'o/ / tshe 'di kho na don du gnyer ba'i mi rnams ni byis pa'i grogs po zhes bya ba yin te/ byis pa'i grogs ni rang bzhin ngan pa/ byas pa mi gzo ba/ mgu bar dka' ba/phrag dog pa la sogs 'grogs pa tsam gyis dge ba 'grib pa/ dgra btul kyang mtha' med pa/ gnyen bskyangs kyang mtha' med pa 'di dag ni nges par spang bar bya'o/ / de ltar spangs nas nags khrod dben pa zhes sngon gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis zhi ba brnyes pa'i gnas/ 'du 'dzi 232

dza'ile lnga pa mong phyi'i rngo lizodang rnam g.yeng med pa/ tshong dang so nam med pa byis pa'i grogs dang bral ba/ bya dang ri dwags 'grogs na bde ba/ chu dang lo ma dka' thub kyi zas dang mthun pa/ rig pa ngang gis dwangs pa / ting 'dzin shugs kyis 'phel ba'i gnas/ de na dgra med/ gnyen med/ chags sdang gi sgrog las grol ba yon tan du ma dang ldan pa'i gnas yin te/ 'di dag ni bsam gtan gyi sngon du 'gro ba'i chos yin pas ci nas kyang gal che bas med thabs med do/ /bsam gtan dngos la/ byis pa nyer spyod kyi bsam gtan/ don rab 'byed pa'i bsam gtan/ de bzhin gshegs dge'i bsam gtan dang gsum/ de yang bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams la zhen nas/ de nyid la ched rdu gnyer te nyams zhen gyi rtsi dang bcas par sgom pa'i dus na byis pa nyer spyod kyi bsam gtan zhes bya/ nyams kyi zhen pa dang bral nas bsam gtan gyi ro myong med kyang stong 'dzin gnyen po'i phyogs la zhen nas sgom pa'i dus na/ don rab 'byed pa'i bsam gtan zhes bya/ stong 'dzin gnyen po'i blo dang bral te/chos nyid rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs dge'i bsam gtan yin/ de ltar bsam gtan sgom pa'i dus thams cad du lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun dang ldan pas yid gang du'ang mi rtog cir yang mi 'dzin pa'i ngang du 'jog pa ni bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la/ thos bsam bsgom pa'i shes rab gsum/ de yang dang po thos bsam gnyis kyis sgro 'dogs bcad nas/bsgom pas nyams su len pa'i dus su/ 'di ltar phyi yul lnga'i snang ba thams cad med bzhin 'khrul ngo la snang ba rmi lam lta bu/ rgyu rkyen rten 'brel tshogs pa las glo bur du snang ba sgyu ma lta bu/ med la yod par snang ba mig yor lta bu/233

dzaji macas rngogs ba che wo'i ma zha dza'isnang bzhin bden par ma grub pa smig rgyu lta bu/ phyi nang gang la yang med bzhin snang ba brag cha lta bu/ rten dang brten pa med pas dri za'i grong khyer lta bu/ snang la rang bzhin med pas gaphrugs brnyan gyi snang ba lta bu/ med snang cir yang 'char bas sprul pa'i grong khyer lta bu ste dngos po med pa'i stong gzugs sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad du bltas pas yul gyi snang ba rdzun pa'i rang bzhin dusho la/ de ltar snang ba'i mkhan po yul can/ sems kyi gshis lugs la brtags pas yul snang ma 'gags la yul gyi 'dzin rtog zhi/ zhes stong nyid stong gsal nam mkha' lta bur rtogs pa'i ngang du 'jog pa ni shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yin no/ / de ltar pha rol tu phyin pa drug la sogs pa byang chub semasadapa'i gzhung lam rgya chen po de thams cad mdo hril gyis dril na stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can zhig la 'ub kyis 'dus pa yin te/ dpal sa ra ha pa'i do ha las kyang / snying rje dang bral stong pa nyid lta ba/ / des ni lam mchog rnyed pa ma yin te/ / gal te snying rje 'ba' zhig bsgom na yang / / 'khor ba 'dir gnas thar pa yod dam ci/ / gang la gnyis po yod par gyur pa de/ /srid par mi gnas mya ngan 'das mi gnas/ / zhes gsungs/ srid pa dang mya ngan las 'das pa gnyis kar mi gnas pa ni mi gnas pa'i myang 'das rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang yin no/ / khrid tshul 'di lta bu'i don yid la nges pa la phar phyin theg pa'i zab gnas thams cad kyang 'du zhing / theg pa chen po'i chos kyi rtsa ba yin pas 'khor sdug bsngal las skyob pa dang / nyan rang gi theg pa las 'phags pa dang / dge rtsa mi zad cing 'phel ba dang / bsod nams rgya chen po thob pa dang sangs rgyas kyi gdung 'tshob pa dang / gzhan don rlabs po che 'grub pa la sogs pa'i dgos pa dpag tu med pas na sbyor 234

dza'ile lnga pa mong byi'i sngo dzobrodangos rjes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo / / zhes dang / yang 〈rdzogs chen a ti zab don gyi dmigs khrid zin bris 〉las/ drug pa lam log pa las khyad par du byed pa sems bskyed pa'i khrid ni/ 'di ltar du bsam ste/phyogs bcu'i nam mkha' 'di la ji ltar gzhal yang mtha' dang tshad med pa/nam mkhas gar khyab ni 'jig rten gyi khams yin/ de ni 'jig rten gyi khams la'ang mtha' dang tshad med/ de thams cad rigs drug sems can gyis go mtshams med par khyab 'dug mod/ bdag gis ni tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa'i snga rol nas skye ba grangs med pa zhig blangs/ skye ba blangs re bzhin gyi lus re grub/ lus grub re bzhin pha ma re byung 'dug pas/ sems can 'di thams cad pha dang mar ma gyur pa ni gcig rang yang med de/ de la tshe 'di'i mas mtshon na/ rang re rnams dang po ma'i mngal du sdod pa'i dus ma'i lus kyi zungs zad/ dbang po'i bkrags mdangs shor/ 'dod pa'i bza' btung la spyad dbang med cing / kun tu ldang zhing lus rgud/ de nas zla ba thim ste mngal nas 'thon pa'i tshe na'ang ma'i kha rus min pa'i rus mtshams thams cad 'byed/ de'i dus su rang gi lus kyi sgul skyod/ ngag gi smra brjod/sems kyi rtog dpyod gang yang mi shes mod/ ma drin mo che ba 'dis 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis bsus/ byams pa'i yid kyis bskyangs/ mi gtsang lag gis phyis/ byed spyod dang phan sgo du ma nas gces par bskyangs/ mthar gos rgyan sogs ci yod der 'dogs/ mdor na rang las lhag par rtag tu 'khyags dogs ltogs dogs brtse zhing gdung ba chen pos bskyangs/ des na tshe 'di'i pha mas ji ltar skyong ba bzhin tshe rabs kyi pha mas kyang de ltar du bskyangs pas drin can gyi ma sha stag yin/ des na tshe 'di'i pha ma dang tshe 235

dza'i ma chos rdzogs pa che po'i ma zhagadza'irabs kyi pha ma zhes nye ring du spyod pa ci la 'thad/ da 'di thams cad 'dod pa ni bde ba 'dod de rmongs shing thabs la mi mkhas pa'i dbang gis sgrub pa sdug bsngal gyi rgyu kho na sgrub cing zhe 'dod dang lag len phyin ci log tu gyur pa ste la la ni sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba rngam po che la longs spyod/ la la ni sdug bsngal gyi 'bras bu la rtag tu spyod cing nyam thag pa'i smyon pa 'di rnams snying re rje snyam du snying rje bskal chen gyi me 'bar ba ltar snying khong rus pa'i gting nas tshugs thabs med pa'i bred sha thon thon gyis mdor na snying 'gas 'gro ba tsam bskyed de/ da thog ma med pa nas drin gyis sposkyangs pa'i ma 'di dag ma rig pa'i mun pa 'thibs pos ni 'thom/ nyon mongs pas yid dkrugs te smyo/blang dor lta bu'i shes rab kyi mig dang bral zhing dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi dmigs bu'i long khrid ni med/ rgyab nas brten pa'i bsod nams kyi 'khar ba med cing thabs shes kyi rkang pa chag pa ngan song gi gnas su gom pa 'dor/las kyi dbang gis sdug bsngal gyi 'khor ba dang ngan song gi g.yang sar lhung zhing nyam thag pa'i sems can 'di rnams yal bar bor na 'jig rten na bdag las khrel dang ngo tsha chung ba su zhig yod snyam du snying rje tshad med pa bskyed/ da snying rje zhes bzhag pas ci la phan/ des na bdag gi ma chus khyer ba de la ko gru'am thag pa la sogs thabs sna tshogs kyi 'dren dgos pa dang chos mtshungs pa yin/ sems can 'di thams cad rnam grol gtan gyi bde ba la 'god par bya/ de'i nus pa da lta bdag la mi 'dug pas bdag gis 'gro kun sgrol nus pa'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang tshe 'di la 'thob par bya/de'i ched du man ngag rdzogs pa chen po a ti zab don snying po'i gdams pa zab mo 'di nyid nyams su blangs te tshe 'di la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 236

dza'ile lnga pa mong byi'itsā zha'aphang thob par byas te sems can thams cad rnam grol gtan gyi bde ba la nges par 'god par bgyi'o snyam/ mdor na kha tsam tshig tsam min pa'i snying rje tshugs thabs med pa kong kong bskyed la ngag tu/ bdag gi pha ma sogs kyi sems bskyed brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs pa'am nyung mtha' gsum gyis byas pa re btang rjes dbugs 'byin 'jug dang sbyar ba'i bde sdug gi btang len byed pa ste/ de'ang dbugs rgyun gyi bzo bcos med pa 'di ka phar 'gro ba dang bstun/ bdag gis tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da lta'i bar du bgyis pa'i dge ba sems can la sbyin no/ / sems can bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig snyam du bsam/ yang rlung nang du 'ong ba dang sems can gyis tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas da lta'i bar du bgyis pa'i sdig pa dang sdug bsngal bdag la smin par gyur cig sems can sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rkyen dang bral bar gyur cig snyam du bsam/ de nas mthar sems bskyed pa'i yul skyabs yul mi dmigs/ skyed pa po'i gang zag sems can mi dmigs/ de bar gyi kun slong gsum ka mi dmigs pa'i ngang du dar cig mnyam bzhag byas rjes/ byang chub sems ni rin po che zhes sogs kyis dge ba bsngo ba dang bcas pa bya'o/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par bya'o/ /bdun pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas/sgrib sbyong ba'i gnyen por rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas la bslab pa ni/〈rdzogs chen ma rig mun sel 〉las/ sgrib sbyong rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas ni/ zab mo'i lam gyi nyams rtogs khyad par can skye ba la bar du 237

tho〉 ma' sa rngo sa la che 'asgo'i ma tho'igacod pa 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib yin pas de nyid sbyang dgos/ de sbyong ba'i mchog ni rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas la rnal 'byor du bya ba yin pas 'di ltar te/ rang nyid tha mal gnas pa laḥ spyi bor pad+ma zla ba'i stengaḥ hūṃ yig dkar pos 'phro 'du lasaḥ rdo rje sems dpa' gangs ri'i mdogaḥlongs sku'i rgyan spras yum dang sbyoraḥ thugs kar zla steng rdo rje laḥ hūṃ mtshan yig brgya'i sngags 'phreng bskoraḥ 'od 'phros rang gzhan sdig sgrib sbyangasaḥsdig ltung nyes tshogs dag par gyuraḥ oṃ gu ru badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya na sa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥ zhes 'don/ spyi bor rdo rje sems dpa' bskyed pa ni rten gyi stobs/ yig brgya bzlas pa ni gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs/thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib spyi dang khyad par so thar byang sems rig sngags kyi dam sdom dang 'gal ba'i nyes skyon la dug khong bar song ba lta bu'i 'gyod pa ni sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ phyin chad srog la babs kyang mi byed par dam bca' ba ni/ nyes pa las slar ldog pa'i stobs yin pas stobs bzhi shugs drag bcas/ rang dang khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyis sngagasasgra sbi ri ri bzlas pas rdor sems kyi thugs srog sngags 'phreng sa bon las bdud rtsi 'o rgyun ltar babs pas/ sku'i nang gang nas sku'i cha thams cad dang / khyad par yab yum spyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi rgyun ma chad par babs pas bdag gzhan gyi tshangs bug nas zhugs te lus kyi nang thams cad gang nas tshe rabs thog med nas bsags pa'i las nyon gyi sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chag nyes ltung gi tshogs thams cad dud khu dang sol khu'i rnam par nag nu ru ru dbang po'i sgo dang / ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas thon/ nad thams cad rnag khrag dang gdon thams cad sbal lcong sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par thon 238

'jile lja pa mong phyi'i' rigronas sa rim pa bdun gyi 'og tu song bar bsam/ de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal nas rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung ma lus pa dag pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ 'od du zhu ste spyi bo nas thim par rang gzhan sems can thams cad dang dbyer med par gyur nas rang nyid kyang rdor sems kyi skur lam gyis gyur pa'i sa bon sngags 'phreng las 'od zer 'phros pa/ phyi snod thams cad 'ja' 'od thig le/ nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad rigs lnga'i skur gsal ba'i ngang nas yang snying oṃ gu ru badz+ra sa twa hūṃ/ zhes ci mang bzla'o/ /sdig sgrib dag pa'i rtags ni/ bskul byed kyi gzungs las/ ji srid du sdig pa byang ba'i mtshan ma ma mthong ba de srid du bzlas brjod bya ste/ rmi lam na zas ngan pa skyug pa dang / 'o ma zho la sogs pa 'thung ba dang / nyi ma zla ba mthong ba dang / nam mkha' la 'gro ba dang / me 'bar ba ma te dang mi nag po thub pa dang / dge slong dang dge slong ma'i dge 'dun mthong ba dang / 'o ma 'byung ba'i shing dang / glang po che dang khyu mchog dang / seng ge'i khri dang /khang bzang gi steng du 'dzeg pa dang / chos nyan pa rmis na sdig pa dang bral bar 'gyur te/ sdig pa byang bar shes par bya'o/ / zhes gsungs pa dang /gzhan yang gser rnyed pa dang / gzhan dag nor bu bzang po rnyed pa dang /nyi zla shar ba dang / grub thob rnams dang mjal ba rnams ni rtolngas pa 'char ba'i snga ltas dang / lo tog bzang por bdag byed pa nas mang po la dbang ba/shing thog dang sbrang rtsi bzang po sogs ro mngar ba zhim po zos pa rmis na/nyams myong skye ba'i snga ltas dang / khrus byas pa/ gos dkar po gyon pa/ me long phyis pa sogs ni gsal nyams 'char ba'i snga ltas dang / 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal por mnga' gsol ba lta bu'i mi 'tshams pa chen po rmis na 239

dza'i ma'adzus rdzo sa pa che bsgo'i ma zha tho'iyang / sgrib pa dag pa'i ltas yin par gsungs so/ / de ltar rtags thon nas kyang mi skyur bar nyams su len par bya'o/ / phan yon ni/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal nas/ 'di dag dus gcig la brgya rtsa brgyad brjod na nyam/sa chag thams cad bskangs te/ ngan song gsum du ltung ba las thar bar 'gyur ro/ / rnal 'byor pa gang zhig gis yi dam du bcings nas 'don na mi tshe 'di nyid la yang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sras dam par dgongs nas bsrung ba dang / bskyab par mdzad la/ tshe 'phos nas kyang bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi sras su gdon mi za bar 'gyur ro/ / zhes dang / snying po rgyan las/ yi ge brgya pa cho ga bzhin/ / nyi shu rtsa ni re re bzlas/ / ltung sogs byin gyis rlabs 'gyur las/ / 'phel ba ru ni mi 'gyur zhes/ / grub pa mchog rnams kyis bshad pas/ / thun mtshams su ni spyad par bya/ / 'bum phyag tu ni bzlas gyur na/ / rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid 'gyur/ / zhes dang / o rgyan rin po che'i zhal nas/ rdor sems sgom bzlas gsungs nas/ 'di ni bla med nang gi nyams chag skong ba'i sgrib sbyang khyad par ba ste/ bskal ba stong gi las sgrib 'dag cing dam tshig nyams chag mtshams med lnga'i las kyang 'dis 'dag par 'gyur ba'i phyir na/ rnal 'byor pas brtson par byas na 'di nyid rang gis sangs rgyas 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/de yang 'gal rkyen sgrib pa sbyong ba rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas la bslab pa ni/ dang po rten gyi stobs ni/ aḥ zhes rang sems skye ba med pa chos kyi sku'i dbyings la mnyam par 'jog dgos par bstan pa yin te/〈mtshan brjod 〉las/ a ni yig 'bru kun gyi mchog / donajichen yi ge dam pa 240

'jime lja pa mong rtsi'ibasdo ribroyin/ / khong nas 'byung ba skye ba med/ / ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ bdag nyid tha mal du gnas pa'i spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo ru 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pa'i pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma stong ldan gyi ze'u 'bru la ma reg tsam du dri ma thams cad yongs su dag pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar bsil nya gang ba maṇ+ḍal gyi phor pa kha sbubs pa lta bu'i gdan dbus su/ thugs srog hūṃ yig dkar po gdan la khab btsugs pa bzhin gyen 'greng du gsal ba yongs su gyur pa las ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ rnam pa rdo rje sems dpa'/ sku mdog dkar gsal zhi tshul dgu dang rgyan cha bcu gsum sogs longs spyod rdzogs pa'i chas dang ldan pa'i sku ste/ zhi tshul dgu ni rnam pa'i yon tan nam zhi gnas kyi nyams bzhi yin zhing / nyams bzhi ni dri ma med cing kha dog ma 'dres pa'i mdangs dang ldan pas gsal ba/ 'od zer 'bar bas 'tsher ba/sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pas lhun sdug pa/ thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i gzi byin dang ldan pa ste bzhi'o/ /ngo bo yon tan nam lhag mthong gi nyams lnga ni/ skye ba gnas su dag pas sku gyong khegs med par pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar mnyen pa/ na ba gnas su dag pas phra sbom sogs kyi skabs rim par phyed pas lcug pa/ 'chi ba gnas su dag pas sku'i sha tshugs lhod par ma gyur pas 'khril bag chags pa/ tshigs mdud rnams phra zhing sku drang la sgul skyod bde bas ldem pa/ rga ba gnas su dag pas sku'i sha rgyas shing pags pa srab la reg bya 'jam pas gzhon tshul dang ldan pa ste lnga'o/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rgyan chas bcu gsum ni/ dang po dar gyi chas gos lnga ni/ dar dkar po gser gyi ngang ris can gyi stod g.yogs/ dar sna 241

dza〉 ma chos rdzogs pa che yo'i ma zhagadza'itshogs pa'i sham thabs/ gar gyi phu thung ste/ dar dpyangs ljang gu'am/ nang gos phu thung lta bu la/ snyan gong ut+pal 'phyang dar gyi cod pan kha dog sna tshogs pa'i cod pan ltag pa nas phyir 'phyang ba la zi ldir zhes pa dang lnga'o/ /rin po che'i rgyan brgyad ni/ dbu skra thor gtsug rin po che'i rtse phran ldem pa la sangs rgyas rigs lngas mtshan pa'i dbu rgyan dang gcig 'khor los mtshan pa'i snyan rgyan dang gnyis/ rin po che'i mgul rgyan dang gsum/ lte ba man chad 'khor ba'i mu tig gi do shal dang bzhi/ thugs mtshan dpal be+e'u mdzes byed mu tig gi se mo do ste do shal thung ngu dang lnga/ rin po che ska rags dang drug phyag gdub dang bdun/ zhabs gdub dang brgyad do/ /de ltar rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa/ phyag g.yas rig stong rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing / g.yon snang stong dril bur dkur bsten pa 'dzin pa dang / yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri thod 'dzin mar 'khril ba/ yab rdzogs pa'i skyil mo krung dang / yum pad+ma'i skyil krung gis rol par bsgom pa'o/ / gnyis pa nyes byas sun 'byin gyi stobs ni/ bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' khyod la skyabs su gsol zhing bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi tshe rabs thog med kyi sdig pa sbyong bar mdzad du gsol/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas de ring yan chad du bsags pa'i sdig pa mi dge ba bcu/ mtshams med pa lnga/ de dang nye ba lnga/ lci ba bcu drugalog pa brgyad/ so sor thar ba'i sdom pa dang 'gal ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya dang 'gal ba/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig dang 'gal ba sogs sngar byas kyi sdig pa'i rgyu dug gsum/ gzhi sgo gsum/ spyir rang gis 242

chu950pa mojabyi'isngo 'grobagyis pa dang / bgyid du bstsal ba dang / gzhan gyis bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang bgyis pa rnams khong du dug song ba lta bu'i 'gyod sems drag pos ngag tu nyes ltung 'di dang 'di lta bu zhes brjod pa la mthol lo zhes dang / yid kyis 'gyod pa byed pa la bshags so zhes mthol bshags kyi khyad par de lta bu yin te/ mkhas grub karma chags med kyis/ 'gyod pa med na bshags pas mi 'dag pas/ / sngar byas sdig pa khong du dug song ltar/ / ngo tsha 'jigs skrag 'gyod pa chen pos bshags/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa nyes spyod sdom pa'i stobs ni/ deng nas bzung ste phyin chad ni srog la babs kyang mi dge sdig pa'i las mi bgyid par sdom sems byed pa ste/karma chags med kyis/ phyin chad sdom sems med na mi 'dag pas/ / phyin chad srog la bab kyang mi dge'i las/ / da nas mi bgyid sems la dam bca' bzung / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs ni/ mgon po khyod kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba rgyas pa'i steng du sa bon hūṃ yig gi mtha' mar yi ge brgya pa'i sngags kyis bskor ba la dmigs nas/ yig brgya gsol 'debs kyi tshul du bzlas pas/ yab yum zung bde bar rol ba'i sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi byang chub sems kyi sprin ga bur zhes bsil zer te zla ba zhun ma'i mdog 'dra ba'i rdul ltar 'dzag pa yis ni/ dper na chu sna rgyug pa'i tshe sa rdul ded pa bzhin/ bdag dang pha mar gyur pa'i khams gsum gyi sems can gyi bsod nams ma yin pa'i las mi dge ba dang / mi g.yo ba lung ma bstan gyi las te/ las mi dge ba de'ang / ngo bo nyid kyi mi dge ba/mtshungs par ldan pa'i mi dge ba/ kun nas bslang ba'i mi dge ba/ don 243

tho'i ma chos rdzo sa la che bsgo'i ma dza〉dam pa'i mi dge ba ste bsags pa'i las dang dug gsum dang rtsa nyon nye nyon sogs kyis phye ba'i nyon mongs pa ste/ kun 'byung las nyon gnyis ni/ 'bras bu sdug bsngal bskyed pa'i rgyu yin pas na des bskyed pa'i nad thams cad rnag khrag gdon thams cad sbal ba sdom sdig 'bu srin la sogs pa srog chags kyi rnam pa dang / sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu dang sol khu'i rnam pa dang bcas te 'og sgo gnyis dang ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas mar nag nu ru ru babs pas sa gas te sa rim pa dgu'i 'og na/ 'chi bdag gshin rjes kha lag spar gsum gzed de yod pa'i kha nang du babs/ lto ba khengs shing 'dod pa tshim nas nyes ltung gi grib rigs thams cad lhag ma med par byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba gdab pa dang bdud rtsi 'bebs sbyong gi dmigs pa gnad smin bya ba ni man ngag go /de ltar lus dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can du gyur pa de'i lus dbus su rtsa gtso bo gsum dang 'khor lo bzhi gsal 'debs dgos pas/ spyi bor rtsa 'dab so gnyis mdog dkar po kha mar kyu ba/ mgrin par rtsa 'dab bcu drug pa/ mdog dmar po kha yar kyu ba/ gnyis ka gdugs kyi rtsibs ma ltar kha sprad pa/ snying khar rtsa 'dab brgyad pa/ mdog mthing ga kha mar kyu ba/ lte bar rtsa 'dab drug cu/ mdog ser po/ kha yar kyu ba/ gnyis ka gdugs kyi rtsibs ma ltar kha sprad par bsam/ slar yang gsol ba btab pas bla ma rdor sems yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi byang sems dkar po lhung lhung dal gyis babs pas/ 'khor lo bzhi'i gnas rnams shel bum zhos gang ba ltar bsgoms pas sgrib pa bzhi dag dga' bzhi'i ye shes rgyud la skyes/rig 'dzin bzhi'i sa bon thebs/ 'bras bu sku bzhi'i go 'phang thob pa'i skal 244

dza'ibe lnga pha mong phyi'i spo zhabrob rgyud la bzhag par bsgoms/ dmigs pa phyi ma 'di nyams rtogs kyi yon tan skye bar gal gnad chen po zhig yin no/ /yig brgya'i sngags don ni/ oṃ ni ye shes lnga'i mgo 'dren/ badz+ra ni rdo rje/ sa hwa ni sems dpa'/ sa ma ya ni dam tshig ma nu ni rjes su/ pa la ya ni skyongs shig badz+ra ni rdo rje/ sa twa ni sems dpa'/ de no po ni nyid kyi nye bar/ ṣ+ṭha ni gnas/ dri rnyo ni brtan pa'i/ me ni bdag la/ bha wa ni dngos por mdzod/ su to ṣ+yo me ni bdag la dgyes pa'i/ bha wa ni dngos por mdzod/su po ṣ+yo me ni bdag la shin tu dgyes pa'i/ bha wa ni dngos por mdzod/ a nu rak+to me ni bdag la rjes su chags pa'i/ bha wa ni dngos por mdzod/ sarba si dhi m+me ni dngos grub thams cad bdag la/ pra ya ts+tsha ni rab tu stsol/ sarba karma su ts+tsha me ni las kun la yang bdag gi tsi t+t+waṃ shri yo ni sems kyi dpal du/ ku hūṃ ni mdzod cig ha ha ha ha ho ni tshad med bzhi dang ye shes lnga'i 'das/sarba ta tha ga ta ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad/ badz+ra ma me muñca ni rdo rje bdag grol bar/ badz+ra bha wa ni rdo rje dngos por mdzod/ ma hā sa ma ya sa twa ni dam tshig rdo rje sems dpa' chen po/ āḥ ni skye med chos kyi sku'o/ /de nas slar yang gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ bdag sogs 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs dang / mgon dang dpung gnyen du gyur pa'i byed po zhes rdo rje sems dpa' bos nas/ las ngan pa bdag ni mi shes gti mug gis non te rmongs par gyur pa yis/ rtsa ba sku gsung thugs yan lag gi dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams par gyur pas na/ bla ma mgon po chen pos bdag gi skyabs dang dpung gnyen mdzod cig rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso bo/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po ste/ khyed ni brtse ba thugs rje 245

dza'i mazhe sa rngo sa la che bsgo'i ma tho〉chen po'i bdag nyid can yin pas/ 'gro ba kun 'dren pa'i gtso bo khyed la bdag skyabs su mchi'o/ / zhes brjod nas sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje sems dpa' thugs dgyes bzhin zhal 'dzum mdangs g.yo ba dang bcas rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad dag pa yin no/ / zhes gsung gis dbugs dbyung ba ste/ gnang ba byin zhing 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pa'i rkyen las rang nyid kyang rdo rje sems dpa' snang stong me long nang gi gzugs brnyan shar ba lta bu'i skur gyur pa'i thugs kar zla dkyil gyi steng thugasasrog hūṃ yig mthing ga'i mthar yig 'bru bzhi po mdun du oṃ dkar po/g.yas su badz+ra ser po/ rgyab tu sa dmar po/ g.yon du twa ljang gu rnams gsal ba las 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan du phyogs bzhi dbus dang lngar 'phros te khams gsum sems can thams cad rdor sems rigs lnga'i rten gzhal med khang dang / der brten pa lha'i rang bzhin du sangs rgyas par bsam la/snying po yig 'bru drug pa ci nus su bzla/ 'di ni bye ba bzlas na gsang sngags kyi rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams te sems can dmyal ba chen por bskal pa mang por nyams su myong bar 'gyur ba'i las 'dag par gsang bdag gos sngon can gyi rgyud nas gsungs pa dang / mthar dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag / sangs rgyas go 'phang 'grub gyur nas/ / 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ / de yi sa la 'god par shog / tses dge ba bsngo zhing mnyam par 'jog par bya ste/〈rdzogs chen klong snying gi sngon 'gro'i 'bru 'grel 〉las/ 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong ba bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas kyi khrid ni/ zab mo'i lam gyi nyams rtogs khyad par can skye ba la bar du gcod pa'i gtso bo ni sdig sgrib 246

dzajile lja la mong phyijitsā ribag chags yin la/ de nyid sbyong ba'i thabs grangs med pa zhig rgyal bas bstan pa rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa ni/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas yin/ de nyams su len pa la gnyen po stobs bzhi tshang ba ni gal che/de la stobs bzhi ni/ rten gyi stobs/ nyes byas sun 'byin gyi stobs/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i stobs/ gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs rnams so/ / de dag gi don rim bzhin 'don sgom zung 'jug tu/ āḥ zhes chos nyid skye ba med pa'i don dran pa'i ngang nas bdag nyid tha mal du gnas pa'i spyi bo mda' gang tsam gyi steng gi nam mkha' ru pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma stong ldan gyi steng du/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i gdan gyi dbus su/ dbyings rig dbyer med mtshon pa'i hūṃ yig dkar po 'od zer bkrag mdangs dang ldan pa zhig gsal/de nas skad cig gis hūṃ yig de nyid gnas gyur pa las/ ngo bo sangs rgyas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa la/ rnam pa dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar la 'od gsal ba gangs ri'i phung po la nyi ma 'bum gyis 'khyud pa lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rgyan chas bcu gsum gyis sku la legs par spras pa longs sku'i rgyan chas bcu gsum ni/ dar gyi chas gos lnga dang / rin po che'i rgyan brgyad de/ dar gyi chas gos lnga ni/ cod pan/stod g.yogs/ dar dpyangs/ sku rags// smad dkris dang lnga/ rin po che'i rgyan brgyad ni/ dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ 'gul rgyan/ dpung rgyan/ do shal/rin po che'i do shal lte 'og yan 'khor ba/ se mo do/ (nu ma'i bar slebs pa'i do shal thung ba/)phyag gdub/ sor gdub/ zhabs gdub ste brgyad do/ /phyag g.yas rig stong gi rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar gtod pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/ g.yon snang stong gi dril bu dku la brten nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis 247

waṃdam chos rdzogs pa che yo'i rnamag waṃrdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i pang du yum snyems ma dkar mo phyag g.yas gri gug dang / g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud cing gnyis med du 'khril ba/ sku snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa snang stong chu zla lta bu'am/ me long du gzugs brnyan shar ba lta bu bkra lam me yod pa/ rang gi spyi bor rang gi kha lta phyogs su zhal phyogs nas bzhugs par bsgom/ bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' khyod la yid khyed shes kyi dad pas skyabs su mchi'o snyam du gsol ba 'debs shing rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi las nyon sdug bsngal bag chags dang bcas pa bral nas dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang thob par shog cig snyam pas smon 'jug gi byang sems dang ldan pa ni rten gyi stobs/ skabs 'dir rdo rje sems dpa' la skyabs su bzung nas smon 'jug gi byang sems dang ldan pa de rten gyi stobs yin/ skabs gzhan du yang sdig pa bshags pa'i yul de nyid rten yin/ de nas bla ma rdo rje sesdas dpa'i thugs brtse ba chen pos bdag dang sems can thams cad la rjes su dgongs te bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ rang gzhan gyi tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bzung ste dus da lta la thug gi bar du/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas sdig pa mi dge ba bcu/ mtshams med pa lnga/ lci ba bzhi ste/ mkhas pa'i gral gong lce/ sngags pa'i nor lce/ dge slong gi phyag lce/ sgrub pa po'i zas te log pa'i lci ba bzhi/ mi chos kyi mna' zos pa/ nyan thos kyi khrims nyams pa/byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya nyams pa/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig nyams pa ste nyams pa'i lci ba bzhi/ tig mug gi dbang gis ston pa'i sku la smad pa/nga rgyal gyi dbang gis mkhas pa'i yon tan la smad pa/ phrag dog gi dbang gis bden pa'i tshig la smad pa/ chags sdang dang phyogs ris kyi dbang gis 248

'jile lnga pa mong phyi'i sngo wāgrochos la dgag sgrub byed pa ste smad pa'i lci ba bzhi/ mtshams med lnga las khrag 'byin lci/ mi dge bcu las log lta lci/ mnyam pa'i chos la khyad 'don lci/rang bzhin med la gal 'dzugs lci ba ste skur ba'i lce ba bzhi'o/ / log pa brgyad ni/ dge ba can la smad pa/ sdig pa can la bstod pa/ dge ba can gyi tshogs bcag pa/ dad pa can gyi thugs dkrugs pa/ bla ma spang ba/ yi dam spang ba/ mched lcam spang ba/ dkyil 'khor gnyan po 'dral ba ste brgyad dang / khrel dang ngo tsha nyams pa la sogs sngar byas kyi mi dge ba'i las bsags pa dngos su dran pa dang mi dran pa tshe rabs thog med nas bsags pa thams cad la ngo tsha 'jigs skrag 'gyod sems drag pos mthol lo bshags so/ /mi 'chab po/ /mi sbed do/ / sdig sgrib thams cad dus da lta nyid du byang zhing dag pa zhig thugs rje ma chung snyam pa ni sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ sngon chad ni bdag mi shes rmongs pa'i dbang gis sdig pa dang mi dge ba'i las de dag bsags pa lags kyi/ da ni drin chen gyi bla ma'i thugs rje la brten nas khe nyen shes pa'i rang bzhin can yin pas/ da phyin chad ni srog dmar po la babs kyang sdig pa'i las gcod cing sdom ste mi bgyid do snyam pa ni nyes spyod sdom pa'i stobs/ de nas rdor sems yab yum gnyis su med pa khyod nyid kyi thugs kar zla ba nya gang ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rgyas pa yungs kar glebs pa tsam pa'i steng du hūṃ yig dkar po spus bris pa lta bu zhig gsal ba'i mtha' mar oṃ nas mgo brtsams te yi ge brgya pa'i sngags 'bru rnams ra langs pa ltar gcig la gcig ma reg tsam du yod pa rnams kyis g.yas bskor du bskor bar bsam la/ rang gi ngag nas yi ge brgya pa gsol 'debs kyi tshul du bzlas pa sngags kyis dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs rgyud bskul bas/ thugs ka'i hūṃ 249

dza'i ma chos rngogs pa chenayo'i ma zhagadzajiyig sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las thugs rje ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'khyag rom mes zhu ba las chu thigs pa ltar babs pa/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud yab yum snyom 'jug gi bde ba la rol ba'i sbyor mtshams nas/ bde chen ye shes kyi bdud rtsi byang chub sems kyi sprin chen po shin tu dkar ba ga bur gyi rdul ltar 'dzag cing thon nas rang nyid kyi tshangs bug nas zhugs pa yis/ bdag dang khams gsum rigs drug gi sems can thams cad kyi las dang nyon mongs pa dang 'bras bu sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba'i rgyu rkyen dang / nad thams cad rnag rul dang khrag rul/ gdon thams cad srog chags sdom sdig sbal sbrul la sogs pa'i rnam pa/ rang bzhin gyi sdig pa dang nyon shes kyi sgrib pa bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba'i nyes ltung dang zlas nyams dang zhor nyams la sogs pa'i dam grib thams cad lhag ma ma lus pa dud khu sol khu rlangs pa'i rnam par chu sna rgyug pas sa rdul ded pa ltar bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis thogs pa med par ded de rkang mthil dang 'og sgo gnyis dang ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas nag nyil gyis phyir thon/ rang gi 'og tu sa gas pa'i mar zhabs/ sa rim pa dgu'i 'og tu 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje glang dmar po'i rnam par gnas pa la 'khor lan chags bu lon sha 'khon gyi bdag po bdag mo thams cad kyis bskor te kha lag spar gsum zed nas yod pa'i nang du song bas mi mthun pa'i phyogs de thams cad ma lus lus pa med par byang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol 'debs dang chabs cig oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya sogs yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzla/ de ltar rdo rje sems dpa' bsgoms te bdud tsi 'bebs sbyong byed pa dang / yig brgya bzla ba sogs gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs so/ / de nas mthar thun 'jog khar/ 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje la sogs pa thams cad ngoms shing 250

dza'ile lnga pa mong byi'i 'o zhagrotshim/ lan chags 'khor/ bu lon sod/ sha 'khon byang / sdig sgrib dgagashin rje'i kha lag spar gsum yang zum/ sa gas pa yang sos te dus min gyi 'chi ba bslus par bsam/ rang gi lus 'di yang phyi gsal nang gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin du yod pa'i dbus su rtsa dbu ma dang / de las gyes pa'i 'khor lo bzhi po gdugs kyi rtsibs ma lta bu/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi kha yar kyu ba/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad kha mar kyu ba/mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab cu drug kha yar kyu ba/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis kha mar kyu ba de ltar gsal gdab/slar yang bdud rtsi'i rgyun sngar ltar babs pas/ rtsa 'khor lo bzhi la sogs pa'i lus kyi nang thams cad shel bum 'o mas gang ba ltar bdud rtsis skya ltem me gang / bum dbang / gsang dbang / sher dbang / tshig dbang rin po che ste dbang bzhi thob/ las kyi sgrib pa/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa/ shes bya'i sgrib pa/ bag chags kyi sgrib pa ste sgrib pa bzhi dag dga' ba/ mchog dga'/ khyad par gyi dga' ba/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba ste dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes rgyud la skyes/ sprul sku/ longs sku/ chos sku/ ngo bo nyid sku ste sku bzhi'i go 'phang rgyud la bzhag par bsam/ khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi mgon po bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'/ bdag ni ma rig pa'am mi shes pa'i rkyen gyis blang dor gyi gnas la rmongs pa yi dbang gis gsang sngags kyi dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i mgon pos bdag sogs sems can thams cad skyobs par mdzod cig rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag gam gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po ste/dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ 'gro ba'i mgon 251

dzaji ma chos rdzogs la che 'bro'i ma tho'ipo'am gtso bo khyed la bdag sogs sems can thams cad skyabs su mchi'o/ /sku gsung thugs te rtsa ba'i dam tshig gsum dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ / mi dge ba'i sdig pa dang las nyon gyi sgrib pa nyes lhung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad dus da lta nyid du byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rdo rje sems dpa' dgyes bzhin 'dzum pa dang bcas te/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad dag pa yin no/ / zhes gnang ba yin zhing 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pa'i rkyen gyis rang nyid kyang rdo rje sems dpa' snang stong me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu'i skur gyur pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yungs 'bru glebs pa tsam gyi steng du/ dbus su thugs srog hūṃ mthing ga de'i mdun du oṃ dkar po/g.yas su badz+ra ser po/ rgyab tu sa dmar po/ g.yon du twa ljang gu rnams zhal nang du phyogs pa'i tshul du gsal la/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūṃ/ zhes zlos pa dang mnyam du yi ge 'bru lnga po las 'od zer kha dog dkar ser dmar ljang mthing ga lnga yar 'phros pa'i rtse la sgeg sogs 'dod yon gyi lha mo rnams kyi phyag na bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rgyal srid sna bdun sogs mchod rdzas dpag tu med pa spros nas/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams bsam gyis mi khyab pa na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad la thugs mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag thugs rje dang byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa'i rnam par byung nas rang la thim pas/mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thob par bsam pa de/ rang don chos sku'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin/ yang yig 'bru lnga las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs brgya stong grangs med pa mar 'phros/ khams gsum rigs drug gi sems can 252

'jile lja ba mong gyi'iglo wāgrothams cad la phog de rnams kyi sdig sgrib sdug bsngal bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag cing phyi snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams dang / nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' dkar ser dmar ljang mthing ga lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur nas/ de thams cad kyi zhal nas/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūṃ/ zhes 'ur di ri sgrogs par bsams nas bzla ba ni/ gzhan don gzugs sku'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin/ dmigs pa'i gnad 'di lta bu la brten nas gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa thabs mkhas pa'i gnad kyis bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa yang skad cig ma re la rdzogs shing / nam mkhas gar khyab kyi sems can gyi don yang sgrub nus pa yin/ de ltar bzlas pa ci rigs pa byas pa'i rjes su thun bsdu ran na/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten mngon dga'i zhing du snang ba thams cad nang bcud kyi rdor sems rigs lnga'i lha tshogs la bsdu/ de rnams 7kyang rim gyis 'od du yal nas rang la bsdu/ rang yang 'od du yal nas thugs ka'i oṃ la thim/ oṃ badz+ra la/ badz+ra sa la/ sa twa la/ twa hūṃ gi zhabs kyu/zhabs kyu 'a chung / 'a chung ha khog ha mgo bo dang zla tshes thig le nā da'i bar rim bzhin thim nas/ nā da yang nam mkhar yal ba ltar mi dmigs spros bral ngang la dar cig lhod de mnyam par bzhag mthar bsngo smon sogs bya'o/ / de ltar rdor sems sgom bzlas byed pa 'di la sogs pa bzlas brjod gang byed kyi dus su sems dmigs pa las gzhan du ma yengs pa dang / bzlas brjod mi tshig gis bar ma chod pa ni ci nas kyang gal che ste/ rgyud las kyang / gal te ting 'dzin 'di med na/ / rgya mtsho'i 'jing gi pha bong bzhin/ / bskal par bzlas kyang 'bras mi 'byin/ / zhes dang / dag dang ma dag stong 'gyur 253

'ji mayos rngo sari che yo'i ma zha dza'iyin/ / ting 'dzin yod med 'bum 'gyur yin/ / zhes gsungs/ o rgyan chen po'i zhal nas kyang / lo gcig 'bag bsnyen byas pa bas zla gcig smra bcad byas pa dga'/ zhes gsungs/ de ltar sems gzhan du mi yengs shing tha mal gyi smra ba dang ma 'dres par/ dus gcig la yi ge brgya pa lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas na sngar byas kyi sdig sgrib dang nyams chag thams cad nges par dag pa bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal gyis bzhes pa yin te/ dri med bshags rgyud las kyang / bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi yang snying nyams chag dang sdig sgrib thams cad sbyong bar byed pa/ yi ge brgya pa zhes bya ba bshags pa thams cad kyi rgyal po 'di dus gcig la lan brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas na nyams chag thams cad bskangs te/ ngan song gsum du ltung ba las thar bar 'gyur ro/ / zhes gsungs/ de ltar nyin re bzhin du rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom zhing yi ge brgya pa nyi shu rtsa gcig re bzlas na/ ltung ba byin gyis brlabs pas mang du mi 'phel ba dang / yi ge brgya pa 'bum phrag gcig bzlas na ltung ba thams cad rtsa ba nas dag par gsungs/ rnal 'byor pa gang zhigagi yi dam du bcas nas 'don na/ mi de tshe 'di la'ang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sras kyi dam par dgongs nas srung skyob mdzad la/shi 'phos nas kyang bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi sras kyi thu bor 'gyur ba gdon mi za'o/ / zhes gsungs so/ / des na bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' ni/rigs brgya rigs gcig tu 'dus pa'i rang bzhin/ gsang chen rigs gcig rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya ste/ yi dam gyi lha zhi khro rab 'byams bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag kyang / rdo rje sems dpa' la ma 'dus pa med/ ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla mar dbyer med du bsgoms pas/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor yang kun 'dus 254

dza'ile sku la mong phyi'i 'o rigronor bu'i lugs su bsgom pa zhes shin tu zab pa'i mthar thug pa yin pas rtag tu nyams su len pa la 'bad par bya'o/ / zhes dang / yang 〈rdzogs chen a ti zab don gyi khrid dmigs zin bris 〉las/ bdun pa sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i gnyen por rdo rje sems dpa'i sko bzlas la bslab pa ni/ de'ang rang cag rnams bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par byed pa la gegs dang nyer 'tshe bar chod byed pa ni sdig sgrib yin pas de sbyang dgos/ de spyong ba'i mchog rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas la rnal 'byor du bya'o snyam du bsams la lus sems rnal du phab/ rang tha mal du gnas pa'i spyi bor pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ge sar ze phon dang bcas pa'i steng kha yar blta ba/ rtsa ba rang gi tshangs bug tu zug pa/ de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba rnams gsal gdab/ de la gsal snang thon pa dang / de'i steng du hūṃ yig dkar po gsal zhing 'tsher ba zhig bsam/ de las 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan bun zer gyis 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams la sku gsung thugs mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib sbyangs/ 'od zer tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang gi drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid rnam pa bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dung ltar dkar ba/ nor bu chu shel ltar 'tsher ba/ gangs ri la nyi ma phog pa lta bu'i gzi byin rab tu rgyas pa'i nyams can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i ngang tshul bzang po dang ldan pa/ g.yas gser gyi rdo rje lnga pa thugs kar gtod de 'dzin pa/ g.yon snang stong dngul dkar gyi dril bu dkur bsnyen pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil krung lham mer bzhugs shing / dbu skra mthon mthing ral pa'i thor tshugs can 255

dza'i ma chos rdzogs pa che po'i mgazhagadza'irin po che'i rked chings dang / nor bu'i rtse phran gyis brgyan pa/ sku stod la dar gyi stod g.yogs dang sku smad la dar gyi smad dkris can/ gzhan yang rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ dpung rgyan/ se mo do/ phyag gdub/zhabs gdub/ ska rags/ do shal la sogs pa dar dang rin po che rgyan can/phun sum tshogs pa du mas mdzes par spras pa sku blta bas chog mi shes pa stong chen sgrib thogs thams cad dang bral ba 'od kyi rang bzhin du bsam/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i gdan la hūṃ yig dkar po gsal zhing 'tsher ba zhig bsam/de'i mtha' skor du yi ge brgya pa'i sngags phreng rnams shin tu phra ba rta rnga la mdud pa btab pa'am/ mu tig bstar la brgyus pa lta bu'am dngul chu'i mdog lta bu hūṃ gis bklag pa'i tshul gyis gsal/ mtha' skor du reg cing ma 'byar ba'i tshul gyis lham mer 'khod par bsam/ de ltar spyi bo'i bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' skyabs gnas kun 'dus su mos pa rten gyi stobs/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa mi dge ba'i las thams cad la gnong 'gyod drag pos dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' khyed mkhyen no/ / bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis sngon chad sdig pa'i las bgyis pa thams cad mthol zhing bshags so/ / byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol snyam pa sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ da phyin chad 'chi ba srog la bab kyang sdig pa'i las dngos su ci/ rmi lam du'ang mi bgyid snyam pa sdig pa las ldog pa'i stobs/ sngar byas kyi gnyen por rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas la spyod pa gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs te/ de ltar stobs bzhi dran bzhin pa'i ngang nas yig brgya gsol 'debs kyi tshul du 'bad pas/ de'ang thog mar thugs ka'i sa bon dang zhabs kyi mthe bong gi rtse las byang sems bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bde khril gyis bab par bsam la mthar 256

dza'ile lja pa mong byi'i sngo pharabrosku'i cha thams cad nas kyang byang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun skya chil le byung ba rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs/ nad thams cad rnag khrag ljan ljin/ gdon thams cad srog chags phra mo'i rnam pa/ sdig sgrib thams cad sol khu dang dud khu'i rnam pa can du dbang po'i sgo dang ba sbu'i bu ga thams cad nas mdor na phu chu drag pos thal ba brdas pa bzhin phyir sangs sangs song snyam du rang lus shel gyi khog pa phyis pa lta bu'i blo ma skyes kyi bar du gzhan du ma yengs par dmigs pa gcun la bzla ste/ de'ang slob dpon chen pos/ ma yengs ting 'dzin ldan pas bzla/ / gzhan du yengs par gyur pas ni/ / bskal par bzlas kyang 'bras mi 'byin/ / zhes gsungs so/ / de nas dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' khyed mkhyen no/ / bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad dus da lta nyid du dbyung zhing dag par mdzad du gsol snyam du 'bad pa na byang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun des rang gi spyi gtsug nas rkang sen gyi bar de srid du mer khrig ge ltem tser gyis gang bas sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi dngos grub thob par bsam mthar mgon po bdag ni sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas rdo rje sems dpa' zhal 'dzum par mdzad de 'o rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag pa yin no/ /zhes gnang ba byin par bsam/ spyi bo'i bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' nyid dbu'i nor bu nas mar 'od du zhu/ gdan pad+ma nas yar 'od du zhu/ thugs 'od lnga'i gang bu'i rang bzhin du gyur pa de nyid rang gi tshangs bug nas snying dbus su sib kyis thim par bsam la sdig sgrib sbyang bya sbyong byed kyi ngo bo la cer gyis bltas te mthar stong gsal zung 'jug spros pa dang bral ba'i ngang du dar cig mnyam par bzhag rjes dge ba bsngo ste/ sdig pa dag pa'i rtags 257

dza〉 ma chos rngogs sda che pha'i mashazhagadza'imatshan ma mthong gi bar du dmigs pa gcun la gsal zhing dag par bzla'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i gnyen por rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas la bslab par bya'o/ /brgyad pa/ chogs gnyis rdzogs thabs maṇ+ḍal/ byutshogs gnyis rdzogs thabs maṇ+ḍal pa ni/ 〈rdzogs chen ma rig mun sel 〉las/ brgyad pa tshogs bsags maṇ+ḍal ni tshogs zhing skyabs 'gro'i skabs ltar gsal gdab/ maṇ+ḍal gyi rgyu ci 'byor bya zhing tha na lag pa'i phyag rgya la dmigs kyang chog yid kyis bdag gir bzung ba'i lus longs spyod dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang bcas/ yongs su ma bzung ba'i stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab steng du rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla lha mi'i 'dod yon dpag tu med pa rnams kyang blos blangs te mchog gsum dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la/ kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab par dmigs te dbul bar bgyi'o/ / thugs rje 'gro ba'i don du bzhes nas bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa byang nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par mdzad du gsol snyam pas rgyas par 'dod na so bdun dang / bsdu na gter gzhung ltar/ chos dbyings rang byung rol ba'i rtsalaḥ phyi nang snod bcud snang srid chosaḥ khyab brdal zhing khams mchod sprin bcasaḥ 'khor gsum yongs dag nyid du rolaḥ sarba pū tsa rat+na maṇ+ḍal hūṃḥ zhes chos longs sprul gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal ci sang 'bul la/mthar skyabs yul gyi lha tshogs rnams rang la/ dzaḥhūṃbaṃ hoḥ zhes thim par 258

dza'ile lnga pa mong byi'i smo rigrobasam/ de yang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bde skyid thams cad tshogs bsags pa las byung ba yin la/ tshogs gsog pa'i thabs zab mo maṇ+ḍal 'di yin pas/ de ltar yun ring nyams su blangs na tshogs rdzogs pa'i rtags su zas cher ma zos kyang mi ltogs/ shes rab phye bas sngar ma go ba'i chos mang du shes/ sngar brjed pa'i chos mang du dran pas/ nyams dga'/blo chos la bkod thub pa 'byung / rmi lam du yang bud med mang pos zas skom ster ba 'byung / nyi zla shar ba dang / gyen la 'gro ba dang / spe tog thang la 'gro zhing me tog 'thu ba dang / gos gsar pa gyon pa/ rgyan btags/ chu la brgal ba/ pha rol tu sgrol ba dang chu la gru'am zam pa 'jug pa dang / maṇ+ḍal me long phyi zhing blta ba dang / dung 'bud pa dang / rnga bo che brdung ba/ rol mo dkrol ba/ lha khang mjal ba sogs rmi'o/ / de yang thengs re tsam rmis pa la blo gtad med pas rtags 'di rnams dngos sam nyams rmi lam du de dag yang yang byung na tshogs rdzogs pa'i rtags yang dag pa yin no/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/de yang mthun rkyen bsod nams ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i thabs mchog rmad du byung ba ni maṇ+ḍal 'di nyid du rgya cher bsngags shing / bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis ma rdzogs na/ dag pa gnyis ldan gyis sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs med/ de bzhin du rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid zab mo rtogs pa'ang tshogs gnyis la rag las pa yin te/ 〈sdud pa 〉las/ ji srid tshogs gnyis dam pa de ni ma rdzogs par/ / de srid stong nyid dam pa de ni rtogs mi byed/ / ces dang / rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tai lo pa'i zhal nas/ bu snang ba rten cing 'brel 'byung 'di/ / don skye ba 259

dza'i ma chos rdzogs pa che yo'i mag gadzajimed par ma rtogs par/ / tshogs gnyis shing rta'i 'phang lo dang / / 'bral bar ma byed nā ro pa/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ ji srid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob pa'i bar du bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis bsags pa la 'bad dgos pa dang / tshogs bsags pa rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa ni maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba yin no/ /maṇ+ḍal gyi rgyu ni/ rang rang gi 'byor pa dang bstun nas rab gser dngul la sogs pa'i rin po che'i maṇ+ḍal/ 'bring 'khar ba la sogs pa'i rgyu dag pa/ tha ma rdo shing la sogs pa'i stegs 'jam po'i gzhi ma la byi dor legs par byas la/ dri bzang dang ba byung gis byugs/ de'i steng 'god rgyu'i tshom bu yang / rab g.yu/ byi ru/ mu men/ mu tig la sogs pa'i rin po che yin/ 'bring a ru dang skyu ru sogs sman gyi 'bras bu yin/ tha ma nas dang /'bras/ gro/ sran ma la sogs pa'i 'bru yin/ de 'dra'i tshom bu bkod pa dmigs rten nyid du byas te/ mdun gyi nam mkhar sku gsum gyi ngo bo rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa tshogs zhing du dmigs pa zhig yin/de yang sku gsum yi ge 'bru gsum gyi rnam par shar ba/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis mgo drangs shing / gling bzhi ri rab 'dod lha'i gnas drug tshangs pa'i 'jig rten dang bcas pa gcig gi mthar khor yug mu rgyud dpag tshad bzhi khri 'phags pas bskor ba nyi zlas brgyan pa ni/ gling bzhi 'jig rten gyi khams zhes bya zhing / de nyid stong gi mthar sum cu rtsa gsum dang mnyam pa'i lcags ris bskor ba la/ stong dang po spyi phud kyi 'jig rten gyi khams zhes zer/stong dang po'i spyi phud kyi 'jig rten gyi khams de nyid gcig nas gnyis su bgrang ba'i stong la gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang mnyam pa'i lcags ris 260

dzajile lnga pa/ na mong phyi'i sngo rigrobaskor ba la/ stong gnyis pa bar pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams zhes ze ra ba yin zhing / de gar ri rab dang nyi zla la sogs pa sa ya phrag re yod par bshad/bar ma'i 'jig rten gyi khams de stong gi mthar/ tshangs ris dang po'i lha gnas dang mnyam pa'i lcags ri mtho khyad kyis bskor ba la/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams zer ba yin zhing / de na nyi zla la sogs pa ther 'bum ste bye ba phrag brgya gnas pa dang / de ltar gnas pa'i zhing khams su rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun dang nye ba'i rin chen bdun sogs lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pas yongs su gtams yod par grags/bdag gi lus dang longs spyod/ dus gsum gyi dge tshogs dang bcas pa la bdag tu 'dzin pa'i gzhi gsum zer zhing / mdor na snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing khams su shes nas yongs su 'bul ba dang chabs cig tu 'gro ba rnams kyis chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur pa'i rgyal srid thob par shog snyam du bsam pa ni sprul sku'i maṇ+ḍal yin no/ /don la rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo skye med stong pa de'i rang bzhin lhun grub kyi snang cha ma 'gags pa las/ don gang gi 'og tu ma gyur pas 'og min dang /de yang kha sbyor yan lag bdun (longs spyod rdzogs pa'i yan lag dang / kha sbyor gyi yan lag bde ba chen po'i yan lag snying rjes yongs su gang ba'i yan lag rgyun mi 'chad pa'i yan lag 'gog pa med pa'i yan lag)gyi bdag nyid longs spyod rdzogs pa dang / kha sbyor dang / bde ba chen po gsum ni/ longs sku rang gi ngos nas bzhag pa'i yan lag yin/ rang bzhin med pa ni de nyid kyi ngo bo'i bzhugs tshul rnam par dag pa zhig yin pa de nyid chos 261 spre

tho'i mazhe sa rngo sa ba che yo'i ma zhaga'ajisku'i ngos nas bzhag pa'i yan lag yin/ snying rjes nges gang dang / rgyun mi 'chad pa dang / 'gog pa med pa gsum ni rtsal snang sprul sku'i ngos nas bzhag pa'i yan lag yin te/ dz+nyokha spyor yan lag bdun 〉las/ lus las byung ba'i bde ba dang / sems las byung ba'i bde ba nyams su myong ba ni/bde ba tsam ste/ de nyid kyang shin tu rgya che ba dang / zag pa med pa dang / gya nom pa dang / 'khor ba ji srid bar gnas pas na/ bde ba chen po ste/ bde ba chen po de lta bu dang ldan pa'i stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams de dag ni nges pa lnga dang ldan pa zhig ste/ gnas 'og min/ ston pa nges pa rigs drug pa rdo rje 'chang / 'khor nges pa rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas/ chos nges pa gsang chen rdo rje theg pa/ dus nges pa rtag pa rgyun gyi 'khor lo lnga dang ldan pa zhig yin/de ltar dbus su rnam par snang mdzad/ shar rdo rje sems dpa'/ lho rin chen 'byung gnas/ nub snang ba mtha' yas/ byang don yod grub pa ste/gangs can mtsho sde lnga re re las/ 'khor rigs chung lnga lngas bskor ba dang /de dag gi steng gi nam mkhar khro bo'i gangs can mtsho sde lnga/ rigs chung lnga lngas bskor ba bcas rigs lnga'i tshom bus brgyan pa can/ don dngos gnas la yan man phan tshun steng 'og gi gzhal byar mi dmigs pa 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po bsam yas pa zhes pa ste/ 〈gsang snying 〉las/gzugs sna tshogs dang / sgra sna tshogs dang / dri sna tshogs dang / ro sna tshogs dang / reg bya sna tshogs kyis phyogs bcur 'khrigs pa rang byung la/ zhes gsungs pa ltar phul nas/ 'gro ba rnams longs sku'i zhing la spyod par shog cig bsam pa ni longs sku'i maṇ+ḍal yin no/ /snang zhing srid pa'i chos yod do cog 'di thamase cad ye nas yod ma myong 262

dza'ile lnga sda mong byi'i sngo ribroba'i rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid rang rig gi ngo bo nang gsal thim la ma rmugs pa'i ye shes rang mthu rdzogs pas gzhon nu/ phyir mi mngon pas bum pa'i sku/ de yang ngo bo ka dag gi ye shes/ rang bzhin lhun grub kyi ye shes/thugs rje kun khyab kyi ye shes dang gsum du gnas so/ / de la ngo bo'i dpe ni/〈thal 'gyur 〉las/ ngo bo ka nas dag pa'i cha stong gsal 'dus ma byas pa sku yi gdangs/ zhes dang / rang bzhin dpe ni/ 〈rtsal rdzogs 〉las/ nang gsal bum pa'i mar me bzhin/ / zhes dang / thugs rje'i dpe ni/ 〈rtsal rdzogs 〉las/ sgron me'i 'od zer nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dra/ / sgron me'i 'od zer stong la thug pa med/ / ces gsungs pa ltar/ thugs rje'i rigs ma 'gag pa chos nyid kyi rol rtsal las shar ba'i rgyan ni/ sku dang thig le rig pa tshad phebs kyi tshom bur bkod de/ gzung 'dzin gyi 'khrul ba rnam par dag pa'i zhing khams phul bas/ 'gro ba rnams chos sku'i zhing du spyod par shog snyam bzhin du 'bul ba ni chos sku'i maṇ+ḍal yin no/ /de 'dra'i maṇ+ḍal tshul ji ltar 'bul dgos she na/ 〈rdzogs chen a ti zab don gyi khrid dmigs zin bris 〉las/ brgyad pa tshogs gnyis rdzogs byed maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid ni/ mthun rkyen bsod nams ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i thabs mchog rmad du byung ba ni maṇ+ḍal nyid du bsngags pas/ des na maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba'i yul tshogs zhing skyabs 'gro'i skabs bzhin gsal btab la maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba'i rdzas ni rab gser yin na sor bzhi tsam dang / dngul mtho gang tsam byas pas kyang chung ngu'i skyon du mi 'gyur/zangs dang 'khar ba sogs rin po che phal pa yin na ni khru gang nges par dgos/ de dag ma 'byor ba'i gang zag gis kyang rdo leb dang sa gzhi byi dor 263

dza'i ma chos rdzo sa pa che yo'i mgazhagadza'ibyas pas byed rung / gong ltar kyang rin po che la sogs pa mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal 'du byas la/ de'ang thog mar sems kyi rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i brdar maṇ+ḍal nyid legs par byi dor bya/ de nas 'byung lnga dang dri bzang po'i chus khyam mer chag btab ste ye shes kyi rlan mi yal ba'i dgos pa yod ces gsungs/de nas lag g.yon gyis nas tshom zhig blangs la maṇ+ḍal bzung / rang gzhan sems can thams cad mgrin gcig tu 'khor bar bsams nas de thams cad sum phrugs kyis tshom bu dgod cing gso ba dang / ngag gis maṇ+ḍal gyi tshig nyid byad rang gis drang ste 'u dir dir sgrog par bsam/ yid kyis dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhis btegs pa'i dbus su ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ de nas rim gyis phyogs bzhir shar gling shel las grub par rang bzhin gzugs zla gam/ kha dog dkar po/ lho gling be+eḍūr+ya'i rang bzhin gzugs sog pa/ kha dog sngon po/ nub gling pad+ma rā ga'i rang bzhin gzugs zlum po/ kha dog dmar po/ byang gling rin po che'i rang bzhin gzugs gru bzhi/ kha dog ser po/ de nas gling chung rnams che chung ma gtogs bzo dbyibs dang kha dog gling chen rnams dang mtshungs pa/ de nas rin po che'i ri bo shar gyi 'dod yon/dpag bsam gyi shing lho'i 'dod yon/ 'dod 'jo'i ba nub kyi 'dod yon/ma rmos pa'i lo tog byang gi 'dod yon/ 'khor lo rin po che shar/ nor bu rin po che shar lho/ btsun mo rin po che lho/ blon po rin po che lho nub/ glang po rin po che nub/ rta mchog rin po che nub byang / dmag dpon rin po che byang / gter chen po'i bum pa byang shar/ sgeg pa ma shar/ phreng ba ma lho/glu ma nub/ gar ma byang / me tog ma shar lho/ bdug spos ma lho nub/ mar me ma nub byang / dri chab ma byang shar/ ri rab kyi shar du nyi ma/ nub tu zla ba/264

dza'ile rnge la —ci mong phyi'i smo ribrolhor gdugs/ byang du rgyal mtshan rnams dang / gzhan yang sring rtse man chad dang lha mi'i 'byor ba bzang la gya nom pa rang gi blos ji tsam 'khyud pa'i bar de srid du 'bul ba ni sprul sku'i maṇ+ḍal te/ de ltar tshom bu so gsum ma'i lugs su byas pa'i maṇ+ḍal ston byed kyi rtsa ba'i gzhung rnams kyi rjes su 'brangs pa yin la/ tshom bu so bdun ma deng sang yongs grags kyi lag len ltar bkod kyang 'gal bar mi sems gsungs/ gang ltar yang gzhan du tshom bu dgu bkod la/ na mo rin chen gzhi ldan sogs dang / yang tshom bu bdun bkod la rang gis yongs su bzung ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bu dang bu mo gces dgu ma lus pa blos ling gis dpyad nas 'bul ba ni longs sku'i maṇ+ḍal/yang tshom bu lnga bkod nas bdag lus mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa dgos 'dod ma lus pa 'byung ba'i gnas gcig pur gyur par dmigs te zhen 'dzin med par 'bul ba ni chos sku'i maṇ+ḍal/ yang tshom bu gsum bkod la chos nyid stong gsal dag pa'i klong du rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo thig le dkar po mthing ser dmar ljang la sogs pa mdor na de re re'i nang du'ang thig le bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros te 'bul ba ni ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i maṇ+ḍal te gtso bor sprul sku'i maṇ+ḍal nyid chig dril bya/mthar maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba'i yul tshogs zhing / 'bul bya'i mchod rdzas/ 'bul ba po'i gang zag ste kun kyang gsum ka mi dmigs pa'i ngang du dar cig mnyam par bzhag rjes/ de ltar bgyis pa'i mthu las bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi tshogs rnam gnyis rdzogs/ sgrib rnam pa gnyis byang bar mdzad du gsol snyam pa'i ngang du/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun/ / sogs kyis dge ba bsngo ba'o/ / de ltar 'bul ba'i phud du ma re bsags pa nangs par bla ma'i 265

cho dza'i ma chos mogs pa che yo'i ma zha dzajimaṇ+ḍal gyi steng du 'bul zhing / yang maṇ+ḍal 'bum tsho legs par bsags pa yin na/ phud slar bla ma la 'bul lam/ dkon mchog gi rten la 'bul gelas rang gis longs mi spyod pa phyag len no/ / zhes dang / dz+nyordzogs chen klong snying 'bru 'grel 〉las/ mdun gyi nam mkhar sku gsum gyi ngo bo rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa tshogs zhing du dmigs la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes brjod pa dang chabs cig gling bzhi ri rab lha gnas dang bcas pa'i stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing khams rnams na/ rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun la sogs pa lha dang mi'i yo byad kyi 'byor tshogs dam pas yongs su gtams shing gang ba blos blangs/ khyad par bdag tu 'dzin pa'i gzhi rang gi lus longs spyod dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang bcas pa mdor na 'dzin sems kyis gces dgur bzung ba thams cad ma lus pa yongs su legs par 'bul gyis/ dam pa chos kyi 'khor los 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi kha lo thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam la bsgyur pa'i rgyal srid dam pa rang bzhin sprul pa'i sku thob par shog cig snyam du bsam pa ni thun mong sprul sku'i maṇ+ḍal/ de'i steng nam mkhar 'og min bde chen gyi gnas rnam dag stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams ye shes rin po che'i gzhal med khang na/ ston pa la sogs nges pa lnga ldan rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor tshom bu'i rnam pa can la/ sgeg sogs 'dod yon gyi lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po bsam yas grangs med pa thogs pas brgyan pa blos dpag tu med pa sprul na/ legs par yul lhun grub longs sku'i zhing khams la spyod par shog cig snyam pa ni thun min longs sku'i maṇ+ḍal/ de'i steng gi dbyings la snang srid gdod ma nas rnam par dag pa gzhon nu bum pa'i sku yi gnas lugs skye med 266 sne

dza'ile lnga pa mong byi'i smo 'grobasam ngo dang bral ba'i gzhi la/ thugs rje ma 'gags 'od gsal gyi snang cha snang gzhi la sogs chos nyid rnam dag gi rol pa sna tshogs pa'i rgyan ye nas rang shar ba'i/ sku dang thig le'i rnam par 'dzin pa rnam par dag pa'i zhing snang tshom bu'i tshul du bkod de legs par phul bas kun bzang chos sku'i zhing la spyod par shog cig snyam pa ni khyad par chos sku'i maṇ+ḍal yin la/ de lta bu'i dmigs gnad khong du chud pa'i ngang nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba 'di ni lam gyi gnas skabs thams cad du 'dor du mi rung ba'i nyams len yin pas dam pa gsum gyi gnad dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas 'bad par bya/ mthar tshogs zhing rnams rang la bsdus te 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag go/ lnga pa bdud bzhi gcig char du gcod pa ku sā li'i tshogs gsog ni/ de la ku sā li zhes pa ni/ sprang po'i don yin pas tshe blos btang gi rnal 'byor ri khrod pa lta bu tshogs gsog pa'i longs skyod gzhan mi rnyed pa rnams kyis dmigs pa la brten nas rang gi lus kyi mchod sbyin byed pa yin/ lus la gces 'dzin bcad de mchod sbyin bya ba ni/ dngos po gzhan gyi mchod sbyin bya ba las lhag par yang phan yon che ba yin te/ ji skad du/ rta dang glang po brgya 'gyur yin/ / bu dang chung ma stong 'gyur yin/ / lus kyi mchod sbyin 'bum 'gyur yin/ / zhes dang / ma gcis/ gi zhal nas/ chags med lus sbyin byed pa de/ / tshogs gnyis yin par ma shes nas/ / phung po gces 'dzin byas pa de/ / ma sprul pa'i sku la mthol lo bshags/ / zhes gsungs/ de yang rang gi snying dbus su sems rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo ma cig khros ma nag mo sku mdog mthing nag phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rna ltag g.yas su phag zhal nag pos ngur sgra sgrogs 267

dza'i ma chos rdzo sa sda che yo'i rnamagazhagadza'ipa khro mo'i cha byad can gar stabs ling nge yod pa zhig gsal la phaṭaḥ ces brjod pas rtsa dbu ma'i lam brgyad spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga thon par bsam pa'am/ yang na 'don sgom zung du 'jug pas/ sdud byed thabs kyi yi ge pha dang / gcod byed shes rab kyi yi ge ṭa ste/ de yang thabs snying rje chen pos sems can thams cad sdud cing / shes rab stong nyid zab mos rang gzhan rnams kyi rgyud la yod pa'i bdag tu 'dzin pa gcod par byed pas na/ phaṭaḥces bya/ de nas rang gi lus la bdag gces par 'dzin pa'i blos zhen rtog thams cad rtsa ba nas bcad pa'am bor bas lha bdud rang sar choms pas/rang sems gtad med kyi rig pa spyi bo tshangs pa'i bug sgo nas mkha' dbyings la thon te dbyings rig dbyer med du bsres la skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i 'dus ma byas yin pas 'chi bdag gi bdud ngang gis bcom pas/rang rig khros mar lam gyis gnas gyur te/ de'i mod la rang lus ro ru gyur nas ling gis 'gyel/ de yang che ba tsho ba stong gsum gyi rgya khyon dang mnyam pa zhig tu bsgom/ de nas rang nyid khros mar gsal ba'i phyag g.yas na chags sdang rmongs gsum gyi rtog tshogs nyon mongs pa'i bdud bcom byed shes rab ye shes kyi gri gug gis/ rang gi lus bem po de'i smin mtshams su tshad tsam byas pas gzugs kyi phung po'i bdud bcom nas bam ro'i thod pa bregs/phyag g.yon na las byed kyi tshul gyis bhasnya ste thod pa de nyid thogs te/ sku gsum gyi mtshon byed mi mgo'i sgyed pu ri rab dang mnyam pa gsum gyi steng du dpral ba rang la phyogs par bzhag thod pa de'i nang stong gsum gyi rgya dang mnyam pa de nyid phyag g.yas pa'i gri gug gis blangs te thod par bcug thod pa'i 'og na me'i rang bzhin yi ge a thung dmar po gnas pa las me 'bar 268

dza'ile lnga pa moja phyi'i smonarigrokhriyizhing thod pa dros te nang gi bam ro de so ro ro zhu nas khol te thod pa'i kha gang nas 'bag btsog dang dri ma dag pa'i cha thams cad lbu ba dang spris ma'i rnam par phyir lud de/ rlangs pa 'phyur ba thod pa'i steng gi hūṃ yig dkar po la phog pas hūṃ yig kyang dros te bdud rtsi dkar dmar gyi rgyun babs pa thod pa 'i nang gi bdud rtsir gnyis med du 'dres shing mthar hūṃ yig kyang 'od du ltem gyis zhu nas thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang gnyis med du thim par bsam/ de yang /yi ge 'bru gsum gyi byin rlabs dang nus pas 'dod dgur bsgyur ba ste/ oṃ gyis kha dog dri ro la sogs pa'i skyon thams cad sbyangs/ āḥyis mang por spel/ hūṃ gis gang la gang 'dod kyi dngos por bsgyur te/ zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'dod rgu thams cad 'byung ba'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam la/oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes dmigs pa ma zin gyi bar du brjod/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i khri rkang dar zab 'bol brtsegs dang bcas pa'i steng du drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid sku mdog smug nag ho ru ka'i chas can zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas pas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar gtod pa'i tshul du 'dzin cing / g.yon mnyam bzhag gi steng na 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i ka pā la bsnams pa/ mchan khung g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ ka 'chang zhing sku la stag sham dang tsus pa'i rgyan drug gis spras pa/ dbu la thod pa skam po lnga brgyan cing zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i stabs su bzhugs pa/ de'i steng gi cha la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang / bar gyi cha la yi dam mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs/ thod pa'i kha'i thad kyi nam mkha' las ye shes dang las la grub pa'i chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang yul lha gzhi bdag la sogs pa 'khod/ de'i 'og gi sa gzhi'i steng du bgegs rigs lan 269

dza'idamayos rngo sa pa che yo'i mgazha dza'ichags kyi mgron gtso bor gyur pa'i khams gsum rigs drug gi sems can thams cad nyi zer la rdul 'khrigs pa ltar gsal gdab/ phaṭaḥ yar mchod yul gyi mgron rtsa rgyud bla ma rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can dang / yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi ljags rdo rje dang 'khor lo la sogs pa'i rnam pa can gyi sbu gus bdud rtsi'i bcud drangs te gsol bas thugs dam gyi dgyes pa bskangs/ rang gi tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing sgrib gnyis dag dam tshig nyams chag byang nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub rnam pa gnyis thob par bsam/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi ljags nyi zer gyi sbu gu can gyis rbedud rtsi'i bcud drangs te gsol/ rang gi tshogs rdzogs shing sgrib pa dag dam chos byang chub sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad bsal/mthun rkyen smon pa'i legs tshogs thams cad spel bar bsam/ de nas rang nyid khros mar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas las byed kyi mkha' 'gro ma dkar ser dmar ljang mthing ga brgya stong grangs med pa nyi zer la rdul 'khrigs pa ltar spros nas/ de dag gis snod ye shes kyi ka pā la bcud zag med kyi bdud rtsis gang ba re re mar khams gsum 'khor ba'i mgron du gyur pa thams cad la byin pas mnyes shing tshims te/ bsad pas tshe thung ba/ 'phrog pas nor dbul ba/brdung bas nad mang ba la sogs pa'i lan chags thams cad byang / khyad par du gnod byed gdon bgegs kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad ngoms shing tshim par bsam pa ni dkar 'gyed yin/ yang bdud rtsi khol ba'i rlangs pa las me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo/ bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ 'phan gdugs la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros nas yar mgron rnams la mchod/ rang gzhan 270

dza〉le lnga pa na mong byi'i smo pharagro —sems can thams cad kyi tshogs sgrib pa dag par bsam/ yang mar mgron thams cad la so so'i gang la ci 'dod kyi yo byad thams cad char bzhin du babs pas thams cad dga' mgu tshims shing yi rang bas/ lan chags 'khor/ bu lon sod/ sha 'khon byang / nad gdon dang sdig sgrib dgathams cad kyang ngoms shing tshims nas rigs drug so so'i las snang sdug bsngal bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad bral te/ pho thams cad 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang / mo thams cad rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i go 'phang thob ste khams gsum 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par bsam pa ni khra 'gyed do/ / dam chos byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad chos nyid mnyam pa nyid kyi dbyings su zhi zhing / rkyen ngan dang las nyon thams cad kyi rtsa ba bdag tu 'dzin pa thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du rlog par bsam la/ mthar mchod par bya ba'i las bdud rtsi phul ba la sogs pa dang / mchod par byed pa'i mkhan po rnal 'byor pa rang dang / mchod pa'i yul yar mar gyi mgron ma lus pa kun kyang gzhi med sgyu ma'i rang bzhin lta bu/ ngo bo gang du'ang ma grub pa'i gshis skye med spros pa thams cad dang bral ba rang bzhin 'gag med kyi snang cha mtha' dag ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs pa/ thugs rje kun khyab kyi rig pa mi gnas mnyam pa chen por lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas lugs rnal ma ma bcos pa'i chos nyid kyi klong du āḥ zhes mi dmigs pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag go / spyir gcod gzhung rnams las/dkar 'gyed dmar 'gyed khra 'gyed nag 'gyed de 'gyed chen bzhi bshad kyang / 'di dkar 'gyed dang khra 'gyed gnyis las dmar 'gyed dang nag 'gyed med pa yin/ de nas gcod kyi dbye ba gsungs pa yang / gnyan sa ri 271

— dza'i mchosardzogs la che yo'i rnamagazhaga'ajikhrod 'grims pa phyi yi gcod/ phung po zan du bsgyur ba nang gi gcod/ nyag gcig cod nas gcod pa don gyi gcod/ gcod de gsum dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa legs te/ zhes gsungs/ des na gcod byed pa thams cad kyang ma rig pa dang 'khrul snang thams cad kyi rtsa ba bdag 'dzin rtsad nas gcod pa la/nyag gcig rtsad nas gcod pa don gyi gcod pa dang 'khrul snang thams cad kyi rtsa ba bdag 'dzin rtsad nas gcod pa la/ nyag gcig rtsad nas gcod pa don gyi gcod ces bya ba yin pas/ ma cig gi zhal nas/ thogs bcas bdud dang thogs med bdud/ / dga' byed bdud dang snyems byed bdud/ / de yang snyems byed bdud la thug / ces gsungs/ des na 'dre zhes bya ba bdag 'dzin snyems byed kyi bdud yin la/ nang snyems byed kyi rtsa ba ma chod par de'i rtsal las byung ba'i phyi 'khrul snang gi lha 'dre med par byed mi nus te/brag srin mos kyang / rje btsun la/ 'dre sems kyi rtsa ba ma shes na/ / 'dre nga bas mi tshad gzhan yang yod/ / khyod song zhig byas pas nga mi 'gro / zhes sogs zhus pa ltar dang / rje btsun gyi zhal nas kyang / 'dre 'dre ru bzung na gnod pa yin/ / 'dre sems su shes na grol ba yin/ / 'dre stong par rtogs na mchod pa yin/ / zhes gsungs/ des na gcod bya phyi na med de nang na yod pa shes par byas la/ gces 'dzin dang bdag 'dzin rtsa ba nas bcad de lus srog phangs pa med par lha 'dre'e zan du ster/ rgyu zhe sdang dang gdug rtsub zhi ste byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bskyed par bya ba dang smon lam la sogs pa snying thag pa nas byed/ gcad bya dang gcod byed thams cad chos nyid mnyam pa nyid kyi klong du brdal na/ nang snyems byed gdon gyi rtsa ba chod de mthar thug don gyi chod tshad mngon du gyur pa yin no/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar 272

'jile 55 pa moja phyi'i rjo lhurakro'abul bar bya'o/ / dgu pa/ byin rlabs myur 'jug bla ma'i rnal 'byor/rtogs pa'i ye shes rang rgyud la mngon du bya ba'i thabs kyi mthar thug pa byin rlabs myur 'jug bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ 〈rdzogs chen ma rig mun sel 〉las/ dgu pa byin rlabs myur 'jug bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ de yang sa lam gyi rtogs pa myur du rgyud la skye bar byed pa la bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgom pa gal che ste/ rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ nyan na tshig mi zin/ bsam na don mi go bsgoms na rgyud la mi skye ba'i dus su zhing gi mthu la brten pa man ngag yin zhes gsungs/ des na zhing gi mchog ni bla ma yin te/ a ti bkod par/drin dang ldan pa'i bla ma de/ / snying gi dkyel dang spyi bo'i gtsug / yan lag mthil du gang bsgom pa/ / sangs rgyas stong gi byin rlabs te/ / gang zag de yis 'dzin par 'gyur/ / zhes dang / dam tshig bkod pa las/ mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa'i lha/ / bskal ba 'bum du bsgom pa las/ / bla ma dran pa 'bum char yin/ / bsnyen sgrub bzlas pa sa ya bas/ / bla ma'i gsol 'debs lan gcig dga'/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ rang gi spyi bor ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa la rnam pa chos sku kun tu bzang po la brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyis bskor ba gsal gdab pa'i tshul ni/ rang nyid rta phag yab yum skuḥ me long gzugs bzhin gsal ba yiḥspyi bor pad+ma nyi zla dang ཿ 'ja' 'od gur khang chen po'i klong ཿ chos sku kun tu bzang po nyidaḥ dgyes 'dzum 'od zer 'phro ba'i skuḥ rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs pa'i mtharaḥ brgyud pa'i bla ma skar tshogs bzhinaḥ mngon 273

dza'i ma chos rngogs pa chenayo'i mgazhaga'ajisum lta bur bzhugs par gsalaḥ zhes pa ltar gsal btab nas tshogs bsags kyi gnad la bzhugasaḥ lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshalaḥ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bulaḥ nyams chag sdig sgrib mthol lo bshagasaḥgasang sngags sgrub la rjes yi rang ཿ smin grol chos 'khor bskor du gsolaḥmya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba 'debasaḥ dge ba byang chub chen por bsngoḥthams cad sangs rgyas myur thob shogaḥ de nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshul ni/ o rgyan rin po che'i zhal nas/ mos gus kyi 'khyer so ni/ nga'i bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas phyogs dus rgyal ba thams cad kyi ngo bo/ rigs 'dus dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyi gzugs/'gro ba thams cad kyi skyabs mgon/ nga'i tshe 'di dang phyi ma bar do gsum mthoragatong dma' gtong kha tsam min pas bla ma mkhyen snyam du bcos ma ma yin pa gal che zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mos gus rtse gcig pas/ e ma hoḥskye med ka dag chos dbyings zhing khams suḥ thog ma'i sangs rgyas kun bzang yab yum laḥ gsol ba 'debs so smin cing grol bar mdzodaḥmadangs rtsal ma 'gags skye med klong yangs nasaḥ longs sku'i gtso mchog rdo rje sems dpa' laḥ gsol ba 'debs so smin cing grol bar mdzodaḥdur khrod so sa gling gi gnas mchog tuḥ mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo las kyi dbang mo cheraḥ gsol ba 'debs so smin cing grol bar mdzodaḥ dha na mi rnyi'i zhing khams yangs pa ruḥ slob dpon chen po hūṃ chen ka ra laḥ gsol ba 'debs so smin cing grol bar mdzodaḥ rgya nag ri bo chen po'i shar phyogs suḥ mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo lab kyi sgrol ma laḥ gsol ba 'debs so smin cing grol bar mdzodaḥ mchod rten bde byed brtsegs pa'i pho brang duḥ o 274

dza'ile lnga la mong gyi'i sngo pharagrorgyan gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje laḥ gsol ba 'debs so smin cing grol bar mdzodaḥ gar bzhugs dam gtsang zhing khams yangs pa ruḥ ye shes mtsho rgyal a ma kun stobs laḥ gsol ba 'debs so smin cing grol bar mdzodaḥsbas yul pad+ma bkod kyi gnas mchog tuḥ dregs pa'i mnga' bdag rig 'dzin dpal seng laḥ gsol ba 'debs so smin cing grol bar mdzodaḥgazhu stod gter sgrom mtsho rgyal gsang phug tuḥ bka' bab las sad bde chen rgyal po laḥ gsol ba 'debs so smin cing grol bar mdzodaḥ skabs 'dir/ mchog gsum rtsa gsum sku gsum 'dus pa'i dpalaḥ sangs rgyas kun dngos rtsa ba'i bla ma laḥ gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nasaḥ 'khor ba dong sprugs phrin las mthar phyin shogaḥ des grangs bsog go/ deng nas bdag sogs mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kunaḥ sems dang sems nyid bde chen chos sku'i klong ཿ gdod ma'i dbyings su mngon par byang chub nasaḥ mtha' yas 'gro kun 'dren par byin gyis rlobasaḥ zhes gsol ba btab pas mthar/ rtse gcig gsol btab bla ma yiḥ gnas gsum 'bru gsum gnas pa lasaḥ dkar dmar sngo ba'i 'od zer 'phrosaḥ bdag gi gnas gsum thim pa yisaḥ dbang bzhi thob nas sgrib bzhi sbyangasaḥ sku bzhi mngon du 'gyur bar shogaḥ ces ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi len cing /mthar bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pa'i ngang la dar cig bzhag go/ de ltar thun bzhi'am rgyun du bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pas nyams rtogs rang bzhin shugs la 'char ba ni/ grub thob rig 'dzin thams cad kyi nyams myong mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig rgyud sde thams cad kyi dgongs pa yin te/ o rgyan rin po che'i zhal nas/ de ltar thun bzhir nyams su blangs nas/ bla ma'i 275

dza'idam chos rngogs sda che yo'i ma zha dza'ibyin rlabs bum pa gang byos tshul du thob nas tshe gcig gis mgon po rdo rje 'changagi go 'phang 'thob par byed pa la/ zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ / de dag rnams ni mdo sngags gnyis ga'i sngon 'gro thun mong gi dbang du byas pa'o/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/de yang gong du drangs pa'i lung ltar/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor la rten bskyed cing spyan drangs pa dang / tshogs bsags pa/ gsol 'debs kyi tshul gyis bzlas pa bya ba/ dbang bzhi blangs shing thugs yid bsre ba/ thun mtshams spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor dang lnga yod do/ /dang po rten bskyed cing spyan drangs pa ni/ e ma hoḥ zhes ngo mtshar ba'i tshig gis sngun bsus nas/ rang sems kyi ngo bo stong pa/ rang bzhin gyi snang cha lhun gyis grub pa ci snang thams cad sku dang ye shes kyi rnam rol 'ba' zhig tu 'char bas dag pa rab 'byams kyi zhing khams/ khyad par 'phags pa'i bkod pa rab tu rdzogs pa'i zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor gsal ba'i dbus su zhes zhing khams sbyong ba 'di ni sems stobs chen po'i spyod yul yin pas gnad shin tu che'o/ / de yang bde stong gi ye shes bskyed pa/ dbang gi snod du rung ba/ bla mas rjes su 'dzin pa dang gsum gyi rten cing 'brel 'byung gis rang nyid kyi gzhi lus rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ sku mdog dmar zhing gsal ba pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po la nyi ma bye bas 'khyud pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas su gzung 'dzin rtsa nas gcod pa'i gri gug sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa thur du brkyangs nas bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon pas chags sdang dbyings su stobs pa'i brdar thod pa khrag gis gang ba zhal du stobs par mdzad pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis 276

dza'ile lnga sda mong byi'i sngo 'grodor stabs su bzhugs pa/ spyan gsum steng gi nam mkhar rings pa'i tshul de bla mar mjal ba brel ba langs pa'i tshul gyis rnam par gzigs pa/ de'i spyi bor pad+ma 'dab ma 'bum rgya che bar brdal ba'i dbus su ze'u 'bru la ma reg tsam du shes rab stong pa nyid mtshon pa'i nyi ma dang / thabs bde ba chen po mtshon pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar gsal nya gang ba'i steng du/ skyabs gnas ma lus pa kun 'dus pa'i bdag nyid can sku drin mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla ma dang rnam pa dbyer med pa/ rnam pa rig 'dzin chen po mtsho skyes rdo rje/sprul pa'i sku de nyid sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa gzhon nu lang tsho bcu drug lon pa'i sha tshugs can/ sku la gsang gos dkar po/phod ka sngon po/ chos gos dmar ser/ za ber smug khra/ 'dung ma dmar po ste lnga brtsegs su gsol ba ste/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse rin po che'i zhal nas legs par gsungs pa ltar/ yang na theg gsum rdzogs pa'i brdar/byang sems kyi theg pa rdzogs pa'i rtags su nang du gsang gos dkar po/sngags kyi thegs pa rdzogs pa'i rtags su sa 'og gi ber chen mthing ga so thar gyi sdom pa rdzogs pa'i rtags su chos gos dmar po gser gyi le'u can mnabs pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i stabs su bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas pas ye shes lnga ldan mtshon pa'i gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ 'jig rten gyi dregs pa'i tshogs thams cad la bsdigs pa'i tshul gyis bsnams pas dregs pa can dbang du bsdu ba/ phyag g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i nang tshe bum rgyan ldan bsnams pa/ dbu la 'dab ldan pad+ma'i mnyen zhu'i rtse mor rdo rje phyed pa'i tog gis mtshan pa'i rtser rgod kyi ldem 'phru rma bya'i mdongs mtha' can gsol ba/ mtshan khung g.yon na bde stong gsang ba'i yum mchog ma man 277
