waṃmidawāzhin mardod kyi don khrid zang don ji nga pordzitshogs brgya rtsa dang / dkyil 'khor gyi mchod pa lo grangs dang / mdo bklag pa dang / mchod rten gso ba dang / gru zam 'chos pa dang / dge 'dun gyi ston mo bya ba dang / dam tshig bsrung ba dang / stong pa nyid bsgom pa dang /bcud kyis len pa dang / tshe bsgrub pa la sogs pa bya'o/ / de nas sngar gyi ltas log nas/ dang po skyon med dus ltar song na bslus pa yin no/ /gsum pa dus su 'pho ba ni/ thabs gang gis kyang 'chi ltas ma 'gyur na 'pho ba yin te/ yo byad thams cad spang dag byas la dben pa'i sar mchod gtor yod na bshams/ med na yid kyis bla ma dkon mchog dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong mchod la/ tshe 'di la ma chags pa'i bsam pa bya ste/ 'da' ka ye shes las bshad pa ltar/ dngos po ci la yang mi chags pa'i 'du shes dang /snying rje chen po'i 'du shes dang / chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa'i 'du shes dang / mi dmigs shing 'od gsal ba'i 'du shes la sogs pa bcu bsgoms pa'i mthar/ 'chi ba rmi lam sgyu ma/ nges pa'i don la 'chi rgyu med pa/rig pa rang gi ngo bo la lta ba rnams kyis nyam nga dang bag tsha med par byas te/seng ge'i nyal lugs sam/ skyil krung gis 'dug ste/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bsams la/ rang gi rtsa dbu ma'i nang snying ga na rang gi rig pa 'od lnga'i gong bu dbus su hūṃ mthing gas mtshan pa zhig sngar gyi rdo rje des mda' 'phangs pa ltar bskyod pa bla ma'i thugs kar thim nas je mtho je mtho las/ mthar yid la mi byed pa phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du 'pho bar bya'o/ / de lta bu rlung ka hig dang bsdongs pa bdun gyis mi 'pho mi srid do/ / btsan thabs su 'pho na/ dmigs pa de dang rtse chung gnon pa lhan cig byas pas nges par 'grub bo/ / rdo rje gdan bzhi las/ bu ga dgu yi steng 621

dzaji ma chos rdzogs la che la'i rnamagazhagadzajiphyogs nas/ / phral du yid kyis 'pho byed na/ / nyin bzhin bram ze gsod pa dang / / mtshams med lnga ni byed pa dang / / chom rkun las kyi longs spyod pa/ /'di ye lam gyis grol 'gyur te/ / sdig pas gos par mi 'gyur ro/ / zhes so/ /don lnga pa bar do'i rnal 'byor la gsum ste/ bar do sbyang ba/ gzung ba/ las kyi 'phro mthud pa'o/ / dang po ni/ da lta bar do yin pa'i 'du shes dang ma bral bas 'od gsal ngos bzung la/ nyin mo dang mtshan mo bsgom par bya'o/ /nyin mo ni stan la 'dug nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms te/ bar do 'byongs par gsol ba btab nas snang ba 'di bar do'i snang ba/ 'gro ba thams cad bar do'i skye 'gro/ zas za ba dang 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug bar do'i snang ba/ dran rig bar do'i shes par ngos bzung la ma shi ba'i 'du shes skad cig kyang mi bya bar/ nga shi 'dug bar do na 'dug snyam nas/ sngar ngo sprad pa bzhin 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po bsgom mo/ / sngar gyi rig pa dang bar do'i rig pa gnyis gcig yin pas 'byung ba sdud pa tsam min pa khyad med pa'i phyir da lta goms pas bar dor ngos zin pa yin no/ / de ltar goms pas mi lam gnyid gung du'ang de byung na bar dor phan thogs pa yin no/ /mtshan mo ni rmi lam 'dun pa'i gnad kyis sbyang bar bya ste/ nyal khar bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms la/ rmi lam 'byongs par gsol ba btab bo/ /gzung ba/ sbyang ba/ bar do'i 'od gsal du bsgom pa gsum las/ dang po rmi lam gzung ba ni/ dus kyi gnad srod/ lus gnad seng ge'i nyal lugs/dmigs pa'i gnad dang po smin phrag tu sems gzung / gnyid du 'gro khar 622

dza'imidatshobazhi mamud kyi zab do rje nga pokhriyimagrin pa na pad+ma dmar po 'dab bzhi'i lte bar a dmar po nas 'bru tsam la shes pa gtad cing / rmi lam la rmi lam shes nas zin par bya snyam du bsams la nyal lo/ / sad res la de ltar dran par byas pas rmi lam zin no/ / ma zin na bla ma la gsol ba gdab/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag nyin dus kyi 'dun pa drag po bya'o/ / des zin nges te/ dang po rbab tu shor ba sogs sngangs pa rtsub mo zhig gis rkyen byas nas zin no/ / zin dus lha'i sku dang yul sna tshogs dang / rdzu 'phrul du mar sprul ba dang / gcig gcig tu bsgyur ba la sogs pa bya'o/ / sbyang ba ni/ rmi lam gyi snang ba de nyid bden med sgyu mar rtsal sbyang zhing /chu dang me la sogs pa la rmi larma gyi me chus su la gnod/ sgyu ma yin/ rmi lam yin snyam du skad cig skad cig la bden med zhen med du byed pa'o/ /bar do'i 'od gsal la bsgom pa ni/ rmi lam de nyid bar do yin par thag bcad la/ bden med zhen med kyis rtsal sbyangs rjes ngo sprad pa'i 'od gsal gyi ngang la bsgom pa'o/ / de ltar byas pas nyin mtshan khyad med par bar do'i snang ba dang 'od gsal du 'byongs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa bar do ngos gzung ba ni/ 'chi kha'i tshe/ sa chu la thim pas lus lci/ chu me la thim pas kha sna'i chu skam/ me rlung la thim pas drod sdud/rlung rnam shes la thim pas phyi dbugs brtsegs ma las rgyu ba chad/ rnam shes nam mkhar thim dus gyen rgyu thur sel gyi rlung gnyis kyi dbu ma'i yar sna mar sna gnyis nas snying gar a rta phrad de dar cig brgyal/ nam mkha' 'od gsal zhugs dus ye shes bzhi las dang po snang ba'i ye shes skad cig ma 'char te/sngar thig le rtsol bas sgom pa'i 'od gsal yin pa las/ de las brgya 'gyur 623

dza'idam chos rngogs pa chen po'i ma gzhagadza'igyis bde la gsal ba/ 'dod chags kyi rtogs pa med pa skad cig ma gcig 'char ba ngos bzung la bsgom mo/ / de nas snang ba mched pa la thim pas sngon bas kyang gsal ba'i ye shes mched pa zhes bya ba skad cig gnyis su 'char ro/ / de ni sngar srog la gomus pa de dang gcig kyang / 'dir gsal la mi rtog pa brgya stong gis lhag pas zhe sdang gi rtog pa zhi ste/ 'od gsal de nyid ngos bzung la bsgom mo/ / de nas mched pa thob pa la thim pas mi rtog pa'i ye shes sngar yid la mi byed pa sgom pa de yin yang / de bas bye ba 'gyur gyi mi rtog la gsal bde spros pa med pa skad cig gsum 'byung ba de ngos bzung la bsgom mo/ / des ni gti mug gi rtog pa zhi ba'i dus so/ / thob pa nye bar thob pa'i ye shes la thim dus na/ sngon bas lhag pa'i bde gsal spros bral rang byung gi ye shes skad cig bzhi 'byung ste/ nyon mongs pa phra ba dang rags pa kun sprin nam mkhar zhi ba ltar dbyings su dar cig nub nas/ sngon 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po dus thams cad la rang bzhin rnam dag chen por ngo sprad pa de 'dir shar snyam du ngo shes par byas la/ de'i ngang du sgom pa'i skad cig la sangs rgyas thob ste/ mtshan brjod las/ skad cig gcig gis bye brag phyed/ / skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / zhes so/ / de dag gi tshe 'byung ba lnga'i rlung dbyings su dag pa 'od gsal lhan cig skyes pas bdag byas pa'i snang ba'ang du ba la sogs pa'i rtags bcu rdzogs par 'char te/ 'dir spros pas chog go/ /gsum pa las kyi 'phro mthud pa ni/ der ngos ma zin pa rnams la/ de nas rnam shes lus kyi phyir thon nas/ srid pa'i bar do rmi lam lta bu bde sdug sna tshogs pa can/ dbang po tshang ba/ rdzu 'phrul yod pa/ gang du'ang 'gro 624

waṃyidarizhin mdzod kyi don khrid zab na zhe nga pozhing gcig tu mi tshugs pa kun tu 'phyo zhing lus dang 'dug sa tshol lo/ / de'i dus su bar do ngos zin nas/ phyogs bcu'i zhing dag pa yid la byas te 'pho ba ltar rnam shes der zhugs pas kha cig rdzus te skye'o/ / sgyu ma lta bu'i bskyed rdzogs bsgoms pas kha cig grol lo/ /pha ma'i mngal dag pa mi lus rin po che sbyor bar byed pa/ ma'i mnga' du pad+ma la oṃ āḥhūṃ ngam lha'i sku bsams pa la rnam shes zhugs nas mi lus rin po che thob nas gsang sngags kyi chos dang phrad de skye ba de nyid dam/ bar dor phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob bo/ / 'jam dpal zhal lung las/ gzugs bcas phung por+sharang lus ni/ / tshe 'di nyid la ma grub kyang / /yid ni rdo rje'i skur grub nas/ / bar dor yang dag 'grub par 'gyur/ / ces so/ /donagasum pa rjes gegs sel ba la gsum ste/ spyod lam rgyun gyi rim pas gegs rnams mi 'byung bar bya ba/ ting nge 'dzin brtan pa'i gegs byings rgod bsal ba/ srog rtsol log pa'i gegs so sor bcos pa'o/ /dang po ni thun mgor lha dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa dang / lus sbyong la bslab pas nad gdon gyi gegs mi 'byung ba yin no/ / lus sbyong ni/rnam pa nyi shur 'dus pa'i dang po ni skyil krung bcas te lag pa 'khyud pa'i tshul lo/ / des yan lag gi nad sel lo/ / gnyis pa ni bsku mnye'i tshul du 'phur ro/ / des lus la drod skye'o/ / gsum pa ni sor mo bsnol la brang la gtad de phyir 'then pas brang gi nad sel lo/ / bzhi pa ni dpung pa gcus la lag pa g.yas dang g.yon du sprugs pas dpung pa'i nad sel lo/ / lnga pa ni lag pa gnyis brang nas khu tshur bcas pa phyir 'phangs pas/ sha pags chu ser 625

dza'idamacas rdzo sa la che yo'i rnam zha dza'igyi nad sel lo/ / drug pa ni lag pa gnyis dpung pa gnyis la bsnol nas bsdams te lus kun gcus pas sked pa'i nad sel lo/ / bdun pa ni rkang pa gnyis brkyangs pa'i brang pa gnyis nas lag pa gnyis kyis 'then pas chu rgyus kyi nad sel lo/ / brgyad pa ni lag pa g.yas g.yon gzhu 'gengs pa ltar byas pas lag pa'i tshigs dang sog phrag gi nad sel lo/ / dgu pa ni lag pa'i khu tshur gnyis mdun ri 'phul ba'i tshul du byas pas ro stod kyi sha rgyas pa dang lag pa'i sbe sha'i nad sel lo/ / bcu pa ni lus rgyab dang mdun du dgug pas mkhal nad mcher nad sel lo/ / bcu gcig pa ni lag pa'i mthe'u chung gnyis lu gu rgyud du sbrel te mdzub mo gnyis kyis spyi gtsug drang por bzhag pas rtsib logs kyi nad sel lo/ / bcu gnyis pa ni lte ba nang du 'then pas ma zhu ba dang pho ba'i nad sel lo/ / bcu gsum pa ni rkang lag bzhi sa la btsugs la mgo cog cog byas pas yan lag dang nying lag gi nad sel lo/ / bcu bzhi pa ni rkang lag bzhi sa la btsugs la g.yas dang g.yon du bltas pas rtse'u chung gi nad sel lo/ / bco lnga pa ni kha sbub/ rkang pa brkyang / lag mthil sa la btsugs te gru mo brang la gtad pas stod kyi phyi nang gi nad sel lo/ / bcu drug pa ni mgo cog g.yas dang g.yon du bskor bas ske dang mjing pa'i nad sel lo/ /bcu bdun pa ni lag pa gnyis bsnol la spyi bor bzhag pas ro stod kyi nad sel lo/ / bco brgyad pa ni pus mo gnam du reng nge gan rkyal du nyal ba'i spyi bor thal mo thad drang du sbyar bas rkang pa'i tshigs dang lag pa'i nad sel lo/ / bcu dgu pa ni rkang pa gnyis re mos su lag pa'i gru mo'i khung du blangs te brkyang bskum byugs pas rkang pa'i nya sha'i nad sel lo/ / nyi shu pa ni rkang pa gnyis kyi mgo pus mo gnyis kyi steng du re mos su bzhag cing ya gcig sa la 626

0yinaskyon phabasbyon zlabacardo /mi za shā shā zusgobatsugs thal mo sbyar bas stod smad thams cad kyi nad sel lo/ /gnyis pa bying rgod bsal ba ni/ spyod lam/ kha zas/ rlung /dmigs gnad bzhis bstan pa las/ spyod lam ni thun stod la bying na mthon stan po la bsdad/ ri dang nam mkha'i mtshams su blta/ khu tshur dpral bar bcings la mig bgrad do/ / rgod na dma' sar ol kos brang non par byas pa'i mgo thog tu zhwa gyon pa'am/ shing leb kyi bug pa la sems gtad do/ /thunasnad la bying rgod byung na khams kyi skyon yin pas thun chung la grangs mang ba'am/ skabs su dar re bsgom par bya'o/ /kha zas kyis bying na bcud can spang zhing bsil ba bsten no/ / rgod na chang phul re la sogs pa khams dang sbyar nas 'thung zhing gom pa lnga bcu tsam du 'chag cing bsgom mo/ /rlung gis bying na 'og sgo bsdams la lte bar bum pa can yang yang bya'o/ / rgod na gzung zhing rang nyid lhar bsgoms pa'i snying ga'i sa bon las brtan g.yo thams cad la 'od zer phog pas 'od du zhu ba thams cad bdag la bsdu ste/ 'dod khams lus kyi smad/ gzugs khams bar/ gzugs med stod la bsdu ba'o/ / bdag nyid snying ga'i sa bon la bsdu/ de je chung je phra las mthar stong pa'i ngang la gzhag go/ /dmigs gnad ni/ spyi gtsug bde chen 'khor lor sems bzung bas bying ba sel lo/ /rkang mthil lam sprul pa'i 'khor lor sems bzung bas rgod pa sel lo/ / yang rgod pa de nyid grangs bya zhing sems de'i ngo bo la bltas pas zhi'o/ /gsum pa srog rtsol gyi gegs sel snyesmu/ rlung khog par sems dang lhan 627

dza'idam chos rdzogs pa chen po'i ma gzhagadza'icig mi rta ltar gnas pa de nyid rlung log pas na zug drag tu 'byung la/khamasasnum dang sems mar me lta bu 'dres pa'i khams log pas zug bde mi bde 'dres mar 'byung ngo / / rtsa zug ni/ phreng 'dar la sogs pa drag la rgyun thung ba khang pa lta bu'o/ / sems gnas dus khams la brten/ 'phro dus rlung la zhon pa'i phyir/ de gnyis las su rung na sems las su rung ba'i gnad de yin no/ / de la khams kyi bcos thabs ni/ lus sbyangs kyis dgram pa dang /chang dang mi zhun dang / bdud rtsi gnyis kyi khrus dang / byug pas zug rang zhir 'gro zhing gang yang yid la mi byed pa nyid khams dwangs ma snyoms pa'i mchog yin te/ sems gnas pa nyid kyi skyon rtse gcig tu dmigs rten gcig la gzung ba la sogs pas 'byung la/ de yid la mi byed pas bsal ba'i phyir ro/ / rlung bcos pas kyang zhi bar nges pa yin no/ /rlung bcos pa la gsum ste/ rtsa ba'i rlung lnga'i bcos thabs dang / yan lag gi rlung lnga'i bcos thabs dang / spyi'i log gnon no/ /dang po lnga'i srog 'dzin pa'i rlung zin na/ snying 'chu zhing ro stod dang snying ga gzer ba 'ong ngo / / rengs na snying rlung dang smyo 'bog tu 'gro bas bcos thabs ni bsku mnye bya/ lus kyi snying ga chu'i rba la bzed/ rang sems rdo rje nor bur gtad/ ha drag po gdon/ me mnyam log par zin na pho ba dang mkhal sked na zhing gzer na kung kung ba 'byung ngo / / rengs na pho gzer dang dmu chur 'gro bas bcos thabs ni chang gi phru na sar gdab cing dugs bya/skyigs bu 'don/ shes pa mgrin par gtad la bsgom mo/ / thur sel gyi rlung zin na dpyi mig na/ rkang pa 'khril zhing ro smad bshal nas na/ dri chen skam po'am/ yang na bshal du 'byung / rengs na dri chen gyi sgo bsdams pas 628

dza'iyi wāzhin mazho kyi na da zab na zhe ngayokhrimibacos thabs ni bshang gci'i bar du mnye/ shes pas rlung tshangs bug tu drangs la bshang sgor phyir la rgyangs kyis 'phang ngo / / gyen rgyu'i rlung zin na mgrin pa skrang / mjing pa'am rtse chung na/ rengs na lkog 'bras su 'gyur ro/ / bcos thabs ni gyen du mi drang bar thur du mnan no/ / khyab byed zin na mgo bo na/ yan lag tshigs khol zhing ber ba 'ong ngo / / rengs na 'khum te sgur por 'gro'o/ / bcos thabs ni bsku mnye dang mchong rgyug bya/ lus stong par bsgom mo/ /yan lag gi rlung lnga'i bcos thabs ni/ mig tu rgyu ba'i rlung zin na mig na/ rengs na long ngo / / bcos thabs ni bsil sman gyi chu lcag brdeg go /des dmar tshag sel lo/ / skya bo mi gsal ba la rkang lag gi mthil bzhir byug pa bya/ mig yon por bsam mo/ / rna ba'i rlung zin na gzer zhing na/ 'ur sgra 'ong / rengs na 'on no/ / bcos thabs ni rna ba mi na ba'i ngos bkab ste rlung mnan la na sa ngos la gdon no/ / sna'i rlung zin na sna rus dang gdong pa na/sna zhom/ dri mi tshor/ dbugs kha nas phal cher 'gro'o/ / bcos thabs ni rlung 'then nas drag por btang / lga'am/ g.yer ma'am/ sug phyes sbrid pa 'byung ngo / / lcer rgyu ba'i rlung zin na lce dang / lce chung dang / rnyil skrang / so na/ kha 'tham/ lce chung 'bab/ lce bsgyur ldog dka'o/ / rengs na lkugs par 'gro'o/ / bcos thabs ni rlung sing sgra dang bcas nang du drag por 'then la/ mi thub dus kha nas phar sing sgra dang bcas pa drag tu 'phang ngo / / lus kyi pags par rgyu ba'i rlung zin na lus kyi pags pa kun 'khol zhing na ber ba ldang zhing tsha'o/ / za phrug dang / shu ba dang mdzer 'gyur/ pags pa 'gog go / bcos thabs ni rlung drag tu rngubs la rkang pa'i sor mor bsdus te lag 629

dza'i ma chos rdzogs la che yo'i mgazha dza'ipa g.yab cing bro brdung ngo / / shes pas rlung rnams ba spu'i bu ga nas thon par bsam mo/ /spyi'i log gnon ni/ lus tsha na spyi bo'i haṃ las thig le lhu ti na mar grang sib sib babs par bsam/ grang shas che na lte ba'i me zur gsum las 'bar bas lus khengs par bsam/ 'og sgo na yar yi las rlung gi dkyil 'khor g.yo bar bsam mo/ /bying na shes pa lus kyi phyir gdon/ rgod na nang du thig le la shes pa gtad/ 'gags na srin po'i sgo phye la steng rlung mnan/ 'khyams na tshangs bug phye la na bun gnam du 'phang / gzer na de'i steng du lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi'i zur bzhir rdo rje bsam mo/ / yang khams log ste mthong snang dmar po'am ser por song na mkhris pa yin pas grib mar bsdad/ chu rlung grang mos lus khengs par bsams la rlung gzung ngo / / skyug na bad kan te lus sbyang bya/ rlung gi rlung ljang gus lus gtor bar bsam zhing drag rlung gzung ngo / / 'dar zhing skyugs la mkho 'khor na rlung ste rlung gseng brdung /me rlung gis haṃ zhu bas lus khengs/ rkang mthil du sems gtad do/ /yang na log gnon lnga ste 'khor lo ltar bskor ba/ dru bu ltar 'dril ba/bu ga mang po'i sbyor ba/ steng 'og gi 'khor lo med pa la bslab pa/ rab tu dma' ba'i sbyor ba la bslab pa'o/ /dang po ni lus khengs pa snyam zhing na tsha che ba dag byung na lte ba'i gnas su 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa bsams la g.yas su 'khor bar bsgom/ des ma bde na g.yon du 'khor bar bsgom mo/ / de ltar 'khor bas lus dang 'khor lo je cher song bas nam mkha' gang bar bsgom/ rjes la nang stong pa dang phyi stong pa'i nam mkha' gnyis bar med gcig tu 'dres te lus dang 'khor lo mi 630

dza'imidawāzhin mardod kyi na da zab zhe jayodamigs par bsam mo /gnyis pa ni snying la sogs pa kor tser na ba la/ gang na sar bu ga gcig bsams pa na phar dbugs phyir song bar bsam zhing rlung drag po 'phang / ye shes kyi rlung rta rnga tsam gcig nang nas phyir dru bu ltar song nas nam mkha'i mthar bsam/ de nas rim gyis bug pa dang dru bu gnyis ka je cher song ste bug pa skar khung dang / mthongs khung tsam dang / dru bu skud pa dang / thag pa tsam du phyir 'dril bar bsam mo/ /gsum pa ni lus thams cad khyab par na na lus thams cad lcags seg gi mig ltar bu ga mang po yod par bsams la/ de thams cad na phar rlung dang nad phyir bton par bsam zhing rlung drag tu 'phang ngo / /bzhi pa ni lus stod na na sked pa yan chad mgrin pa man chad stong par bsams la/ de na phar la rlung sngo bun bun song bar bsam mo/ / gal te thur du 'khru ma/ 'og rlung drag tu bsdams pas chad do/ /lnga pa ni rlung gis brgyal 'bog dang mchong rgyug byung na rang gi 'og tu dong zab shin tu ring ba bsgoms pa na mar la rang gi lus tib tib bying ba'am/ sa'i 'og tu bying bar bsam mo/ / rlung sha lpags mtshams su zhugs na rkya rbab la 'gro/ phyis mdzer 'gro bas de bcos pa ni dri chus bkru/ chang dron mos bkru/ mar nag gam lo mar rnying pas bsku mnye lan mang du bya'o/ /des sel nges so/ /bcos thabs 'di dag ni nyams su myong ba'i gnad shin tu zab pas gsang zhing gces spras kyis nyams su blang bar bya'o/ / de ltar nyams su blangs pas gnas skabs su ting nge 'dzin dang / spyan dang / mngon shes dang / rdzu 631

dza'i ma chos rdzogs pa chen po'i rnam gzhagadza'i'aphrul dang / grub pa brgyad la sogs pa 'grub la mthar thug byang chub 'grub pa yin no/ /de ltar yang zab snying po'i gnad rnams kun/ /phyi rabs don du gsal bar bkod pa las/ /byung ba'i dge ba gangs ri ltar dkar des/ /'gro kun tshe 'dir bde chen mkha' skyod shog /yid bzhin mdzod kyi don khrid zab don rdo rje snying po zhes bya ba/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa dri med 'od zer gyis brag ri me tog brtsegs pa'i 'dabs su bkod pa rdzogs so/ /de yang yid bzhin mdzod kyi don khrid zab don rdo rje snying po zhes bya ba 'di ni nyams len pa rnams la nges par du mkho ba zhig yin par sems te 'dir bkod pa yang chos la blo bcos ma min par dad cing / snying thag pa nas gus pa/ sems bsam pa'i gting nas nyams su len par 'dod pa rnams dang phrad nas de dag gis thos pa dang / bsam pa dang / bsgom pa bcas byed pa 'i mthun rkyen du 'byor nas byin rlabs sam mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub stsol ba dang / rang don yid byed dang rnyed bkur snyan grags sogs 'jig rten chos brgyad la rab tu zhen zhing chags pa'i stobs jikyis rang gzhan kun la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i bsod nams dman pa rnams dang nam yang mi 'phrad pa'i smon lam 'debs so/ / / / dge'o/ /dge'o/ / dge'o/ / / /632

dam chos rjogs pa chen po'i rnam gzhag che long tsam brjod pa mthong grol byin rlabs k+kaban ba'i 'od gsal/rtsom pa po/ reb gong rdo rje mkhar/rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khun ba/ lhag sgron/mdun shog 'char 'god pa/ skal tshe/glog klad par bsgrigs pa/ bstan 'dzin/ ri chi ri bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang /dpa skrun 'grams spal tshan pa/ gli sko sgo(lha sa —nga ra byang lam ang 20)par 'debs tshan pa/ bod ljongs shin hwa par 'debs bzo grwa/deb tshad/ 850spo 1168 1(32par shog 20 375yig grangs/ khri 35par gzhi/ 2007lo'i zla 3par par gzhi 1bsgrigs/par thengs/ 2007lo'i zla 3par par thengs 1btab/par grangs/ 01 —2’000dpe deb ang rtags/ 1bya2kho978 —7—223—02120 —3rin gong sgor/ 30 00par gzhi sger bdag yin pas 'dra bcos par 'debs mi chog
